chapters.title: Chapter 301 -301-Duel at the Edge of the Abyss
paragraphs: Harris shot out of the arena space, his expression dark and livid.
Harris had been defeated!
Dustin had done it!
By himself, he had swept through every contestant except Faustus!
The spectator stands fell into a deathly silence.
Every gaze was fixed on Dustin’s proudly standing figure, filled with awe and shock.
A powerhouse from an outer universe was actually terrifying to such an extent!
The Endless Starfield contained countless heavenly talents, yet Dustin was merely a peak demi-sage rank from the Chaosverse.
There were as many universes among the stars as grains of sand. Who knew how many more powerful beings like him were still lying dormant out there?
At that thought, the spectators suddenly felt as tiny as specks of dust before the vastness of the starry sky.
"Faustus, it’s your turn."
At that moment, every spectator’s gaze turned toward Canaan Starfield.
"Faustus is our final trump card... I hope he can win."
"Faustus definitely can do it. No matter what, we have to believe in him!"
At this moment, even the contestants from Warzone One who had once been tricked by Daniel were now looking at him with eyes full of hope.
Dustin also looked toward Daniel, a smile on his face.
"Faustus, are you ready?"
Chanelle’s voice drifted softly through the air.
Daniel nodded calmly.
"Everything is under control."
"Go."
Chanelle’s voice was as warm as a spring breeze.
"Go and step onto the invincible path that belongs to you. Let it pierce through this vast darkness like a sharp blade!"
"Go and shake the entire universe. Make it tremble and roar beneath your feet. Illuminate the Endless Starfield. Become the legendary existence whose name future bards will sing beside the fire!"
Daniel’s figure vanished in an instant.
Under the gaze of countless eyes, Daniel appeared upon the arena.
By now, this arena space had already been shattered beyond recognition. Every inch of the void was wailing faintly.
Even those who had touched the threshold of sage rank, peak demi-sage rank powerhouses, could be shredded into nothingness at any moment if they stepped into this place.
Even more terrifying was the fact that the entire arena space was slowly collapsing, like the final breath of a dying giant.
Once it shattered completely, both Faustus and Dustin would be buried here. Not even ashes would remain.
At this moment, the two supreme quasi-sages seemed to be standing above a ten-thousand-foot abyss, their lives hanging by a thread. Every step they took was like treading on the edge of a blade.
Danger was everywhere. It hid behind the opponent’s fist and lurked within the cracking void beneath their feet.
Death coiled tightly around them from every direction.
Daniel stared deeply at Dustin.
This was his first time seeing a Chaos Human of the same rank as himself.
After all, that human predecessor, Hyman, had long since stepped into the realm of Oracle-grade and become a legendary existence.
"The blood flowing in the bones of the Chaos Humans is, in the end, the same as ours."
Daniel lifted his chin slightly, a sharp glint flashing through his eyes.
Dustin was also carefully observing Faustus.
This was the ancestral human heavenly talent whom Lord Hyman had praised as someone "bearing the potential of a great Oracle-grade existence."
He knew that the man before him might very well be the most terrifying opponent he had encountered so far.
Strictly speaking, the two of them could be considered to share the same roots. Yet they could also be called strangers walking different paths.

After all, the Chaos Humans had left this universe far too long ago. Time, like a vast river, had washed everything beyond recognition. They had long since abandoned the universe where Earth resided and set foot on an entirely different road.
This connection was truly so tangled that it made one sigh.

The many powerhouses in the spectator stands, as well as those lofty Oracle-grade beings above, all thought for a moment that the two fighters were cautiously testing each other, neither daring to attack lightly.
They held their breath. The entire starry sky fell silent, as though even time itself had slowed down just to await the opening of this world-shaking battle.
"Faustus has finally entered the arena! My heart is about to leap out of my chest!"
"Holy Shit, Faustus! You’re our last hope!"
"All glory, all faith, everything is entrusted to you..."
At a certain moment, Faustus’s and Dustin’s gazes suddenly collided, bursting with invisible sparks.
Neither of them spoke.
Nor was there any need for words.
Everything would be spoken through iron and blood!
Rumble!
Faustus’s body suddenly expanded, transforming into a ten-thousand-meter giant whose head touched the firmament and whose feet stood upon the earth.
Ancient golden patterns surfaced across his skin.
That was the Titan Body burning!
At the same time, he waved his great hand, and ninety-nine clones stepped out from the void. Every single one of them looked exactly like him.
Each clone activated the Divine-grade secret art known as Titan Body, as though ninety-nine blazing suns had risen at once.
"Sacred Runes!"
Dustin let out a low shout. Two ancient sacred patterns appeared in his pupils.
As light flowed and shifted, totemic pillars and sacred steles condensed out of thin air in the void, engraved with ancient vows and incantations.
"Microforce Judgment Sword Array!"

Four streaks of sword light descended in four directions. A sword array diagram unfolded in midair, and radiant sword light fell like crashing stars, sealing off the entire world with a thunderous force.
Daniel smiled coldly.
"Supreme Divine Domain: Chaotic Reincarnation!"
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
One hundred layers of Supreme Divine Domain unfolded at the same time, as though one hundred worlds had overlapped together.
One hundred pairs of enormous eyes opened from within the void. The qi of life and death flowed like endless rivers, releasing ancient chants.
"Sea of Elements!"
Nearly infinite elemental power transformed into a vast ocean. Towering waves surged up and swept toward Dustin.
The countless sword lights within the sword array clashed violently against the elemental ocean, like two seas devouring each other, neither able to gain the upper hand.

Just then, the life-and-death qi shooting out from those enormous eyes condensed into a massive black-and-white diagram. As it slowly rotated, it firmly suppressed the totemic pillars and sacred steles.
"You still have that silver ring."
Daniel suddenly spoke, his voice calm.
"I don’t believe you don’t have another trump card."
The corners of Dustin’s mouth lifted slightly.
That ring was a top-tier treasure among Divine-grade secret artifacts, a protective item specially bestowed upon him by the sages of the Chaos Humans. It had originally been his final trump card.
Daniel merely smiled.
He really did not have one.
Because with his own strength alone, he had already far surpassed anyone of the same rank.
He did not need external objects.
He himself was the strongest weapon!
Boom!

Daniel suddenly moved. His ninety-nine clones charged out at the same time, surrounding Dustin so tightly that not even water could pass through. Immediately afterward, a storm-like barrage of attacks descended.
Fist shadows fell like mountains. Sweeping kicks lashed out like dragons. Every strike was powerful enough to shatter a small asteroid.
Dustin’s hands moved rapidly, and his figure suddenly blurred.
Eight figures identical to him appeared out of thin air. Half were pitch-black as ink, while the other half were as pure white as snow.
But even so, he only had nine bodies in total.
Daniel, however, had one hundred!
Boom!
Daniel’s fist smashed heavily into Dustin’s cheek.
Half of Dustin’s face exploded on the spot. Crimson blood and shattered bone fragments sprayed outward, turning into a mist of blood in the void.
Boom!
Daniel kicked Dustin in the abdomen. The sound of ribs snapping inch by inch rang out clearly, like dry branches breaking apart.
Boom!
Dustin took another palm strike, and his entire body flew backward like a meteor.
His heart was filled with shock.
How did this Faustus seem to possess an inexhaustible, endless supply of Strength?
After such intense consumption, he could still maintain his peak state?
Even Dustin himself had already lost no small amount of blood essence and mind power.
Yet Faustus remained as ferocious as ever, as though he would never tire!

chapters.title: Chapter 302 -302-Dustin Is Blasted Onto the Back Foot
paragraphs: "His Strength is not only terrifying... it also seems inexhaustible."
Dustin’s heart sank. A chill shot straight up his spine and into the back of his skull.
This simply defied all reason!
Dustin clenched his teeth.
The silver ring on his finger suddenly lit up, erupting with dazzling radiance.
One ring became ten. Ten became a hundred. A hundred became a thousand. A thousand became ten thousand...

Layer upon layer, densely packed, they transformed into tens of thousands of silver rings. Like a silver torrent, they swept across the sky and surged toward the one hundred Daniels on the battlefield.
A Divine-grade secret treasure!
It was the very life-saving treasure that the saints of the Chaos Humans had specially bestowed upon Dustin. It should have been his final trump card.
Yet Dustin had never imagined that Daniel would be so ferocious, forcing him into an absolute disadvantage in the blink of an eye.
What terrifying combat power!
Steeling his heart, he activated this secret treasure ahead of time.
"Heh!"
Seeing the countless silver rings surging toward him like a tide, Daniel merely smiled faintly.
"I don’t have a Divine-grade secret treasure, but I have a hundred ways to defeat you."
A crazed look appeared in his eyes. It was an almost obsessive confidence.
"And I’m going to choose the most exhilarating one!"
He took a deep breath and said excitedly, "Dustin, you really are strong."
"No opponent has ever survived under my hands for more than three minutes."
He suddenly roared, "It’s time to end this!"
"Explode!"
The ninety-nine clones surrounding and attacking Dustin chose to self-destruct without the slightest hesitation.
Boom!
In that instant, Dustin felt the world spin around him, as if the entire universe had exploded beside his ears.
Boom!
Cracks in space spread in every direction like a spiderweb. Countless shards of the void shot outward like sharp blades.
Boom!
Countless rings were blasted apart and sent flying in all directions, falling into the abyss like birds with broken wings.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The aftermath of the explosion lingered for a long time. The entire arena space shook violently, on the verge of collapse, as if it would completely return to nothingness in the very next moment.
And Dustin’s figure had already been swallowed by that torrent of destruction!
Daniel’s own Strength was terrifying beyond measure, and the destructive power unleashed by the self-detonation of his clones was enough to tear stars apart.
The continuous explosions accelerated the collapse of the entire arena space, as if a dying beast was letting out its final howl.
As for how severely Dustin had been injured—
Those consecutive explosions had directly shattered his Immortal Icon.
The Divine-grade secret technique could no longer be maintained. His body was covered in dense cracks, like an ancient statue struck by lightning, ready to completely fall apart at any moment.
"How is this possible... How could he be this strong?!"
Stormy waves surged through Dustin’s heart.
He had originally thought that Daniel was merely slightly stronger than Harris.
But only now did he realize—
How was this merely "slightly stronger"?
The gap between them was like clouds and mud, like a heavenly chasm!
Especially that opponent’s Strength, which seemed endless and inexhaustible.
This was simply absurd!
The many methods Dustin was so proud of were more than enough to deal with the other nine-star powerhouses. Even Harris had been forced into desperate straits by them.
But against Daniel...

From beginning to end, Daniel had relied only on his unparalleled brute force. No matter how many profound techniques or clever tricks Dustin possessed, Daniel crushed them all with sheer overwhelming power!
In the spectator stands.
The spectators who witnessed this scene more or less breathed a sigh of relief.

This was especially true for the master of Starvault Sanctum and the Oracle-grade existences of the various major starfields. The hearts that had been hanging in their throats finally settled back down.
Although they were existences standing at the peak of this universe, if their own starfield lost all dignity in such a grand event, that would still be an unbearable humiliation.
And Faustus had indeed used his fists to hold up the last shred of face for everyone.
Chanelle, in particular, could hardly conceal his excitement. His eyes erupted with blazing light.
"He did it! He really did it!"
It was as if stars were burning in Chanelle’s eyes.
"The powerhouse from the Chaosverse suppressed all the contestants from our universe, and Faustus, in turn, suppressed that Chaosverse powerhouse with absolute Strength!"
He had already made up his mind.
With this battle alone, he would be able to fight for the highest newcomer treatment from a gold-grade divine mountain on Faustus’s behalf!
He wanted to recommend Faustus to join a gold-grade divine mountain—
Even though formal members of gold-grade divine mountains would never accept anyone who was not a Divine-grade powerhouse.
But rules existed precisely to be broken!
"Faustus is absolutely worth having a gold-grade divine mountain pour all its resources into nurturing him."
Chanelle was even looking further ahead.

With the karmic connection formed today, once Faustus ascended to the position of a great Oracle-grade existence in the future, Chanelle’s own status within the gold-grade divine mountain would naturally rise along with him.
"Sigh..."
The Oracle-grade existence from the Samuel Starfield looked at Faustus with eyes full of jealousy.
For a fleeting instant, he had dearly wished that Faustus would be defeated by Dustin.
That way, he could claim that it was not that the contestants of their universe were incompetent, but that Dustin was simply too powerful.
However, Faustus’s strength had already reached a despair-inducing level. His radiance could no longer be concealed.
Harris stood there in a daze, his eyes hollow as he stared at that figure and murmured,
"Faustus..."
"As expected, Boss is a monster."
James and Mosi both sighed in admiration. There was no longer the slightest trace of dissatisfaction in their eyes.
"Damn it."
Watching this scene, Silas was left with nothing but irrepressible jealousy in his heart.
And just then—
Daniel waved his hand once more, and ninety-nine clones stepped out from the void, surrounding Dustin completely.
The dense mass of figures blotted out the sky and covered the sun, like an army.
Dustin raised his head, stubbornly meeting Daniel’s eyes. His battle intent had not diminished in the slightest.
"So, if you have any more methods, use them."
Daniel’s voice was deep and firm.
He did not believe it.
The strongest quasi-sage of the Chaosverse, this unparalleled prodigy who could create his own Divine-grade secret technique, could not possibly be limited to this.
Dustin had suffered a tremendous loss.
Daniel’s Immortal Icon was on the same level as Dustin’s.
But the outrageous part was that Daniel had also mastered Titan Body at the same level!
Moreover, all of his clones possessed ninety percent of the original body’s strength.
A single Daniel was already enough to crush any powerhouse of the same Rank, and now there were ninety-nine such Daniels!
Even more terrifying was the fact that Daniel’s Strength seemed inexhaustible. Every strike carried destructive might capable of annihilating heaven and earth.
Even someone as powerful as Dustin had been beaten dizzy and forced to retreat again and again.
On the battlefield, aside from Daniel and Dustin, who both knew perfectly well about the distant connection between them, none of the other powerhouses knew anything.
They only regarded Daniel as the most dazzling blazing sun nurtured by this universe.
Dustin’s battle intent did not fade.
"Faustus, let us fight to our hearts’ content!"
Dustin brought his hands together, his ten fingers leaving behind a blur of afterimages.
Suddenly, his entire body glowed with resplendent golden light. At the same time, his Divine Domain quietly unfolded.
"Divine Domain?"
Daniel’s eyes flickered.
"So Chaos Humans also possess Divine Domains?"
Dustin’s Divine Domain slowly spread out, and three towering sacred icons emerged within the void.

The first icon on the left was the image of a six-winged warrior burning with golden flames. He held a blazing longsword in each hand, his eyes wide with fury, and his entire body exuded a pressure that made the soul tremble.
This was the Aspect of Sacred Wrath.
The second was the image of a holy knight clad in heavy armor and holding a massive shield. The surface of the shield was carved with ancient guardian runes, making it seem utterly impregnable.
This was the Aspect of the Eternal Bastion.
The third...
Daniel’s pupils suddenly contracted!

Even more terrifying was the fact that Daniel’s Strength seemed inexhaustible.
Every strike carried destructive might capable of annihilating heaven and earth.
Even someone as powerful as Dustin had been beaten dizzy and forced to retreat again and again.
On the battlefield, aside from Daniel and Dustin, who both knew perfectly well about the distant connection between them, none of the other powerhouses knew anything.
They only regarded Daniel as the most dazzling blazing sun nurtured by this universe.
Dustin’s battle intent did not fade.
"Faustus, let us fight to our hearts’ content!"
Dustin brought his hands together, his ten fingers leaving behind a blur of afterimages.
Suddenly, his entire body glowed with resplendent golden light.
At the same time, his Divine Domain quietly unfolded.
"Divine Domain?"
Daniel’s eyes flickered.
"So Chaos Humans also possess Divine Domains?"
Dustin’s Divine Domain slowly spread out, and three towering sacred icons emerged within the void.
The first icon on the left was the image of a six-winged warrior burning with golden flames.
He held a blazing longsword in each hand, his eyes wide with fury, and his entire body exuded a pressure that made the soul tremble.
This was the Aspect of Sacred Wrath.
The second was the image of a holy knight clad in heavy armor and holding a massive shield.
The surface of the shield was carved with ancient guardian runes, making it seem utterly impregnable.
This was the Aspect of the Eternal Bastion.
The third...
Daniel’s pupils suddenly contracted!

chapters.title: Chapter 303 -303-Two Top-Tier Human Prodigies!
paragraphs: Upon that third sacred icon, Daniel sensed two completely opposite yet perfectly unified auras of law!
Destruction and creation. Death and rebirth!
It was the product of the fusion between the Sanctum Sigil secret art and a Divine Domain. This was precisely the path of fusion that the Chaos Humans excelled at most.

It was a sacred icon split clearly into black and white. The left side was pitch-black as ink, with blood-red eyes burning with violent flames. Its fangs were exposed, and destructive shadows coiled around its entire body.
The right side was white as snow, its features compassionate, radiating a holy and warm light!
Darkness and light gathered within one body. Life and death intertwined as one.
This was the Aspect of Twilight Judgment.
"Aspect of Twilight Judgment!"
Dustin’s hand seals suddenly stopped. The third sacred icon descended with a thunderous force and fused with his body.
Dustin’s body transformed drastically along with it.
Half of his face became black as the abyss, filled with evil and brutality. The other half became holy as fresh snow, full of compassion and serenity.
At this moment, he seemed to have transformed into both angel and demon at the same time. Righteousness and evil coexisted within him, reaching a strange balance.
"This is the sacred art of my Chaos Humans, a technique that stands equal to the Apocalypse Sanctum Sigil."
Dustin’s voice rang out like a great bell.
"Fight!"
Before his words had even faded, Dustin charged toward Daniel’s clone like a meteor.
Daniel’s clone met him head-on without fear.
The moment they clashed, Daniel immediately sensed that Dustin was now worlds apart from before.
Previously, although Dustin’s Strength through the Immortal Icon had been formidable, it still fell somewhat short against Daniel, who was practically cheating.
After all, Daniel’s MP was immensely vast, almost inexhaustible. Every strike he unleashed carried deadly destructive power.
In terms of foundation, even Harris at his peak was like a tiny stream before a vast ocean when compared to Daniel.
Dustin was likewise unable to compare.
And yet, at this moment, with the blessing of the sacred icon, Dustin was actually even stronger than when he had activated the Immortal Icon.

Daniel’s Divine Domain was currently entangled with Dustin’s Sanctum Sigil totems and holy steles, while also resisting many of Dustin’s other methods. For the moment, neither side could decide the outcome.
Right now, Daniel could only rely on his own strength to clash head-on with Dustin.
Even so, Dustin still found it extremely difficult to deal with Daniel, and he was forced back again and again!
"Aspect of Sacred Wrath!"
Dustin roared.
The first sacred icon within his Divine Domain descended with a thunderous rumble and blessed his body.
In an instant, Dustin’s attack power rose by another level. With every movement of his hands and feet, space shook violently, as if it might collapse at any moment.
Daniel refused to show weakness. His clone attacked with wide, sweeping movements, focusing only on offense and abandoning all defense.
The two figures were like ancient gods of war reborn. Every strike carried power capable of destroying heaven and earth.
The two supreme powerhouses fought until the sky darkened and the earth seemed to collapse within that already shattered space.
The secret realm space had now been beaten into utter ruin. Everywhere were pitch-black cracks and endless nothingness.
The entire space teetered on the edge of collapse at every moment.
In the spectator stands.
The watching powerhouses were all shaken to the core.
James and Mosi, in particular, were deeply shocked. They felt sincere admiration for Dustin’s strength.

They knew very well that Daniel’s power was anything but ordinary. For Dustin to fight Daniel back and forth like this, even while remaining at a disadvantage the entire time, was already terrifying enough!
"That space can barely hold on anymore. This battle is insane!"
"As expected, Faustus is still stronger. Harris was ultimately not enough, and even Dustin isn’t enough either."
"I just want to know, when we’re all quasi-sages, why is the gap between us and them so huge?"
"Have you noticed? Both of them are humans! Humans are only a quasi-first-rate race in the Endless Starfield. They’re still far from the truly top-tier races."
"And these Chaos Humans are only ranked in the top three among the human branches. How did they cultivate a monster like Dustin?"
"And Faustus from our universe’s human race is also a monster among monsters. Could it be that the human race is about to rise?"
Just then, the master of Starvault Sanctum suddenly made a move.
Buzz!
The space of the first arena, which had been on the verge of collapse, immediately stabilized. It rapidly restored itself at a visible speed, and another layer of protection was reinforced around it.
Daniel and Dustin’s fierce battle continued, but they no longer shattered space with every casual exchange.
"Divine-grade secret arts. Not bad."
Daniel suddenly spoke, his tone calm.
"Dustin, have you ever been blown up before?"
Dustin froze slightly, and his offensive immediately slowed.
Daniel grinned, then suddenly shouted, "Explode!"
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
Rumble!
Dustin’s expression changed drastically on the spot.
"Wait, you...?"
A bitter look appeared on his face.
"Aspect of the Eternal Bastion!"
Dustin decisively drew down the second sacred icon within his Divine Domain and blessed his body with it.
Boom!
Boom! Boom!
Daniel’s clones self-destructed one after another.
Daniel directly detonated all ninety-nine clones in one go. Then, in the next instant, he summoned them again and made them self-destruct once more!
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The space that the master of Starvault Sanctum had just repaired and reinforced was shattered again in the blink of an eye!
Fragments of space scattered in all directions. Large swaths of space broke apart like glass mirrors, collapsing into nothingness.
Even the powerhouses in the spectator stands felt a faint tremor!
The space connected to the arena was also shaken by the endless explosions and cracked apart one after another.
What a terrifying and shocking scene this was!
As for Dustin, who was at the very center of the explosions, blood was flowing all over his body.
"Faustus, you brat, you really are ruthless!"
Dustin gnashed his teeth, but an unyielding flame still burned in his eyes.
"Aspect of Twilight Judgment!"
He roared and fused the three sacred icons into one.
In an instant, his body became dazzling and translucent, glowing like crystal.
No matter how Daniel’s clones continued to self-destruct, they could no longer injure him in the slightest.
However, Dustin fell into a brief state of silence.
The Aspect of Twilight Judgment could almost be called an invincible body. Nothing below the peak of Divine-grade could break it.
But the price was the abandonment of all perception.
At this moment, the space where the two of them stood was once again blasted into ruins!
The master of Starvault Sanctum made another move to repair the space.
"These two are way too fierce!"
When the spectators saw the space shatter again, they were instantly rendered speechless.
"Dustin truly is incomparably powerful, almost omnipotent!"

"Judging only by his own foundation—Immortal Icon, the path of Sanctum Sigils, the sword array, the sacred art secretly passed down among the Chaos Humans, and that Divine-grade silver ring treasure—so many methods gathered in one body. It is simply breathtaking."
"But Faustus is much more crude and simple. It all comes down to one word: explode!"
"No matter how many methods you possess, he breaks them all with brute force and blows everything apart!"
At this moment, the many nine-star powerhouses present could truly be said to have broadened their horizons.
They had never seen peers as powerful as Faustus and Dustin.
Dustin was almost all-capable. Every path he walked had been pushed to the extreme of his Rank.
Faustus, on the other hand, was even more overbearing. No matter what sacred art you used, he only cared about blowing it up!
Had they not seen it with their own eyes, who could have believed that such terrifying young powerhouses existed in this world?
Without personally crossing hands with Faustus, one would never be able to understand his true terror.
At this moment, Dustin was like a lone boat amid raging waves. He had already been forced into a desperate situation.
If the battle continued, he would inevitably damage his Origin, and he might even fall!
Just then, a soft sigh drifted through the void, long and lingering.
"I’ve lost."
It was unmistakably Dustin’s voice.
Dustin had admitted defeat!

chapters.title: Chapter 304 -304-The Oracle-grade Transmission of Profound Mysteries
paragraphs: A faint smile curved Daniel’s lips as he looked at Dustin, whose face was filled with helplessness.
Dustin gave a bitter smile and shook his head.
He had already exhausted everything he had. Every method, every trump card, every last technique he had kept hidden at the bottom of his box—he had used them all.
And yet, against Daniel’s almost unsolvable self-destruction technique, he was utterly at a loss.

"Aspect of Twilight Judgment can withstand it for a while, but the consumption is simply too great. Once the holy idol dissipates, I will have no means left to resist. Faustus’s self-destruction is practically the descent of doomsday itself."
Dustin shook his head helplessly.
He had been proud all his life and had never bowed his head easily. As for personally admitting defeat, Faustus was the first person in his life to force him to do so.
Daniel had an old connection with the Chaos Humans, so naturally, he would not strike to kill.
Seeing Dustin concede, he stopped at once.

"My Crusader’s Physique still hasn’t been adjusted to its strongest state," Daniel thought to himself. "Crusader’s Physique is a battle Constitution born for slaughter. Until now, no one has ever forced out the full extent of my Strength... and Dustin can’t do it either."
The corners of his lips rose slightly.
"Faustus is actually this powerful!"
The awakened Udi, Silas who had been watching the battle, Cold Star, and the other powerhouses were all completely numb with shock.
Their understanding of Daniel’s terrifying strength had been renewed once again.
"As expected of Boss Faustus. He really is worthy of being our leader."
James and Mosi exchanged a smile.
They had always had confidence in Faustus, so at this moment, they were not surprised in the slightest.
Harris looked dazed as he muttered, "I poured all my Strength into that attack, yet I couldn’t even shake the hem of Dustin’s clothes!"
"But Faustus defeated him with just one move and forced him to bow his head and admit defeat... This is simply like a dream."

"The Canaan Starfield truly shines with countless Stellar lights. Heroes and geniuses are emerging one after another. In the next generation’s starfield struggle, how are we supposed to contend with them?"

An Oracle-grade from another starfield sighed as he gazed at Faustus’s spirited back. Then, thinking of rising talents like James and Mosi in the Canaan Starfield as well, he suddenly felt that the future was bleak.
In comparison, his own starfield could not even produce a single genius capable of standing beside them!
"If this continues, the future of our starfield may be far from optimistic... It is time to devote our full strength to cultivating the new generation."
The various Oracle-grades secretly gritted their teeth. Each of them began calculating that after returning, they had to advise their leaders on this matter.
The long-shelved plan to cultivate new stars had to be launched immediately.
The Oracle-grade from the Samuel Starfield wore a grave expression as he thought to himself.
"Although the backbone Strength of the major starfields consists of Divine-grade powerhouses, top-tier quasi-sages absolutely cannot be underestimated."

"My Samuel Starfield may be able to stand shoulder to shoulder with the Canaan Starfield in terms of the number of sages, but when it comes to the foundation of top-tier demi-sage ranks, we have already been left far behind... We must find a way to increase our starfield’s reserves of demi-sage rank talents. Otherwise, the future will be worrying."

If they could not surpass their rivals among the younger generation, then in the future balance of power between starfields, there would likely be no weight left for the other starfields to place on the scale!
Chanelle, however, was immensely gratified.

Although quasi-sages were like newborn fawns in the Endless Starsea, and only Divine-grade beings and existences above Divine-grade could be considered true powerhouses who had stepped into the star sea, top-tier quasi-sages were still far too rare.
Moreover, once such geniuses broke through, they could reach heights ordinary people could never hope to attain!
Therefore, every starfield’s top-tier demi-sage rank talents were treasures. Someone like Daniel was a treasure among treasures!
Budelica Oracle-grade swept his gaze over the many powerhouses before him, his expression relaxed.
Just now, he had truly been sweating for the contestants of his own universe.
Fortunately, Faustus had taken action and stabilized the situation, allowing the heart that had been hanging in his chest to finally settle.
"I hereby announce that the champion of this Starlight Rankings Tournament is..."
"Faustus!"
Budelica Oracle-grade’s voice entered the ears of every spectator.
Whoosh—!
The spectator stands instantly erupted.
"Glory to Faustus!"
"Faustus is invincible! This crown is truly deserved!"
"This victory came so swiftly... Such thunderous momentum will surely forge a legendary Chapter to be passed down through the ages!"
At this moment, the Oracle-grades from the various starfields all surged toward Chanelle, their mouths full of endless praise.
No one knew what they truly felt in their hearts, but at the very least, their faces were filled with respect and compliments.
"Congratulations! The Canaan Starfield has seized the crown!"
"Chanelle, you old fellow, I’m truly green with envy. Your starfield actually has an unparalleled genius like Faustus."
"Chanelle, Faustus possesses the potential to become a great Oracle-grade. The future of your starfield is truly promising!"
Chanelle smiled and nodded to them one by one, responding with calm composure.
At this moment, he had already received a secret message from the Golden Holy Mountain headquarters.
"Faustus’s treatment has already been finalized."
Chanelle was overjoyed. This message was like sweet rain descending at exactly the right moment.
He looked toward Faustus’s tall, upright figure, and the corners of his lips rose slightly.
This boy was about to soar into the heavens!
Some people sighed quietly. Some secretly clenched their fists. Others silently calculated how they should draw closer to Faustus in the future.
From this moment on, the eyes of this starry sky would gather more and more upon that rising new star.
Whoosh—!
The figure of the Lord of Starvault Sanctum appeared out of thin air on the high platform.
Budelica Oracle-grade bowed respectfully, then withdrew.
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum was a supreme powerhouse at Oracle-grade T8, the helmsman of the Budelica Starfield’s Starvault Sanctum.
For this tournament, he was both the organizer and the host.
Daniel and Dustin bowed to the Lord of Starvault Sanctum at the same time.
"Sanctum Lord."
"Your Excellency."
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum smiled and nodded. He swept an appreciative glance over Daniel before his gaze finally landed on Dustin.
"Dustin, how was it?"
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum smiled as he spoke.
Dustin gave a bitter smile. "I lost. I am sincerely convinced."
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum said warmly, "Winning and losing are minor matters. It is good that you were not injured. Go and rest first."
"Yes, Your Excellency."
Dustin answered respectfully. Then, with a meaningful glance at Daniel, he left on his own.
Since he had lost, he ought to leave the stage.
Only the true king was worthy of standing on the platform and receiving the cheers.
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum extended his hand. Two clusters of light appeared in his palm.
"Faustus, these are your rewards for winning the championship."

The Lord of Starvault Sanctum said, "Do not underestimate them just because there is only one Divine-grade secret treasure and one Divine-grade secret art. Both of these are the very best among the best, enough for you to use all the way until you reach the Oracle-grade realm."
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
If even the Lord of Starvault Sanctum personally called them supreme-quality items, then how heaven-defying must they be?
Whoosh—!
The clusters of light slowly flew toward Daniel.
Faustus reached out, and the two clusters of light landed lightly in his palm.
Seeing that he had accepted the rewards, the Lord of Starvault Sanctum spoke gently.
"Next, I will spend three days explaining the mysteries of the universe and my insights on advancement. How much you can gain from it will depend entirely on yourself."
He paused, then deliberately added, "The content I will speak on is the path of the sage rank."
"A lecture on the Dao? And personally delivered by a T8 Oracle-grade!"
When Daniel heard this, his eyes immediately shone with brilliance.
He knew that this was the Lord of Starvault Sanctum deliberately reminding him.
The path of the sage rank!
A quasi-sage only possessed a portion of the characteristics of the Divine-grade, while the most fundamental core of the Divine-grade was the sage rank.
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum had deliberately chosen to explain the path of the sage rank. It was clearly tailored for all the demi-sage rank powerhouses present.
This was simply an unexpected delight, and Daniel was naturally filled with anticipation.
"Thank you, Sanctum Lord."
After thanking him, Daniel returned to the seats of the Canaan Starfield.
He had only just sat down when Chanelle’s voice sounded beside his ear.
"Faustus, there is something I need to discuss with you!"

Moreover, once such geniuses broke through, they could reach heights ordinary people could never hope to attain!
Therefore, every starfield’s top-tier demi-sage rank talents were treasures.
Someone like Daniel was a treasure among treasures!
Budelica Oracle-grade swept his gaze over the many powerhouses before him, his expression relaxed.
Just now, he had truly been sweating for the contestants of his own universe.
Fortunately, Faustus had taken action and stabilized the situation, allowing the heart that had been hanging in his chest to finally settle.
"I hereby announce that the champion of this Starlight Rankings Tournament is..."
"Faustus!"
Budelica Oracle-grade’s voice entered the ears of every spectator.
Whoosh—!
The spectator stands instantly erupted.
"Glory to Faustus!"
"Faustus is invincible!
This crown is truly deserved!"
"This victory came so swiftly...
Such thunderous momentum will surely forge a legendary Chapter to be passed down through the ages!"
At this moment, the Oracle-grades from the various starfields all surged toward Chanelle, their mouths full of endless praise.
No one knew what they truly felt in their hearts, but at the very least, their faces were filled with respect and compliments.
"Congratulations!
The Canaan Starfield has seized the crown!"
"Chanelle, you old fellow, I’m truly green with envy.
Your starfield actually has an unparalleled genius like Faustus."
"Chanelle, Faustus possesses the potential to become a great Oracle-grade.
The future of your starfield is truly promising!"
Chanelle smiled and nodded to them one by one, responding with calm composure.
At this moment, he had already received a secret message from the Golden Holy Mountain headquarters.
"Faustus’s treatment has already been finalized."
Chanelle was overjoyed.
This message was like sweet rain descending at exactly the right moment.
He looked toward Faustus’s tall, upright figure, and the corners of his lips rose slightly.
This boy was about to soar into the heavens!
Some people sighed quietly.
Some secretly clenched their fists.
Others silently calculated how they should draw closer to Faustus in the future.
From this moment on, the eyes of this starry sky would gather more and more upon that rising new star.
Whoosh—!
The figure of the Lord of Starvault Sanctum appeared out of thin air on the high platform.
Budelica Oracle-grade bowed respectfully, then withdrew.
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum was a supreme powerhouse at Oracle-grade T8, the helmsman of the Budelica Starfield’s Starvault Sanctum.
For this tournament, he was both the organizer and the host.
Daniel and Dustin bowed to the Lord of Starvault Sanctum at the same time.
"Sanctum Lord."
"Your Excellency."
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum smiled and nodded.
He swept an appreciative glance over Daniel before his gaze finally landed on Dustin.
"Dustin, how was it?"
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum smiled as he spoke.
Dustin gave a bitter smile.
"I lost.
I am sincerely convinced."
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum said warmly, "Winning and losing are minor matters.
It is good that you were not injured.
Go and rest first."
"Yes, Your Excellency."
Dustin answered respectfully.
Then, with a meaningful glance at Daniel, he left on his own.
Since he had lost, he ought to leave the stage.
Only the true king was worthy of standing on the platform and receiving the cheers.
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum extended his hand.
Two clusters of light appeared in his palm.
"Faustus, these are your rewards for winning the championship."
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum said, "Do not underestimate them just because there is only one Divine-grade secret treasure and one Divine-grade secret art.
Both of these are the very best among the best, enough for you to use all the way until you reach the Oracle-grade realm."
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
If even the Lord of Starvault Sanctum personally called them supreme-quality items, then how heaven-defying must they be?
Whoosh—!
The clusters of light slowly flew toward Daniel.
Faustus reached out, and the two clusters of light landed lightly in his palm.
Seeing that he had accepted the rewards, the Lord of Starvault Sanctum spoke gently.
"Next, I will spend three days explaining the mysteries of the universe and my insights on advancement.
How much you can gain from it will depend entirely on yourself."
He paused, then deliberately added, "The content I will speak on is the path of the sage rank."
"A lecture on the Dao?
And personally delivered by a T8 Oracle-grade!"
When Daniel heard this, his eyes immediately shone with brilliance.
He knew that this was the Lord of Starvault Sanctum deliberately reminding him.
The path of the sage rank!
A quasi-sage only possessed a portion of the characteristics of the Divine-grade, while the most fundamental core of the Divine-grade was the sage rank.
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum had deliberately chosen to explain the path of the sage rank.
It was clearly tailored for all the demi-sage rank powerhouses present.
This was simply an unexpected delight, and Daniel was naturally filled with anticipation.
"Thank you, Sanctum Lord."
After thanking him, Daniel returned to the seats of the Canaan Starfield.
He had only just sat down when Chanelle’s voice sounded beside his ear.
"Faustus, there is something I need to discuss with you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 305 -305-Golden Holy Mountain’s Invitation and Treatment
paragraphs: "Faustus, there is something I need to discuss with you!"
There was sincerity in Chanelle’s voice.
Daniel raised his brows slightly and blinked, already having a rough guess in his heart.
"Please speak, Your Excellency."
Chanelle said, "I specifically contacted Golden Holy Mountain on your behalf and applied for you to obtain the status of an official member."
"Now, I have already received their reply—as long as you are willing to join Golden Holy Mountain..."
Chanelle placed extra emphasis on his next words.
"We will grant you the treatment of a peak Divine-grade powerhouse."

Earth was located within Canaan Starfield. Aetheria was also located within Canaan Starfield. As the most powerful faction in Canaan Starfield, Golden Holy Mountain naturally had deep connections with Daniel.
Every starfield had at least a few powerful factions, more or less. Daniel could not simply bury his head and develop alone. He also needed to strengthen his own forces.
Joining Golden Holy Mountain seemed to be the best choice.
Chanelle had already laid out his sincerity before Daniel. All that remained was for Daniel to nod.
However, faced with Golden Holy Mountain’s recruitment, Daniel did not agree immediately.
"What exactly does the treatment of a peak Divine-grade powerhouse include?"
Chanelle was extremely patient with Daniel.

"Golden Holy Mountain’s treatment has always been among the most generous in the entire star sea. Originally, only those who had stepped into Divine-grade were qualified to join. The fact that you can enter by exception has already broken an iron rule that has lasted for tens of millions of years."
He paused for a moment, then continued.

"The treatment for Divine-grade powerhouses is divided into three tiers. Your tier is the highest one. It includes a granted territory, fixed advancement resources, a pass to enter Ivahpin World, limited-time qualifications to enter high-resource secret realms and dangerous lands, a generous initial sum of points, and extremely high organizational authority."
"In short, everything a peak Divine-grade powerhouse can enjoy, you will not be missing a single thing."
Daniel pondered for a moment.
Why did one need to enter a major faction?
Because in the Endless Starsea, all rare resources were firmly held in the hands of major factions.
If Daniel was not a member of Golden Holy Mountain, he would not even have the qualifications to set foot in those secret realms, forbidden lands, or treasure grounds.
If he barged in without permission, he would probably be expelled on the spot by a group of Oracle-grade powerhouses before he could even touch the edge of the place!
Moreover, how could one person painstakingly accumulating foundations alone compare to the resources countless powerhouses had built up over the course of endless years?
After joining Golden Holy Mountain, he would only need to spend points to obtain resources that had been accumulated for countless ages.
Was this not twice the result with half the effort?
"Thank you, Your Excellency Chanelle. I am willing to join Golden Holy Mountain," Daniel replied solemnly.
He knew very well that he had not yet reached Divine-grade and was originally not qualified to join. The fact that he could be accepted by exception was entirely due to Chanelle’s strong support.
Chanelle was a T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse. Even within a colossal existence like Golden Holy Mountain, he was a high-ranking expert who possessed extremely great authority.
The fact that Daniel could break the rules so smoothly was all thanks to Chanelle’s full support from behind the scenes!
When Chanelle heard that Daniel was willing to join, he was overjoyed.

He was already one of the few T7 powerhouses within Golden Holy Mountain with the greatest hope of breaking through to T8 Oracle-grade. He had always liked discovering promising juniors, and his influence within Golden Holy Mountain was deeply rooted.
Now, with Daniel joining him, it was like adding wings to a tiger!
At the very least, in terms of talent reserves, his branch had already surpassed his other rivals.
"You will not be disappointed, Faustus," Chanelle said happily. "Once Starvault Lord finishes this explanation of profundities, I will personally take you to Golden Holy Mountain’s headquarters."
Daniel did not resist joining Golden Holy Mountain.
That was because Angel, a T6 Oracle-grade powerhouse of Golden Holy Mountain, had once shown him goodwill.
Back when Daniel fought his way into the God Realm, Angel had clearly favored him somewhat. That had always left Daniel with a good impression of Golden Holy Mountain.
"Let’s first see what that Divine-grade secret treasure and that Divine-grade secret art actually are."
Taking advantage of the fact that Starvault Lord had not yet begun his explanation, Daniel took out the rewards.
[Ding! You have obtained the special item [Voidbound Grail] (Divine-grade)!]
Faustus looked at the ball of light in his hand.
Radiance flowed within the light. After he injected energy into it, the ball of light rippled like water, slowly condensing into an ancient-looking holy grail.

The body of the cup was forged from some unknown dark silver metal. Its surface was engraved with countless fine patterns resembling star trajectories and spatial cracks.幽blue light flowed along the rim of the cup, as though infinite Strength was sleeping within it.
[Voidbound Grail]
Status: Unactivated
Condition: Sealed
Grade: Divine-grade Secret Treasure (Primordial)
Effect: After use, this treasure can be controlled to perform three special operations: [Void Lock], [Limit Break], and [Seal].
[Void Lock]: Can seal the current space. The range depends on the user’s mind power.
[Limit Break]: Can allow the user to break through the current state of Void Lock, sealing, suppression, and similar restraints.
[Seal]: Can completely suppress targets whose strength is lower than the user’s, and can also weaken targets whose strength is higher than the user’s to a certain extent.

Introduction: The Voidbound Grail is a top-grade treasure among Divine-grade secret treasures. Having been baptized by a mysterious Strength, this cup contains a complete cosmic Origin will and complete spacetime laws. This cup is an extremely rare spacetime-type secret treasure specialized in breaking restrictions and sealing. Its preciousness is immeasurable.
Activation Condition: Activating this secret treasure requires it to devour one Primordial Grade treasure.
Description: Divine-grade secret treasures are divided, from low to high, into ordinary, Master Grade, Sacred Artisan Grade, Sacred Artisan Law Grade, Primordial Grade, and Primordial Law Grade.

Divine-grade secret treasures are forged by Oracle-grade beings using their own authority and special Sacred Materials. Their power and grade depend on the Sacred Materials used and the strength of the refiner.

The materials used for secret treasures below Primordial Grade are all things that exist in the mortal world, while the materials used for Primordial Grade and above are Origin substances from the beginning of the universe.
Law secret treasures contain the power of laws. Their holders can use them to grasp the laws within.
After Daniel finished reading the introduction, he put the holy grail into his backpack.
"So there are actually this many classifications within Divine-grade secret treasures."
Only now did he understand why Starvault Lord had said that this treasure was top-grade.
Any treasure related to spacetime was top-grade.
Spacetime was the ultimate Great Dao of the Endless Starsea. This was an eternal and unchanging truth.
Even among Primordial Grade Divine-grade secret treasures, this holy grail belonged to the very top!
Daniel took a deep breath, and a wave of pleasant surprise surged in his heart.
He turned his gaze toward the ball of light that represented the secret art.
"I wonder just how exceptional this item is."
He looked toward that secret art.
[Ding! You have obtained the Sacred Art [Celestial Grasp] (Oracle-grade)!]
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
A Sacred Art!
[Celestial Grasp]
Grade: Oracle-grade

Effect: When this Sacred Art is activated, the caster’s palm will transform into a miniature Astral Realm vortex. Within it, stars revolve and galaxies spiral, as though a newborn universe is breathing in the palm of the caster’s hand.
The caster can pour all of their accumulated divine power, Immortal Singularity, and even law fragments into this Astral Realm in their palm.
The power of the Astral Realm has no upper limit!
Description: Laws cannot be formed into written words, melodies, or talismans. Sacred Arts, however, are simplified versions of laws. They can be recorded through various means and passed down.
Note: The grades of Sacred Arts are divided according to their power. Above Divine-grade is Oracle-grade, and above Oracle-grade are Sacred Radiance, Sacred Venerable, Sacred Lord...

chapters.title: Chapter 306 -306-The Invitation, and the Human Ancestor’s Concern
paragraphs: Daniel blinked, then immediately learned the Sacred Art.
[Ding! You have learned the Sacred Art [Celestial Grasp]!]

"The threshold for this Sacred Art is extremely high. It requires a tremendous amount of energy to fill it. Even if an ordinary quasi-sage obtained it, they would find it difficult to control. But it is extremely suitable for me."
Daniel pondered silently.
His greatest strength lay in his boundless foundation, and this Sacred Art could store his energy within it. Once activated, he could freely control its eruption. This was simply perfect!
Its power was no weaker than using a clone to self-destruct.
Just then, another system notification sounded beside Daniel’s ear.
[Ding! You have obtained the reward for this mission!]
[Ding! You have obtained the [Scroll of Astral Prosperity] (Rare).]
Daniel raised his brows.
Rare items had no grade divisions, so naturally, they could not be boosted by the Millionfold Boost either. After all, they had no lower limit, and they had no upper limit.
Daniel took out the item.
[Scroll of Astral Prosperity] (Rare)
Type: Bound
User: Faustus
Grade: Rare
Effect: A pass for entering and exiting the Astral Realm. The holder of this scroll may enter the Astral Realm without obstruction.

Description: The number of these scrolls is limited. In each era of the Endless Starsea, only seven exist. Only those blessed by the Goddess of Fortune may obtain one. The holder may freely travel through the Astral Realm.
[Astral Realm]: Star systems that are about to be born but have not yet fully taken shape are collectively known as Astral Realms.

Because an Astral Realm is on the verge of formation, it will condense supreme Sacred Materials on the level of Primordial Law Grade treasures, foundations of laws manifested from countless profundities, as well as various Primordial Grade treasure lands. It possesses an extremely rare and supreme space for advancement.
The birth of an Astral Realm is extraordinarily rare.
Generally speaking, only after the lifespan of a star system reaches its end and it completely perishes will there be a chance for an Astral Realm to be born after another million years.
From the birth of that newborn world to its final stabilization, the time left to all beings is merely a short span of one hundred years.
After one hundred years, once the Astral Realm fully takes shape, even someone holding a Scroll of Astral Prosperity will no longer be able to enter it freely.

Regarding the Scroll of Astral Prosperity, ancient records described it as follows: this item was personally forged by an eternal sage-rank supreme powerhouse. Even an existence of eternal sage-rank cannot increase its number.
However, the next lower-tier item, the [Scroll of Radiant Stars], has slightly looser restrictions on quantity.
Although it is similarly rare, it can also be used to enter the Astral Realm. However, the holder can only linger around the outer region of the Astral Realm, and there is a time limit.
Faustus carefully finished reading these records, and his heart surged with emotion.
The Scroll of Astral Prosperity... was actually this precious!

Especially an existence like the Astral Realm—unless a star system’s lifespan naturally came to an end, turning it into dead silence, and then another million long years passed, there would only then be a chance for an entirely new star system to be born.
And this newborn world would actually exist for merely one hundred years!

One had to know that in the Endless Starsea, it was very common for supreme-grade powerhouses to live for tens of thousands of years, and it was not strange for Divine-grade powerhouses to exist for hundreds of thousands of years.
To them, a hundred years was nothing more than the blink of an eye.
Precisely because of that, grasping this hundred-year opportunity was all the more precious.
The Astral Realm was undoubtedly an incomparably rare existence.
"With the Scroll of Astral Prosperity, it is equivalent to obtaining the key to enter the Astral Realm."
Daniel put the scroll away.
After counting all the gains from this trip, he felt utterly refreshed.
Both the Divine-grade secret treasure and the Sacred Art were top-grade. The Scroll of Astral Prosperity was even something that could only be encountered by chance and not sought after.
The harvest from this trip was truly enormous.
Only then did Daniel turn his gaze toward the tournament grounds.
The arenas that had previously been divided into several independent spaces had now been restored to their original state.
The powerhouses of Budelica Starfield were busily arranging the venue.
An Oracle-grade powerhouse’s transmission of mysteries was an extremely particular matter, especially when that powerhouse was a T8 Oracle-grade!

Countless Divine-grade powerhouses were rushing about, laying the ground with top-grade Sacred Materials, decorating the surroundings with rare spiritual flowers and spiritual trees. There were even Divine-grade powerhouses individually using their Immortal Singularities to give rise to all kinds of rare, top-grade items.
Just then, Dustin’s voice sounded beside Daniel’s ear.
"Daniel."
"Dustin, is something the matter?"
Dustin’s voice was calm, and even carried a trace of closeness.

"Before I left the Chaosverse, His Excellency Hyman specifically instructed me to pay attention to your existence. He said that you possess the potential of a great Oracle-grade being. Although we Chaos Humans have left this homeland for far, far too long, the homeland still remains here. It needs you to protect it."
"I also benefited greatly from this battle with you."
Dustin chuckled softly.
"In the past, I was far too arrogant. It was your appearance that made me wake up."
Daniel blinked, then also smiled.
"My battle with you also broadened my horizons and allowed me to understand just how vast the Endless Starsea truly is."
"You joined Golden Holy Mountain?"
Dustin suddenly asked.
Daniel’s thoughts shifted, and he probed, "Do the Chaos Humans also want me to join them?"
"Don’t overthink it."
Dustin hurriedly explained, "We exist in different universes. If we made you join the Chaos Humans, it would bring you no benefit, and it would bring no benefit to the homeland either."
Daniel nodded slightly.
The Chaosverse and the current universe were, after all, two independent universes.
Between the two great universes, slaughter and conflict often broke out over the struggle for benefits.
There was a tacit understanding between Daniel and the Chaos Humans—the Chaos Humans would not ask him to join them. They would only show goodwill.
Daniel had chosen Golden Holy Mountain, while also maintaining goodwill toward the Chaos Humans.
Otherwise, Dustin would never have been able to leave alive after fighting him.
If Daniel unleashed the full power of his Crusader’s Physique, then even if Dustin was not killed on the spot, he would still undoubtedly die.
"Then what is this about?" Daniel asked in confusion.
"It is like this..."

Dustin slowly explained, "You share a bloodline connection with us Chaos Humans. I came here under the ancestor’s orders. Aside from participating in the tournament, there is one other matter—I am here to invite you to go to the Astral Realm together!"
What?
The Astral Realm!
Daniel was slightly stunned.
An ultimate secret realm like the Astral Realm—and Dustin was actually inviting him to go there together?
"You possess a Scroll of Astral Prosperity?" Daniel asked.
"How could a treasure like that be something I am qualified to possess?"
Dustin smiled and shook his head.
"The Scroll of Astral Prosperity is extremely rare and extremely miraculous. It can even recognize its master on its own. Unless one is a child of fortune, they can forget about obtaining it!"
"I do not have that kind of treasure, but I do have a Scroll of Radiant Stars."

Dustin said, "The Scroll of Radiant Stars can also grant passage into the Astral Realm, and it is relatively easier to obtain. This time, I brought two scrolls with me. One of them is something the ancestor entrusted me to give to you."
"Then I truly must thank you. Please convey my gratitude to the ancestor on my behalf!"
Aside from being shocked, Daniel was also deeply touched.
Separated by two great universes, that human ancestor was actually still thinking of him, and had even gone so far as to take out an entry pass to the Astral Realm for him!
He did not reveal the fact that he had already obtained a Scroll of Astral Prosperity.
He had originally known that the Scroll of Astral Prosperity was extremely rare, but he had not expected it to be rare to such an extent.
He was worried that once this news was exposed, it would attract the covetous eyes of great Oracle-grade beings.

Although he had Golden Holy Mountain as a backer in the current universe and did not fear a great Oracle-grade being launching a sneak attack from the shadows, what if the Astral Realm was located in another universe, beyond Golden Holy Mountain’s reach?
Therefore, he had to act with discretion.
"Easy enough. Once the matters here come to an end, I will give you the Scroll of Radiant Stars and explain the details of the Astral Realm clearly to you," Dustin said solemnly.
This time, he had come carrying two missions.
The first was to participate in the tournament.
The second was to invite Daniel to go to the Astral Realm together.
Therefore, no matter how fiercely they had fought to the death during the competition, Dustin had never harbored killing intent toward Daniel.
Of course, even if he had harbored killing intent, it would have been useless.
Daniel’s strength was far above his!
