Rare items had no grade divisions, so naturally, they could not be boosted by the Millionfold Boost either.
After all, they had no lower limit, and they had no upper limit.
Daniel took out the item.
[Scroll of Astral Prosperity] (Rare)
Type: Bound
User: Faustus
Grade: Rare
Effect: A pass for entering and exiting the Astral Realm.
The holder of this scroll may enter the Astral Realm without obstruction.
Description: The number of these scrolls is limited.
In each era of the Endless Starsea, only seven exist.
Only those blessed by the Goddess of Fortune may obtain one.
The holder may freely travel through the Astral Realm.
[Astral Realm]: Star systems that are about to be born but have not yet fully taken shape are collectively known as Astral Realms.

Because an Astral Realm is on the verge of formation, it will condense supreme Sacred Materials on the level of Primordial Law Grade treasures, foundations of laws manifested from countless profundities, as well as various Primordial Grade treasure lands.
It possesses an extremely rare and supreme space for advancement.
The birth of an Astral Realm is extraordinarily rare.
Generally speaking, only after the lifespan of a star system reaches its end and it completely perishes will there be a chance for an Astral Realm to be born after another million years.
From the birth of that newborn world to its final stabilization, the time left to all beings is merely a short span of one hundred years.
After one hundred years, once the Astral Realm fully takes shape, even someone holding a Scroll of Astral Prosperity will no longer be able to enter it freely.
Regarding the Scroll of Astral Prosperity, ancient records described it as follows: this item was personally forged by an eternal sage-rank supreme powerhouse.
Even an existence of eternal sage-rank cannot increase its number.
However, the next lower-tier item, the [Scroll of Radiant Stars], has slightly looser restrictions on quantity.
Although it is similarly rare, it can also be used to enter the Astral Realm.
However, the holder can only linger around the outer region of the Astral Realm, and there is a time limit.
Faustus carefully finished reading these records, and his heart surged with emotion.
The Scroll of Astral Prosperity... was actually this precious!

Especially an existence like the Astral Realm—unless a star system’s lifespan naturally came to an end, turning it into dead silence, and then another million long years passed, there would only then be a chance for an entirely new star system to be born.
And this newborn world would actually exist for merely one hundred years!

One had to know that in the Endless Starsea, it was very common for supreme-grade powerhouses to live for tens of thousands of years, and it was not strange for Divine-grade powerhouses to exist for hundreds of thousands of years.
To them, a hundred years was nothing more than the blink of an eye.
Precisely because of that, grasping this hundred-year opportunity was all the more precious.
The Astral Realm was undoubtedly an incomparably rare existence.
"With the Scroll of Astral Prosperity, it is equivalent to obtaining the key to enter the Astral Realm."
Daniel put the scroll away.
After counting all the gains from this trip, he felt utterly refreshed.
Both the Divine-grade secret treasure and the Sacred Art were top-grade.
The Scroll of Astral Prosperity was even something that could only be encountered by chance and not sought after.
The harvest from this trip was truly enormous.
Only then did Daniel turn his gaze toward the tournament grounds.
The arenas that had previously been divided into several independent spaces had now been restored to their original state.
The powerhouses of Budelica Starfield were busily arranging the venue.
An Oracle-grade powerhouse’s transmission of mysteries was an extremely particular matter, especially when that powerhouse was a T8 Oracle-grade!
Countless Divine-grade powerhouses were rushing about, laying the ground with top-grade Sacred Materials, decorating the surroundings with rare spiritual flowers and spiritual trees.
There were even Divine-grade powerhouses individually using their Immortal Singularities to give rise to all kinds of rare, top-grade items.
Just then, Dustin’s voice sounded beside Daniel’s ear.
"Daniel."
"Dustin, is something the matter?"
Dustin’s voice was calm, and even carried a trace of closeness.
"Before I left the Chaosverse, His Excellency Hyman specifically instructed me to pay attention to your existence.
He said that you possess the potential of a great Oracle-grade being.
Although we Chaos Humans have left this homeland for far, far too long, the homeland still remains here.
It needs you to protect it."
"I also benefited greatly from this battle with you."
Dustin chuckled softly.
"In the past, I was far too arrogant.
It was your appearance that made me wake up."
Daniel blinked, then also smiled.
"My battle with you also broadened my horizons and allowed me to understand just how vast the Endless Starsea truly is."
"You joined Golden Holy Mountain?"
Dustin suddenly asked.
Daniel’s thoughts shifted, and he probed, "Do the Chaos Humans also want me to join them?"
"Don’t overthink it."
Dustin hurriedly explained, "We exist in different universes.
If we made you join the Chaos Humans, it would bring you no benefit, and it would bring no benefit to the homeland either."
Daniel nodded slightly.
The Chaosverse and the current universe were, after all, two independent universes.
Between the two great universes, slaughter and conflict often broke out over the struggle for benefits.
There was a tacit understanding between Daniel and the Chaos Humans—the Chaos Humans would not ask him to join them.
They would only show goodwill.
Daniel had chosen Golden Holy Mountain, while also maintaining goodwill toward the Chaos Humans.
Otherwise, Dustin would never have been able to leave alive after fighting him.
If Daniel unleashed the full power of his Crusader’s Physique, then even if Dustin was not killed on the spot, he would still undoubtedly die.
"Then what is this about?" Daniel asked in confusion.
"It is like this..."
Dustin slowly explained, "You share a bloodline connection with us Chaos Humans.
I came here under the ancestor’s orders.
Aside from participating in the tournament, there is one other matter—I am here to invite you to go to the Astral Realm together!"
What?
The Astral Realm!
Daniel was slightly stunned.
An ultimate secret realm like the Astral Realm—and Dustin was actually inviting him to go there together?
"You possess a Scroll of Astral Prosperity?" Daniel asked.
"How could a treasure like that be something I am qualified to possess?"
Dustin smiled and shook his head.
"The Scroll of Astral Prosperity is extremely rare and extremely miraculous.
It can even recognize its master on its own.
Unless one is a child of fortune, they can forget about obtaining it!"
"I do not have that kind of treasure, but I do have a Scroll of Radiant Stars."
Dustin said, "The Scroll of Radiant Stars can also grant passage into the Astral Realm, and it is relatively easier to obtain.
This time, I brought two scrolls with me.
One of them is something the ancestor entrusted me to give to you."
"Then I truly must thank you.
Please convey my gratitude to the ancestor on my behalf!"
Aside from being shocked, Daniel was also deeply touched.
Separated by two great universes, that human ancestor was actually still thinking of him, and had even gone so far as to take out an entry pass to the Astral Realm for him!
He did not reveal the fact that he had already obtained a Scroll of Astral Prosperity.
He had originally known that the Scroll of Astral Prosperity was extremely rare, but he had not expected it to be rare to such an extent.
He was worried that once this news was exposed, it would attract the covetous eyes of great Oracle-grade beings.

Although he had Golden Holy Mountain as a backer in the current universe and did not fear a great Oracle-grade being launching a sneak attack from the shadows, what if the Astral Realm was located in another universe, beyond Golden Holy Mountain’s reach?
Therefore, he had to act with discretion.
"Easy enough.
Once the matters here come to an end, I will give you the Scroll of Radiant Stars and explain the details of the Astral Realm clearly to you," Dustin said solemnly.
This time, he had come carrying two missions.
The first was to participate in the tournament.
The second was to invite Daniel to go to the Astral Realm together.
Therefore, no matter how fiercely they had fought to the death during the competition, Dustin had never harbored killing intent toward Daniel.
Of course, even if he had harbored killing intent, it would have been useless.
Daniel’s strength was far above his!

chapters.title: Chapter 307 -307-The Voice of the Oracle, the Covenant of the Stars
paragraphs: No one knew how Daniel was feeling.

At this moment, an irrepressible excitement was surging in his heart—he had only just obtained the Scroll of Astral Prosperity, and now an opportunity to go to the Astral Realm had arrived right after it!
This was simply a gift from fate!
The Astral Realm contained countless supreme treasures, and even law treasures that carried the rules of the universe.
Those were all the most top-tier materials for constructing a sage rank.
Daniel had already tasted the benefits of a supreme Divine Domain. How could he possibly endure an ordinary sage rank?
If he wanted to break through to Divine-grade, then he had to use the finest materials to forge his sage rank!
And all of those things could be found in the Astral Realm!
Daniel was in an excellent mood.
At this moment, the Lord of Starvault Sanctum had already taken his place and was about to begin transmitting his insights.
Daniel was filled with anticipation. He hoped that from the mouth of this T8 Oracle-grade being, he would be able to gain some unexpected comprehension.
"What exactly will this kind of transmission of profundities be like?"
He secretly wondered in his heart.
The tournament grounds on the Budelica Plane had already been transformed into a sacred preaching platform.
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum, a T8 Oracle-grade being, would personally ascend the stage and begin his lecture, transmitting myriad profundities.
All those present were rising star powerhouses from various factions, and their hearts were as firm as stone.
Faced with this once-in-a-thousand-years opportunity, every powerhouse present was brimming with energy, concentrating their minds as they waited.
The transmission of a T8 Oracle-grade powerhouse would be greatly beneficial even to T7 Oracle-grade beings.

In the realm of Oracle-grade, even a single tier of difference was like the gap between heaven and earth. The distance between them was countless times greater than the difference between a human and an ant.
At this moment, the Lord of Starvault Sanctum sat cross-legged in the void.

Beneath him, sacred flowers and sacred grasses shone brilliantly. Spiritual trees and spiritual stones reflected one another’s radiance. Above the firmament, all kinds of auspicious phenomena appeared, as though the entire world was tilting its ear to listen.
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum slowly opened his mouth. His voice was like a great bell and a clear chime, cleansing the hearts of all who heard it.
Although Daniel could not fully understand what he was hearing, he still listened with his full attention.
System notifications rang repeatedly beside his ear.
[Ding! You are listening to the Oracle. Divine energy +10,000!]
[Ding! You are listening to the Oracle. Divine energy +10,000!]

Because of the existence of his amplification system, Daniel did not need to rely on long years of bitter cultivation to comprehend his Rank like these powerhouses did. He only needed to accumulate enough foundation, and he would be able to break through in one go.

Fortunately, the Lord of Starvault Sanctum deliberately began from the most basic knowledge of sage rank. This allowed Daniel, an outsider who had entered halfway through, to understand at least some of the simpler principles.
"So this is the principle behind sage rank."
Daniel pondered silently.
His current level was directly linked to his Rank. Only by breaking through his Rank could he continue leveling up.
The next step was to attempt to construct his own sage rank.

"The core of a Divine Domain lies in ’fusion’—using Strength to condense momentum, and using momentum to forge a Divine Domain. At the same time, one’s body will continuously give birth to Immortal Singularities. As long as the Divine Soul is undying, the Divine Domain is immortal. So that is what it means."
A look of realization appeared in Daniel’s eyes.
"And sage rank is the advancement of the Divine Domain. A Divine Domain relies on Immortal Singularities, while sage rank relies on endless divine energy."
Divine energy!
Divine-grade powerhouses were also known as divine energy beings.
Those who transcended the mortal and entered the sacred, becoming capable of all things!
During his explanation, the Lord of Starvault Sanctum said that "Divine-grade" was the shortened form of "divine energy being."
Only then did Daniel truly understand.
So-called transcendence into the sacred meant condensing divine energy, mastering divine energy, and ultimately becoming an embodiment of divine energy.

The reason a sage was called sacred did not lie in the magnitude of their Strength, but in the fact that they had already surpassed the restraints of mundane laws and become both a vessel and controller of divine energy.
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum’s voice echoed through the void like the tolling of an ancient bell.
"To comprehend the constancy and impermanence of laws, and to be able to govern both—this is the beginning of a sage."
Then, how did one step onto the path of sagehood?
Condensing an immortal sacred will and watering oneself with divine energy—this was Low Divine-grade.
Comprehending the flow of laws between heaven and earth, seeing through their constancy and transformation, and standing above both—this was Mid Divine-grade.

Breaking free from the shackles of planar laws, becoming a source of divine energy oneself, and at the same time transcending the restraints of all laws—this was High Divine-grade, and even peak Divine-grade.
Upon reaching this step, one could advance to Oracle-grade!
Oracle-grade beings were the masters of divine energy!
With a single thought, they could shift the stars and distort spacetime.
A sage was, in and of themselves, a moving palace of laws.

Once one became a sage, they could no longer descend into small worlds—because the Origin order of a small world would sense that the sage’s divine energy posed a tremendous threat to itself and would reject them madly.
Medium worlds were also only willing to accommodate sages at Mid Divine-grade and below. The principle was the same.
Only large living worlds that were complete and stable in themselves would not reject sages. They could even accommodate Oracle-grade beings!
This was because the Origin order of a large living world was already powerful and mature enough to withstand the fluctuations of a sage’s divine energy.
To put it plainly: "It has already formed a mature order of its own and can distinguish good from evil, right from wrong by itself."
Only now did Daniel understand why living worlds had such restrictions against Divine-grade powerhouses.
So sages understood the laws of the world, yet were not governed by those laws. They even sought to transcend the laws and rewrite them.
How could the World Origin possibly tolerate that?
The day one became a source of laws oneself would be the day one’s sage rank came into conflict with the world’s order.
This was an irreconcilable contradiction.
Naturally, the world would not allow it.
Daniel continued listening, and then he understood how to construct a sage rank.
"So constructing a sage rank is actually quite similar to constructing a Divine Domain."
He smiled.
"The blueprint of the sage rank is the most crucial point. Top-grade and powerful blueprints are only held by the major factions of the various starfields, and they need to be exchanged with points."
"It is just like the blueprint of my Chaotic Samsara Divine Domain—with the blueprint, one can continue filling, stabilizing, or strengthening the Divine Domain!"
"Therefore, top-grade sage rank blueprints are extremely precious and extremely rare. Exchanging for one requires a tremendous price."
"Furthermore, constructing a sage rank requires an ocean-like amount of divine energy."
Daniel’s eyes flickered.

"The more top-grade the sage rank blueprint is, the more divine energy it requires. It will consume many times more than constructing a Divine Domain. Divine energy can not only be used to construct a sage rank, but can also be used as a method to enhance it—the more divine energy consumed, the stronger the enhanced sage rank will be."
"There are also differences between sage rank and Divine Domain."
Daniel digested this knowledge.
"A Divine Domain often determines the upper limit of a sage rank. The Divine Domain is the foundation of one’s strength. The firmer the foundation, the stronger the sage rank will naturally be."

"For example, my sage rank is built upon a supreme Divine Domain, which is the finest of the finest among Divine Domains. Even if I use it as the foundation to break through to Divine-grade, I will possess a first-rate sage rank."
"If the Divine Domain itself is mediocre, then even if one obtains a top-grade sage rank blueprint, the final result after construction will be greatly reduced."
Daniel smiled faintly. In terms of how solid his foundation was, there were probably few who could compare to him.
"There is another point."
He continued thinking.
"Constructing a sage rank requires a large amount of Sacred Materials. The specific types of Sacred Materials required depend on the sage rank one chooses."

"The more top-grade the sage rank, the more top-grade the Sacred Materials required. After all, one cannot live in a magnificent palace while the interior decoration is only done in a sloppy and perfunctory manner, can they?"

"Only with matching Sacred Materials can a sage rank approach perfection without limit. And a sage rank that approaches perfection without limit is a sage that approaches invincibility without limit."
Daniel’s gaze became firm.
"In order to accumulate divine energy, and in order to obtain top-grade Sacred Materials, I must go to the Astral Realm!"
"Only after possessing a top-grade foundation like a supreme Divine Domain can one truly understand the mysteries within."

chapters.title: Chapter 308 -308-The Sage Rank Codex, Registered Members
paragraphs: Daniel was sincerely satisfied with his Divine Domain.
That Dustin was almost omnipotent, an astonishingly talented figure beyond compare.
Yet once Daniel’s supreme Divine Domain unfolded, it could restrain and suppress Dustin’s endless stream of methods.

This was something the other nine-star powerhouses could not do. Although their Divine Domains could also be considered first-rate, before a supreme Divine Domain, they were nothing more than fireflies before the bright moon.
Facing Dustin’s offensive, they could only passively take the beating, without the slightest ability to fight back.
Naturally, Daniel also had to construct a supreme sage rank. There was no doubt about that.

"The Astral Realm can not only allow one to comprehend Sacred Arts and laws, and obtain massive amounts of divine energy, but it also contains countless primordial Sacred Materials. Many Divine-grade secret treasures are refined using Sacred Materials nurtured by the Astral Realm, because the Astral Realm is a primordial world. Only the Astral Realm can give birth to primordial things."
Daniel’s eyes lit up, and a vivid comparison surfaced in his mind.
"The Astral Realm is like that primitive heaven and earth when the universe first opened."
When heaven and earth first opened, primordial beings and innate supreme treasures were everywhere.
Just imagine that era when the universe was first created—even an ordinary stone might contain primordial power.
A cloud, a wisp of sunset glow, could also be the incarnation of a primordial object.
What a wondrous scene that must have been!
And Daniel and Dustin were about to head to such a place—to a newly born world... to plunder! To temper themselves!
"Just thinking about it makes my blood boil."
Daniel blinked, and a smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
"Although the Astral Realm is filled with treasures everywhere..."
The corners of his lips curled slightly, but another thought was turning in his mind.
"That place must also be hiding deadly blades everywhere."
Although he had not come into contact with much detailed information about the Astral Realm, he could figure it out even with his toes.
The Endless Starsea was so cruel. How could there only be gains and no risks?
Leaving aside those native primordial beings, just the powerhouses swarming in from other universes would include even major figures at the Oracle-grade level personally entering the stage.
Oracle-grade beings also needed to advance. They also needed to fight over Divine-grade secret treasures, and they also needed to accumulate foundations to pass on to the juniors they valued.
With such a public, fat piece of meat dripping with oil, who would not want to rush up and take a few bites?
Daniel very much wanted to.
In fact, he was already becoming somewhat impatient.
Just then, the voice of the Lord of Starvault Sanctum came to an abrupt stop.
He was finished!
He had not spoken for very long. What he had discussed was only his experience in transitioning from demi-sage rank to Divine-grade, so it did not take much time.
However, the many powerhouses present, even those Oracle-grade beings, had all benefited greatly.
And among those who gained the most was Daniel.
The instant the Lord of Starvault Sanctum’s voice fell, a system notification rang beside his ear.
[Ding! You have listened to the sermon of a T8 Oracle-grade being and comprehended the secrets of sage rank.]
[Notification: You have obtained the [Sage Rank Codex].]
Daniel was stunned.
He remembered that he had once obtained a Divine Domain Codex before, and from it, he had chosen a supreme Divine Domain.
Now, he had obtained a Sage Rank Codex as well!
Did that not mean he now had another chance to obtain a supreme sage rank?
That was a supreme sage rank!
"Top-grade sage rank blueprints have always been held only in the hands of those super factions."
Excitement flashed in Daniel’s eyes.
"If I wanted to exchange for one with points, I would have to spend an astronomical amount. Now, good. I’ve saved all of it."
With the Sage Rank Codex, he had saved an enormous sum of points.
However, top-grade Sacred Materials still had to be exchanged for with points.
That did not matter. Chanelle had said that his treatment was the first tier among Divine-grade beings. The moment he joined the faction, he would receive points.
Daniel was not in a hurry to choose a sage rank blueprint.
The divine energy he had accumulated so far was still too little.
Through the sermon of the T8 Oracle-grade Lord of Starvault Sanctum, he had only accumulated a little over one billion divine energy.
That amount was clearly far from enough.
"At the very least, I need to accumulate ten trillion."
Daniel set himself a small goal.
He needed a massive amount of divine energy to construct his sage rank, then use it for enhancement.
Ten trillion was the minimum line in his heart.
Moreover, right now, he did not have a single Sacred Material. The time had not yet come to choose a sage rank, and his perspective was also still limited.
He decided to wait until he harvested a wave from the Astral Realm before constructing his sage rank steadily and properly.
"I’ll put this Sage Rank Codex aside for now."
He withdrew his thoughts.
The end of the Lord of Starvault Sanctum’s sermon meant that this tournament had officially come to an end.
This tournament had gathered all the strongest quasi-sages in the current universe.
Midway through, even a top-tier demi-sage rank from an outer universe had suddenly entered the stage.
Dustin had suppressed almost every opponent by himself, but in the end, he was defeated by Daniel.
Daniel had become the most dazzling light.
Not only had he preserved the dignity of Myriad-Star Cosmos, but he had also won glory for the universe and secured tangible benefits for Canaan Starfield.
Daniel was undoubtedly the greatest winner.
After the tournament ended, the various starfields dispersed one after another.

chapters.title: Chapter 309 -309-Opportunity and Death Coexist
paragraphs: "This is already very good, okay!"
James began explaining with an extremely serious expression.

"Golden Holy Mountain is a colossal existence that has existed for who knows how many tens of thousands of years. There are so many good things inside that they can’t even be counted. As long as you have points, you can get whatever you want."
"And there’s also the opportunity to listen to Oracle-grade beings transmit profundities. Big Brother, do you think that’s treatment anyone can receive?"
He looked as though he had been completely defeated by Daniel.
"So that’s how it is!"
Daniel responded, "Then congratulations to you two. I also have some good news."
James and Mosi stared blankly at Faustus.
Faustus said calmly, "I am already an official member of Golden Holy Mountain."
Boom—!
The two of them froze at the same time, as if they had been struck by a bolt of lightning.
Holy shit...!
An official member.
That treatment was countless times better than that of a registered member.
"Mosi, tell me, is this good news?"
"Why does my mood suddenly feel like I just ate a sour fruit..."
James looked at Mosi with a stiff expression.
"Of course."
Mosi replied expressionlessly with two words.
"Boss Faustus, what level of treatment did you get exactly?"
James could not help asking out of curiosity.
Daniel smiled.

"Nothing much. They just gave me an initial sum of points, my own sphere of influence, a fixed headquarters territory, some kind of pass to enter and exit Ivahpin World, qualifications to enter dangerous lands, secret realms, and forbidden zones, as well as some organizational authority and things like that."
"Eh, this treatment is just so-so, right?"
He blinked, his face full of innocence.
James and Mosi opened their mouths wide, nailed in place like two stone statues.
Then James decisively pulled Mosi around and walked away. His furious voice drifted through the air.
"How did I only now realize that some people are this good at showing off?!"
"Mm!"
Watching the two of them leave, Daniel shrugged.
In truth, he currently had no real concept of what his treatment actually meant. He would only truly experience it after arriving at Golden Holy Mountain’s headquarters.
Suddenly, a voice transmission sounded beside his ear.
"Faustus, come over here."
It was Chanelle’s voice.
Daniel arrived before Chanelle.
Chanelle smiled as he sized him up, then nodded in satisfaction.
"As expected, you are someone blessed with great Fortune Points."
"Faustus, do you know that whenever an Astral Realm opens, it marks the emergence of a large number of top-tier Divine-grade powerhouses?"
Chanelle’s eyes were bright as he smiled.
"A new Astral Realm is about to open. I have secured one of Golden Holy Mountain’s quotas for you, James, and Mosi."
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
Golden Holy Mountain’s quota?
James and Mosi were going too?
That was excellent.
"There is no need for me to say much about how greatly the Astral Realm can help in constructing a sage rank."
Chanelle continued, "Likewise, every time an Astral Realm opens, it is also a calamity. Do you mind if I say a few more words?"
Daniel nodded repeatedly.
"I would be more than grateful!"
Chanelle slowly began, "An Astral Realm is a newborn star system."
"For the first ten years after its birth, it is protected by primordial laws. Even Oracle-grade beings like us cannot approach it."

"From the eleventh year to the thirtieth year, only demi-sage rank powerhouses can enter by relying on ’star scrolls.’ Among them, those who possess a Scroll of Astral Prosperity can enter the deepest regions of the Astral Realm and obtain the greatest harvests."
"There are only seven Scrolls of Astral Prosperity in each era."
Chanelle sighed with emotion.

"Back when I was still a demi-sage rank, I personally saw the seven powerhouses who held the Scrolls of Astral Prosperity. Without exception, each of them stood at the very peak of the starry sky’s pyramid. At that time, in front of them, I felt nothing but shame at my own inferiority."
Daniel’s heart shook.
Even an existence like Chanelle, a T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse, had felt inferior before those seven people back then. It was clear just how terrifying those people must have been!
And he himself had a Scroll of Astral Prosperity in his possession.
"The Scroll of Astral Prosperity will accompany its master for life. Once its master dies, it will immediately dissipate. Not even an eternal sage can capture it."
"It chooses its master on its own. It cannot be forced."
Daniel’s eyes flickered. For a moment, he nearly wanted to reveal that he possessed a Scroll of Astral Prosperity.
But after thinking about it, he still held back.
That scroll was far too rare, and now was the critical period when the Astral Realm was about to open. Who knew how many bottomless powerhouses would resort to all kinds of methods to seize it?
Even when facing a senior like Chanelle, who was extremely kind and friendly toward him, he could not reveal it.
Everything had to remain steady!
Chanelle continued, "The Scroll of Astral Prosperity is difficult to obtain, but the Scroll of Radiant Stars is relatively more common."
"Only powerhouses below Oracle-grade need the Scroll of Radiant Stars. Golden Holy Mountain has some of them in its possession. Once you arrive at headquarters, you can exchange points for one."
"Understood."
Daniel nodded.
"There is more."
Chanelle continued explaining, "From the thirty-first year to the sixtieth year of the Astral Realm, Divine-grade powerhouses are allowed to enter."
"They also need Scrolls of Radiant Stars, but the Scroll of Radiant Stars can only allow passage through the outer regions of the Astral Realm."
"In other words, for the first thirty years, Divine-grade powerhouses cannot enter the Astral Realm?"
Daniel quickly grasped the key point.
He was invincible among those of the same Rank. If he could dominate the entire Astral Realm for those thirty years, did that not mean all the good things would belong to him alone?
"That’s right."
Chanelle smiled.
"The Astral Realm is nurtured by primordial profundities. Even eternal sages must obey its rules, let alone Oracle-grade and Divine-grade beings."
"Primordial profundities..."
Daniel nodded.
"I understand."
"From the sixty-first year to the one hundred and first year is when Oracle-grade beings can exert their strength. They will enter the Astral Realm at that time."

Chanelle said, "Normally, demi-sage rank powerhouses who hold Scrolls of Radiant Stars will only stay until the thirty-first year, because once Divine-grade powerhouses enter, they will no longer be able to fight them."
Chanelle’s voice suddenly became low and deep.
"Daniel! In the Endless Starsea, the only one you can trust is yourself."

He said quietly, "When faced with top-grade Sacred Materials, top-grade treasure lands, and top-grade Sacred Arts, even companions from the same starfield and the same faction must be treated with extreme caution."
He placed heavy emphasis on the words "extreme caution."
Daniel immediately understood the chill within those words.

Chanelle pondered for a moment before saying, "Inside the Astral Realm, even if you encounter demi-sage ranks, sages, or Oracle-grade beings from Canaan Starfield or Golden Holy Mountain, you must still be on guard."
"Many times, an innocent person invites death not because they have committed any wrong, but because they are carrying treasures that others covet."
Daniel nodded.
"The most dangerous enemy is often the one you never guard against."
Seeing that he had taken these words seriously, Chanelle nodded in relief.
"Only by keeping a low profile can one live for a long time—unless you already possess the strength to crush everything, making it so that no covetous person dares to even entertain the thought."
His voice was calm and powerful.
"This time, I specially fought for quotas for James and Mosi because I wanted you to have a few companions at your side whom you can slightly trust."
"In the Astral Realm, strength alone is not enough. You also need helpers. Searching for treasures alone will ultimately be less efficient than having three or five people travel together."
Faustus nodded.
He had never set foot in the Astral Realm before, and since Chanelle had personally experienced it, his words naturally made sense.
Otherwise, if he recklessly charged in blindly, he would suffer a huge loss sooner or later.
"After saying so much, it is time to tell you where the Astral Realm is."
Chanelle stretched out his hand. A ball of gentle radiance rose from his palm and slowly flew toward Daniel.
Buried within that ball of light were the coordinates of the Astral Realm, as well as some detailed information about its regions.

chapters.title: Chapter 310 -310-Canaan Starfield’s Enormous Gains
paragraphs: "Oh? This newly born Astral Realm is in the Chaosverse!"
Daniel’s eyes flickered.
If he was going to the Chaosverse, he would probably inevitably have to deal with the Chaos Humans.
"No wonder Dustin invited me to go to the Astral Realm. So it’s actually in their universe."
"The Astral Realm is currently still within its first ten-year gestation period, so it cannot be entered yet," Chanelle said. "But it will soon be unsealed."
With another wave of his hand, two clusters of gentle light appeared out of thin air.
"One of these two items is the Ivahpin Scroll, a pass to enter that world. The other is a small... personal gift from me to celebrate your joining Golden Holy Mountain."
An entry scroll for Ivahpin World?
Daniel accepted the scroll.
The scroll felt as light as nothing in his hand, as though he were holding a piece of solidified night.
On the surface of the scroll was engraved a lush, golden ancient tree, its patterns exquisite and lifelike.

Seeing the confusion on his face, Chanelle explained, "Ivahpin World is a supreme law sacred treasure jointly forged by several T9 Oracle-grade beings of Golden Holy Mountain. You can activate this Ivahpin Scroll with your mind power, and then your consciousness will appear within a boundless world."
"That world exists between reality and illusion. Every member of Golden Holy Mountain can enter Ivahpin World."

"Within Ivahpin World, you can communicate with others, buy and sell treasures, exchange points for resources, check mission rankings, and even carry out advancement... It is equivalent to another complete world."
"No matter which corner of the Endless Starsea you are in, you can enter it through the Ivahpin Scroll. In many moments of crisis, it can even save your life!"
After hearing this, Daniel was completely stunned.
"Why do I feel like... this Ivahpin World gives me the same sense as an illusory plane?"
His heart trembled violently, and he suddenly began to doubt the authenticity of this world.
"Then the world I’m in... is it real?"
"My Millionfold Boost system... could it also be a treasure forged by some peerless existence?"
"And the game system?"
He even thought of something deeper.
"My several rebirths..."
At this thought, Daniel felt a bone-chilling cold rise up his back.
"Why think so much? I’m just scaring myself."
He shook his head, driving away those absurd thoughts from his mind.
There was no need to overthink it. The most crucial point was—
Even if he thought about it more, he still did not have the ability to solve it!
Ivahpin World!
That was a supreme-grade sacred treasure jointly forged by several T9 Oracle-grade beings of Golden Holy Mountain.
No matter where a member of Golden Holy Mountain was in the Endless Starsea, under normal circumstances, they could enter that world between illusion and reality through the Ivahpin Scroll.
Chanelle had even specifically mentioned that high-grade authority in Ivahpin World could be used to save one’s life at critical moments.
Daniel put away the Ivahpin Scroll, then reached out and accepted the ball of light floating before him.
Inside the light lay an exquisite small sword. Within the sword was Chanelle’s unique aura of divine energy, deep and vast, as though an entire galaxy had been sealed inside.
"What is this?"
Daniel looked at Chanelle.
"This is a life-saving trump card I am giving you."
Chanelle smiled. "Do you know how great a benefit you won for Canaan Starfield this time?"
Daniel shook his head.
Golden Holy Mountain had only required the contestants to participate in the competition. As for what ranking they obtained or what benefits they would win, it had not said anything at all.
"You performed exceptionally well this time," Chanelle said. "The slaughter and conflict between starfields is no less intense than wars between universes."
"When facing outer universes, we can unite against the outside. But once internal interests are involved, we still fight each other to the death!"
Daniel was not surprised at all.
That was exactly the kind of place the Endless Starsea was.
Forget starfields—even a small place like the Myriad-Race Starry Sky was filled with constant conquest and endless invasions.
He himself had personally taken part in it.

Since these were the rules of the universe, and the rules of the Endless Starsea, then before he possessed absolute Strength capable of changing those rules, he could only obey them, develop honestly, and quietly strengthen himself.
Then, when the day came that he possessed the power to rewrite the rules, he could break them and rebuild them.
Of course, all of this would depend entirely on whether Daniel himself wanted to.
"The original purpose of this tournament was to eliminate meaningless internal consumption between the various starfields."
Chanelle’s voice sank.

"The interests within the Endless Starsea are simply too enormous. If rules are not established, the various factions will continue slaughtering one another endlessly, and the losses will only grow greater and greater."

"The internal forces of our current universe have already consumed too much Strength. If this internal strife continues, then when it comes time to compete with outer universes for benefits, we will inevitably be passive at every step and fall behind everywhere."
Daniel came to a realization.
So this was what those powerhouses standing at the very top had been planning.
In order to accumulate enough Strength to deal with threats from outer universes, they could only temporarily suppress internal disputes and infighting.
One had to admit, this was the correct choice!
"In this Starlight Tournament, we divided benefits based on rankings," Chanelle said. "I have already received the news—you took first place, James took third, and Mosi took fourth."
Without a doubt...
Canaan Starfield was the greatest winner!
"In the coming war against the outer universes, our Canaan Starfield will temporarily assume the role of leader, while Golden Holy Mountain will become the alliance master."
"All of this was an advantage you won for us."

Chanelle smiled. "So this divine energy sword is not only a congratulatory gift for your joining Golden Holy Mountain, but also my thanks for the enormous contribution you have made to Canaan Starfield."
"As for this small sword..."
Chanelle paused for a moment.
"Inside it is sealed the Strength of my full-power strike."
Hiss—!
Daniel drew in a deep breath.
Chanelle was a T7 Oracle-grade being, yet this tiny sword actually carried the power of a full-force strike from a T7 Oracle-grade.
What terrifying destructive power that must be!
"It can only be used once," Chanelle said. "It can be activated by injecting just a small amount of divine energy. If you use this small sword, I will also sense it."
His voice softened.

"T9 Oracle-grade beings possess the ability to revive living beings from the Time River. You only need to display your own talent, and if you also have enough points in your possession, then having a T9 Oracle-grade being act to fish you out of the Time River is not impossible."
"Do you... understand what I mean?"
Daniel’s pupils suddenly contracted.
T9 Oracle-grade beings were actually so terrifying that they could revive living beings from the Time River!
It was simply inconceivable!
Chanelle’s meaning could not have been clearer.
He wanted Daniel to continue maintaining his current combat power and brilliance, to keep growing stronger and display a unique and unparalleled potential.
Then those supreme-grade existences standing at the very peak of Golden Holy Mountain would consider acting to revive him for the sake of that talent.
Moreover, if he held a massive amount of points, then the chances of those existences taking action would be even greater.
"I understand, Your Excellency."
Of course Daniel understood.
The resurrection spoken of by the natives of this world was completely different from the infinite resurrection he possessed as an adventurer!

chapters.title: Chapter 311 -311-Mass-Produced Divine-Grade Powerhouses
paragraphs: A powerful Oracle-grade existence could trap an adventurer in an endless cycle of death. In that case, so-called infinite resurrection would be completely useless.
Even Daniel, who possessed the ability of Immortal Revival, would be helpless if a powerful Oracle-grade erased every trace of his existence from every point in time and every spatial dimension.
But if a T9 Oracle-grade took action, things would be completely different.

They could directly break the profound rules from within the Time River. Even if the target had been reduced to nothing, as long as there was still something related to them—just one thread of karma—they could revive that person.
The problem was, why would a T9 Oracle-grade do such a thing?
That was the significance of Chanelle’s existence.
Daniel had joined Golden Holy Mountain, and Chanelle was his recommender.
He was telling Daniel that from now on, they were fellow travelers on the same boat, sharing both glory and loss.

Chanelle kept his attitude very humble because he knew that a prodigy like Daniel, once he broke through to Divine-grade, would immediately stand at the peak of Divine-grade. With just a little effort, he would be able to step into the level of Oracle-grade, even the Saint Radiance realm.
As long as Daniel broke through to Oracle-grade, reaching high Oracle-grade would not be difficult either.
What Chanelle was investing in was not only the Daniel of the present, but also the Daniel of the future.
He believed in Daniel’s future achievements, which was why he had always treated him as an equal.
After the two chatted for a while longer, their conversation came to an end.
Daniel had to hurry to Golden Holy Mountain’s headquarters first.
"We’ll head to headquarters together. After that, we’ll each return home. Half a year later, we’ll meet again in the Budelica starfield."
After Daniel learned that James and Mosi were also planning to return to their hometowns, he immediately made the suggestion.
James and Mosi were also going to the Astral Realm.

Neither of them had an Ivahpin Scroll in their hands, so they could not directly exchange for a passage scroll to the Astral Realm on the spot. They could only go to headquarters first, exchange the treasures they carried for points, and then use those points to purchase scrolls.
As for Daniel, if he wanted to exchange for anything, he could do it directly inside Ivahpin World.
The treatment he enjoyed was top-tier treatment that stood in a class of its own among Divine-grade members. Registered members simply could not compare.
"I’m returning to Frostfall Galaxy, Mosi is going back to Misty Starsea, and Boss Faustus is returning to Visca Galaxy."
James sighed with emotion. "Time flows like water. We gathered in such a hurry, and now we’re parting just as quickly. Fortunately, half a year from now, we’ll meet again."

Daniel smiled. "The Astral Realm is filled with unpredictable dangers. You’d better work hard to improve your strength. If you end up calling me to save you when the time comes, you’ll be embarrassing yourselves beyond the universe."
"How could I possibly slack off?"
James chuckled. "If we’re talking purely about life-saving ability, then in the quasi-sage realm, aside from you, Boss Faustus, I dare say no one can surpass me."
"Coward."
Mosi added with his usual sparing words.
"Why do I feel like you’re insulting me?"
James glared at Mosi angrily.
"I have to go back."
At this moment, Daniel’s emotions surged. He was practically unable to wait any longer.
That Starbeast egg might be able to transform into one of his avatars.
His current avatar ability had a ceiling. Divine-grade was already its limit!
But the Starbeast egg was different. If he could take it for his own use and transform it into an avatar, he could break through the shackles of Divine-grade.
When that time came, no matter how recklessly he took risks, he would no longer have to be so cautious.
More importantly, Starbeasts possessed inherited bloodline memories passed down from generation to generation.
That was the legacy accumulated over countless years by the number one lifeform of the starry sky.
He was determined to obtain this gift.
The star sea was vast and boundless. Even crossing a single galaxy would take a Divine-grade powerhouse several years at full speed, let alone crossing the vast distance between starfields.
Of course, if one had a flying-type Divine-grade vehicle, things would be much faster.
Chanelle’s flying vehicle was also a top-tier treasure. Even so, flying from the Budelica starfield back to the Canaan starfield had taken quite some time. But this was already considered fast.
Golden Holy Mountain had existed for an immeasurably long time.
Legend had it that its founder was an eternal sage.
It was located at the center of the Canaan starfield, in a realm opened up by Golden Holy Mountain itself.
It was a vast territory no smaller than a galaxy, a grand plane formed from multiple non-living worlds.
Gold Realm.
"So this is Golden Holy Mountain..."
Daniel stepped down from the flying vehicle and looked over this unfamiliar world before him.
In the Endless Starsea, the laws and order of living worlds awakened naturally.
As for the laws of non-living worlds, they were personally created by supreme powerhouses.
To create laws, one had to be at least a T8 Oracle-grade existence.
Gold Realm was precisely such a non-living world. It had been jointly opened by several great Oracle-grade powerhouses, and its territory was vast enough to rival an entire galaxy.
Daniel looked at the orderly yet profound planes before him. They were completely different from any world he had ever seen.
Most of the worlds he had seen were sealed off.
But the grand plane before him was open.
There were no barriers separating the various planes. Their auras blended together, forming one seamless whole.
Outside the planes, countless powerhouses flew through the air. They were densely packed, too numerous to count.

Daniel did not even need to use his mind power to sense that among these countless powerhouses, the weakest had Divine-grade strength. There were even quite a few low-tier Oracle-grade existences among them!
"Golden Holy Mountain truly deserves to be the strongest force in the Canaan starfield. Its foundation is unfathomable."
Daniel could not help but sigh.
He finally understood why the Divine-grade powerhouses under the Lord of Starvault Sanctum had been like servants.
Sages were indeed powerful, but before a colossal existence like this, they were nothing more than insignificant specks of dust.
James seemed to have been here before. Seeing Daniel’s expression, he opened his mouth to explain.
"Even among Divine-grade powerhouses, there are differences in status and quality."
Daniel looked at him in confusion.
"Divine-grade powerhouses can be mass-produced."
James smiled. "People like us, who advanced one step at a time through our own efforts, are naturally the real deal."

"But the major forces have countless methods to mass-produce Divine-grade powerhouses. The more powerful ones can even create beings whose combat strength is no different from a normal Divine-grade powerhouse."

"Those Divine-grade beings might be non-living entities, or they might be forcibly elevated through external power. But no matter which type they are, they all have one fatal flaw—they will never be able to advance any further in this life."
Daniel immediately understood.
No wonder there were so many Divine-grade powerhouses. They could actually be mass-produced like goods coming off an assembly line.
But the drawback was also obvious.
They would never be able to take another step forward.
"In the Endless Starsea, potential is often more important than strength."
James spoke with deep meaning.
Daniel nodded.
He thought of Chanelle’s attitude toward him. It was precisely because Chanelle valued his potential so highly.
"After all, Oracle-grade existences are already rare, and great Oracle-grade existences are rarer still."
Daniel smiled.
"That’s exactly the reason."

James nodded in agreement. "In wars between universes, Divine-grade powerhouses are nothing more than cannon fodder charging at the front. The true outcome is ultimately decided by the life-and-death battles between Oracle-grade and great Oracle-grade existences."

chapters.title: Chapter 312 -312-Primordial Card, Golden Token!
paragraphs: Golden Holy Mountain headquarters.
When the stewards of the various major factions heard that Chanelle had returned with that group of prodigious demi-sage ranks, they all sent people to gather information.
"Go. See whether that fellow called Faustus really has three heads and six arms."
The person in power of a certain family immediately gave orders to his subordinates.
"Chanelle made a beautiful move this time. He seized the initiative and won over Faustus and that batch of demi-sage ranks. Now he has people to support his side."
A great Oracle-grade powerhouse could not help but praise Chanelle for making an exceptionally brilliant move.
"Pass down my order. Our family is not allowed to provoke Faustus and the others. We can only befriend them. We absolutely must not offend them."
A certain powerhouse of Golden Holy Mountain issued a strict command.
"You should go and recognize Faustus and the others as well. Remember all of their appearances clearly. In the future, if you see them, you must never offend them."
The other factions also warned their own people one after another.
Golden Holy Mountain dominated the entire Canaan starfield, and its internal factions were deeply intertwined and complicated.
Chanelle was the leader of one of those factions. In addition to him, there were also the Four Great Royal Families, numerous noble families, and many other forces.
The reason they could possess so much authority was that they used their brains more often than their fists.
They disdained doing things like suppressing promising newcomers.
In the Endless Starsea, a powerhouse with potential was far more worthy of attention than a powerhouse with strength alone.
Not only would they not make enemies of Daniel, they would even take the initiative to show goodwill.
"So this is Faustus, the champion of this competition?"
A Divine-grade powerhouse looked at him, his eyes filled with admiration.
"Look at that boundless vitality. The younger generation is truly fearsome."
"These young powerhouses all have the bearing of Oracle-grade existences."
"That’s right. We absolutely cannot underestimate them."
"I wonder whether they have any interest in making new friends..."
After Chanelle brought this group of quasi-sages to the destination, he left.
Before leaving, he specially reminded Daniel to go to Golden Holy Mountain’s registration office and complete a handover procedure.
Daniel and the others arrived at the registration office, and suddenly attracted a crowd of powerhouses.
Daniel had long since grown used to it.
Ever since he stepped into Gold Realm, there had been powerhouses constantly watching and observing them.
After the competition ended, the three great nine-star powerhouses of the Canaan starfield had become famous overnight.
Countless quasi-sages throughout the Canaan starfield had even begun treating Daniel and the others as idols and examples to follow.
Daniel simply completed the handover. In truth, there was not much to hand over.
He received several items.
[Ding! You have obtained [Primordial Card] (Rare).]
Daniel was now holding that card in his hand.
The Primordial Card stored his Golden Holy Mountain points.

Because it was a rare item, and because the points were strictly monitored by Golden Holy Mountain throughout the entire process, with every single point recorded, it was impossible to trigger Millionfold Boost.
However, Daniel could exchange treasures for points. In essence, that was not too different.
Inside this card, there were his initial 500,000 points.
Every hundred years from now on, another 500,000 points would be delivered to him.
[Ding! You have obtained [Golden Token] (Rare).]
Daniel looked at the token in his hand.
[Golden Token (Rare)]
Restriction: Golden Holy Mountain member, peak Divine-grade.
Privileges:

One residence within Gold Realm.Free access to all treasured lands, dangerous lands, forbidden lands, mystic realms, and other domains controlled by Golden Holy Mountain.For all types of territories of the above four categories in which Golden Holy Mountain participates, the holder may apply to settle in them. The first five years are free. After five years, points must be used for exchange. The upper limit is one hundred years.The holder can receive instant emergency messages from Golden Holy Mountain.The holder can contact any Golden Holy Mountain powerhouse below T8 Oracle-grade, at the cost of points.Current sphere of influence: Visca Galaxy.
Description: The Golden Token, the identity symbol of an official member of Golden Holy Mountain.
After Daniel finished reading it, he casually threw it into his backpack.
The treatment Chanelle had mentioned had indeed all been fulfilled.
It was truly treatment that stood in a class of its own among peak Divine-grade members.
Especially the final line: Golden Holy Mountain had assigned Visca Galaxy to him as his sphere of influence!

Of course, this did not mean they had simply given him a territory the size of an entire galaxy for free. Rather, it meant that in the future, when he fought for territory, Golden Holy Mountain would back him from behind.
No matter who he faced, everything would have to be done according to the rules!
As for how much territory he could seize, and whether he would end up capsizing, that would depend entirely on his own ability.
Daniel finally understood why the ancestors of the Aetheria human race had not directly gone out to seize territory back then.
Because every territory already had an owner!
If one rashly barged into the territory of some major force, what awaited them would be endless war.

Unless one’s strength had reached the point of being invincible throughout the starry sky, the result would be that after defeating the weak, the strong would come; after defeating the young, the old would come. It would never end.
For example, if one day, a powerhouse from an outer universe came to Visca Galaxy to seize Daniel’s territory, Golden Holy Mountain would stand up for Daniel.
If a low-tier Oracle-grade could not defeat them, then a high Oracle-grade would be sent.
If a high Oracle-grade still could not defeat them?
Would they be afraid when a group of great Oracle-grade powerhouses pressed down on them?
What about an eternal sage?
They would face enemies that seemed impossible to kill off, and each one would be stronger than the last.
This was the unspoken rule of the Endless Starsea.
Everything had to be done according to the rules.
Unless—
You were strong enough to ignore all rules!
Daniel finished the handover.
Next, it was time to use his points to exchange for treasures.
"Ivahpin World..."
He took out the realm scroll and sent his mind power into it.
His 500,000 points could be used for exchange at Golden Holy Mountain headquarters, or they could be used inside Ivahpin World.
Of course, entering Ivahpin World was more convenient.
The instant his mind power sank into the realm scroll—
Whoosh.
His vision suddenly blurred, as if he had opened two pairs of eyes at the same time.
The other scene was another world.
A vast and boundless land unfolded before Daniel.
He discovered that he was floating in midair, and beneath his feet was a massive city.
There were no walls, no guards. It was completely open.
Inside the city, pavilions and buildings stood everywhere, and countless living beings came and went in dense streams.
Around him, powerhouses kept appearing out of thin air, turning into streaks of light as they descended into the city.
"Ivahpin!"
In front of the towering city gate stood a tall and crystalline obelisk.
Several ancient and solemn characters were engraved on the surface of the monument, radiating a faint silver glow.
Daniel only glanced at it once before following the flow of people into the city.
Silverlight Lounge, Moonshadow Tower, Gemstone Sacred Hall, Corridor of Wisdom, Mission Board...
He walked all the way through, and everywhere he looked, he saw wondrous sights he had never witnessed before.
The dazzling array of buildings and shops left him overwhelmed. A strange illusion suddenly arose in his heart.
"Am I playing around in an illusion right now?"
Of course, he quickly cast that thought aside.
After all, in this world, the boundary between reality and illusion had long since become blurry.
This place did not belong to the pure real world, nor was it an absolutely empty dream.
Instead, it was a world independent of both, filled with MP.
Following the guidance, he found the Gemstone Sacred Hall where treasures could be exchanged.
The hall was filled with powerful beings, but there were no attendants or merchants in sight.
Everything depended entirely on the visitors selecting and exchanging items on their own.
Daniel calmly browsed through the rare and precious treasures displayed inside the crystal showcases.
No one knew how much time had passed before his gaze suddenly froze on one item, and his pupils abruptly contracted.
"This place actually has this thing!"
He could not help but exclaim in a low voice.
It was not that he was ignorant or easily amazed. Rather, this surprise had come far too suddenly.
They were two elemental cores!
They were precisely two of the ten elemental cores he urgently needed to unseal theChronoverse Prologue Codex.
"Wonderful. These are exactly the two I’m missing!"
Daniel was wild with joy.
TheChronoverse Prologue Codexrequired ten elemental cores to be gathered before it could be unsealed. At present, he had already obtained seven.
And now, the dark elemental core and soul elemental core he lacked were quietly lying right before his eyes.
"Let’s see how many points they require first."
He suppressed his excitement and shifted his gaze toward the exchange price.
Twenty thousand points!
"So cheap?"
He could hardly believe his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 313 -313-Points Exchange, Primordial Codex
paragraphs: Daniel thought about it for a moment and soon understood the reason.

Elemental cores were extremely difficult to collect. Unless one was someone blessed by Lady Luck herself, an ordinary person might not be able to gather them all even after exhausting an entire lifetime.
Moreover, theChronoverse Prologue Codexwas unique. In this world, only one person could unseal it.
And that person was none other than himself!
If not for this, the price of these two elemental cores would probably have been multiplied hundreds or even thousands of times over.
"Does this count as... accidentally finding a bargain?"
The corners of Daniel’s lips curled upward. Without any hesitation, he directly spent twenty thousand points to exchange for them.
At this point, he was only missing the final one of the ten elemental cores.
His anticipation toward unsealing space-time magic burned even more intensely in his heart.
The laws of space-time were one of the supreme-grade laws of the universe. If they could be fused with theChronoverse Prologue Codex, their power would be unimaginable.
He continued browsing, silently memorizing the items he needed to exchange for.

Golden Holy Mountain’s treasury was filled with a dazzling array of treasures. There were simply too many good things. He could not even finish looking through them all, and even had the impulse to empty out the entire treasury!
He roughly sorted through the treasures he needed, then combined that with his most urgent current needs and selected several items.
The first thing that entered his sight was a complete set of exquisitely crafted legion armaments.
[War Puppets (Divine-grade)]
Restriction: Official member of Golden Holy Mountain.
Required points: 100,000 points.
Explanation: Contains one Mid Divine-grade puppet, five Low Divine-grade puppets, and fifty quasi-sage puppets.

Description: After activation, the puppets of the above ranks can be summoned to assist in battle. The puppets possess extremely high Intelligence and can be regarded as true living beings. One-time-use item, permanently effective.
Description: Carefully crafted by a great Oracle-grade powerhouse proficient in the laws of creation. Whether used to guard one’s home or serve as vanguards in an army, they are quite a good choice.
"One hundred thousand points."
Daniel nodded slightly. He felt that this price was truly not expensive.
He had browsed through quite a few things just now. Even supreme-grade mystic arts required fifty thousand points.
Divine-grade mystic arts cost as much as five million points, and even the most ordinary Divine-grade secret treasures required six million!
By comparison, one hundred thousand points was nothing more than a drop in the bucket.
He immediately bought this set of puppets, planning to use them to guard the Aerial Realm or serve as powerful fighters in future campaigns.
After all, among the forces under his command, the strongest were himself and Camille. Neither of them had stepped into Divine-grade yet.
With this puppet legion, they could at least hold up the sky at a critical moment.
He then spent another thirty thousand points to exchange for a Scroll of Radiant Stars.
"I already have a Scroll of Astral Prosperity."
Daniel was thinking of Camille.
"Although Camille’s strength can’t compare to James and Mosi, she is loyal enough to me. She is a comrade I can entrust my back to."
"Lord Chanelle said that having companions during the Astral Realm expedition would bring many benefits. Besides, Camille also needs to find an opportunity to break through to Divine-grade..."
He planned to bring Camille along.
A Scroll of Radiant Stars worth thirty thousand points was nothing more than a negligible expense.
At this point, he had already spent 170,000 points, leaving him with 330,000 points.
"I might as well get a few sets of Divine Domain templates too."
He spent 150,000 points and purchased over a dozen sets of Divine Domain templates.
Ordinary Divine Domain templates only required one thousand points. Even higher-quality ones cost just over ten thousand.
In the Endless Starsea, supreme-grade existences were as numerous as hairs on an ox. Divine Domain templates truly could not be considered rare.
However, incredibly powerful Divine Domain templates like the ones James and Mosi possessed could not be found anywhere.
Templates of that level could no longer be measured by material value. No faction would ever take them out for sale.
If Earth’s players wanted to break through beyond supreme-grade, they had to possess Divine Domain templates.
Those with good luck might receive gifts from the system. As for the powerhouses standing at the peak, they could naturally obtain top-tier templates as well.
But what about those players who were unlucky and were not at the peak?
Were they supposed to be trapped forever among the weak, unable to advance even an inch?
Daniel gave them an opportunity.
He exchanged for Divine Domain templates from Golden Holy Mountain, intending to place them in the guild warehouse and sell them for points.
The players could choose whatever level of Divine Domain template they wanted, as long as they had enough points.
And those points required players to create value for Daniel: mining ore veins, gathering precious materials, expanding territory, defending domains...
"There is no free milk in this world."
Daniel never regarded himself as some holy saint, nor would he allow anyone to take things from him for free.
He had given the players a choice to become stronger. That in itself was already an enormous act of goodwill.
He counted the treasures in his hands.
Two elemental cores: forty thousand. Scroll of Radiant Stars: thirty thousand. Divine Domain templates: one hundred and fifty thousand. Divine-grade puppet legion: one hundred thousand.
The total was 320,000 points, leaving him with 180,000 points.
It was somewhat insufficient!
He simply converted all the wealth under his name into points.
[Ding! You have used Origin Crystals to exchange for five million points.]
With this, his usable points became abundant again.

Daniel knew very well that constructing a Divine Domain required a large amount of Sacred Materials. Although the requirements for quality were not as strict as those for sage rank, they still could not be too crude.

Seeing that the players under his command were about to begin constructing Divine Domains, he simply spent 1.1 million points to purchase a large batch of Sacred Materials, preparing to distribute them to everyone.
This was both the nourishment for cultivating his "chives" and the sickle for harvesting them.
Apart from this, he had no other urgent needs for the time being.
Those top-grade primordial-law Sacred Materials cost hundreds of millions of points at every turn. The little more than four million points he had on hand was nothing more than a drop in the ocean.
"So it turns out that the most valuable thing in the Endless Starsea isn’t currency, but the internal points of the major factions."
Through this exchange, Daniel thoroughly understood that principle.
Fortunately, the various resources in the territories under his command had never stopped producing.
Once those resources underwent Millionfold Boost, the profits would become ridiculously heaven-defying.
He could use the boosted resources to exchange for points, then use those points to empty Golden Holy Mountain’s treasury.
No matter how he calculated it, this deal was absolutely profitable!
He did not continue lingering. Turning around, he walked out of the Gemstone Sacred Hall.
After passing through several long streets, he arrived at the Corridor of Wisdom.
After browsing for a while, he spent 100,000 points to purchase a book.
[Primordial Codex (Rare)]
Restriction: Official member of Golden Holy Mountain.
Explanation: This book describes the techniques and key points for transforming certain things that are neither crafted by Holy Artisans nor primordial objects into primordial Holy Relics.
Description: This book focuses on forging techniques and does not require the assistance of any vessel.
Daniel stored the book away.
He had chosen this book not because it was especially precious, but because of its transformation ability.
Many supreme-grade items, after undergoing Millionfold Boost, would reach an inconceivable level of quality.
At times like that, certain methods were needed to fully transform them into higher-level materials.

In this way, he would be able to continuously produce high-level Holy Relics. Whether he kept them for his own use or used them to empty Golden Holy Mountain’s treasury would depend entirely on his mood.
He left four million points as reserve and withdrew from Ivahpin World.

chapters.title: Chapter 314 -314-Good Things Are Taken by Force
paragraphs: Meanwhile.
James and Mosi had also finished exchanging their respective treasures, and each of them had exchanged for a Scroll of Radiant Stars.
The three met in front of the portal.
"Boss Faustus, goodbye."
James waved farewell.
Mosi did not speak. He only nodded slightly.
"See you again."
Daniel waved as well.
James’s hometown was in Frostfall Galaxy, Mosi’s hometown was in Misty Starsea, and Daniel was returning to Visca Galaxy.
Inside Golden Holy Mountain’s portal was the most detailed and complete Star Chart currently available in the Canaan starfield.
With a single thought, it could send him directly back to Visca Galaxy.
The portal lit up with dazzling radiance, and the figures of the three gradually disappeared within the light.
Visca Galaxy.
Daniel stepped into the portal, and brilliant light swallowed him.
When he opened his eyes again, he was already in Visca Galaxy.
This was his territory, his foundation, the starting point of all his ambitions!
He was not in a hurry to return to Earth. Instead, he first went to the Dawn Pirates’ base and picked up Camille.
Camille still looked as cold, sharp, and capable as ever. When she saw Daniel, a faint trace of relief flashed through her eyes, almost too subtle to notice.
"My lord, you’re back."
Daniel nodded and brought her back to Earth.
With his puppet avatar stationed there, he knew the players’ growth progress like the back of his hand.
The avatar’s consciousness was connected to his, yet it also operated independently.
During the time he had been away participating in the competition, the avatar had been continuously advancing various reforms and improvements.
And the players’ growth speed had even somewhat surprised Daniel.
The resources in the monster-farming areas were extremely abundant. Their levels had soared all the way upward, almost without encountering any obstacles.
The foundation of all this lay in the vast territory Daniel had conquered.
Equipment, skills, pets, materials...
Whatever the players wanted, they had it, as if they were standing inside an inexhaustible treasury.
Without this vast territory, their progress would probably have been several times slower.
It was worth mentioning that none of the players had rashly attempted to break through or construct their Divine Domains.
Daniel already had experience in this regard. He had long since organized information related to Divine Domains into a guide and made it public.
Everyone knew clearly that the gap between a good Divine Domain and an ordinary Divine Domain was like a heavenly chasm.
Before they had sufficient confidence, no one dared to break through recklessly.
And now, the time had come!
Daniel placed all the Sacred Materials and Divine Domain templates he had brought back from Golden Holy Mountain into the guild warehouse.
Want to break through beyond supreme-grade?
Want Sacred Materials?
Want Divine Domain templates?
All of that was possible!
Exchange for them with points.
Not enough points?
No problem. Ever heard of working for them?
A faint smile rose at the corners of Daniel’s lips. After that, he formulated a series of strategies for outward expansion.
After Camille finished reading those plans, her brows furrowed slightly, and there was some hesitation in her tone.
"My lord, you want to conquer all the small worlds in Visca Galaxy?"
Daniel glanced at her. "What? Is there a problem?"
Camille fell silent for a moment, carefully considering her words.
"That is every single small world in an entire galaxy... Visca Galaxy has countless factions. You are not the only Golden Holy Mountain member here!"
"There are quite a few Golden Holy Mountain powerhouses in this place. Not to mention, there are also factions that do not belong to Golden Holy Mountain—such as the Myriad Races Alliance!"

"In Visca Galaxy, the Myriad Races Alliance is also a colossal force. Although its overall scale in the Canaan starfield cannot compare to Golden Holy Mountain, they are still a faction with Oracle-grade existences presiding over them. If this triggers a faction war..."
She paused, feeling that Daniel’s plan was truly somewhat aggressive.
"Aggressive?"
The corners of Daniel’s lips lifted slightly. His voice was calm as water, yet carried an unquestionable certainty.
"Divine-grade powerhouses cannot descend into small worlds. With my avatar stationed there, what is there to fear if I take them all?"
"There is nothing to worry about. The Godkin are firmly under my control now, more obedient than little dogs."

"As for the shadowkin, sirenfolk, and the like, they are nothing more than minor characters. So what if they have Oracle-grade existences? The higher one reaches Oracle-grade, the more reservations one has!"
"Behind me stands Golden Holy Mountain. They don’t have the courage to directly make trouble for me."
He stood up, his gaze turning toward the distant horizon, toward that star sea waiting to be conquered.
"The iron law of the Endless Starsea is survival of the fittest! With blood and fire as the brush, and the star sea as the scroll, one must fight with everything one has to seize everything!"
"Our first step is to conquer the Myriad Races Starry Sky and take all the small worlds into our hands. After that, the entire Visca Galaxy will submit beneath our feet."

Camille pondered for a moment, then asked in a low voice, "The Godkin, shadowkin, and sirenfolk are indeed easy enough to deal with. But that Myriad Races Alliance... how does my lord plan to handle them?"
"The Myriad Races Alliance..."
Daniel’s fingers slowly tapped against the tabletop, his knuckles striking the metal and producing cold echoes.

"They have great Oracle-grade existences presiding over them. Indeed, they are not comparable to other factions. But if they have great Oracle-grade existences, does Golden Holy Mountain not have any?"
He had already calculated all of this clearly.
Great Oracle-grade existences had to accept mandatory missions issued by their faction at fixed intervals.
As long as he was willing to pay enough points, it might not be impossible to invite them to take action.
In that case, what was there to fear?
Just fight!
Hesitation would only lead to defeat and death. Even if a decisive charge ended in failure, it was still better than hiding inside a shell, clinging to life, and passively waiting to be devoured.
"The Myriad Races Alliance is not worth fearing. What we want are only those small worlds, not middle worlds or great worlds, those high-grade territories with abundant output."
"If the Myriad Races Alliance dares to obstruct me..."
Daniel’s voice suddenly sank.
"I will make them pay a price in blood."

Camille nodded slightly. "Golden Holy Mountain is ultimately the hegemonic force of the Canaan starfield. Even if the Myriad Races Alliance wants to make a move, they will have to weigh the consequences carefully."
"What if we encounter powerhouses who are also from Golden Holy Mountain?"
Camille asked another question.
Daniel turned his head and looked at her. The smile on his lips did not change in the slightest.
"Then we seize it all the same!"
"Being timid and hesitant has never been my nature. My style has only one rule—advance without turning back!"
"I don’t care who they are. Take it first, then talk!"
He deployed the plan in an orderly manner.
All players who participated in the campaign against the small worlds would receive a large number of points.
In this way, the points the players needed to break through beyond supreme-grade would also have a source.

"I will sell treasures that are crucial to the players, and the players will pay with labor and time in exchange for the capital to become stronger. Meanwhile, I will extract even greater profits from the players and from the territory itself."
"With this, everyone benefits."
Daniel nodded in satisfaction.
Next, he still needed to formulate the Astral Corsairs’ plundering strategy.
"I hold the Millionfold Boost system in my hands. I must continuously gather resources and stack them layer upon layer. Only by doing so can I maximize the benefits!"
Besides that...
He took a giant egg out of his pack.
The giant egg was completely black, like ink. On its surface, faint glimmers resembling flowing galaxies could vaguely be seen. It emitted an ancient, profound, and boundless aura.
It was a Starbeast egg.
"I need to create an avatar first. An avatar using a Starbeast as its vessel... it is practically tailor-made for me."
