Daniel shouted in a low voice.
His voice exploded like thunder in the depths of everyone’s soul.
That heaven-covering giant palm came crashing down.

Within the miniature Astral Realm in its palm, endless divine power, Immortal Singularity, and fragments of Law erupted like a volcano, unleashing terrifying might capable of tearing apart the star sea.
Rumble!
The giant palm suddenly slammed down.
The many Divine-grade powerhouses of the Council of the Gods roared furiously and unleashed their sage power one after another, each using secret arts as they desperately tried to resist.
However—
Crack, crack, crack...
A series of crisp sounds exploded one after another.
Those were the sounds of bones shattering and sage power collapsing, especially piercing in the void.
The Divine-grade powerhouses of the Council of the Gods were forcefully suppressed in place by that giant palm.
Endless Strength swept in from every direction like a tide, grinding them down.
It was as though they were not facing a single demi-sage rank, but an invincible army made up entirely of demi-sage-rank existences!
It was as though what they resisted was not the power of one world, but the weight of countless worlds crushing down at the same time.
Under this terrifying force, low-grade sages did not even have time to scream before they were reduced directly to ash.
Mid-grade sages could only barely endure for two or three seconds before their sage power shattered, their sacred bodies collapsed, and they turned into insignificant dust within the star sea.
Only those high-grade sages could barely withstand it for a moment, yet they too suffered heavy Origin injuries in an instant.
Their sage power was like glass struck by a heavy hammer, covered in dense cracks.
Their sacred bodies withered, and their Origin faded, like candles extinguished by a violent gale.
With this one palm from Daniel, several hundred Divine-grade powerhouses were all executed!
[Ding!
You have killed a Divine-grade powerhouse, Council of the Gods low-grade sage.
You have obtained Origin Crystal × 100 cubic units!]
[Ding!
You sold Origin Crystal × 100 cubic units to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The sold item is a currency-type item.
Please choose quality boost/quantity boost!]
"Quantity boost!"
[Congratulations!
You have obtained 1 gold coin!
You have obtained Origin Crystal × 100,000,000 cubic units!]
[Ding!
You have killed a Divine-grade powerhouse, Council of the Gods mid-grade sage.
You have obtained Origin Crystal × 120 cubic units!]
[Ding!
You sold Origin Crystal × 120 cubic units to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
Repeating process...
You have obtained Origin Crystal × 120,000,000 cubic units!]
[Ding!
You have killed a Divine-grade powerhouse, Council of the Gods high-grade sage.
You have obtained Origin Crystal × 150 cubic units!]
You have obtained Origin Crystal × 150,000,000 cubic units!]
System notifications exploded one after another beside Daniel’s ears.
After the fall of several hundred Divine-grade powerhouses, an enormous amount of Origin Crystals dropped.
After being enhanced by Millionfold Boost, they all fell into his pocket.
Those cold numbers jumped before his eyes, yet they failed to stir even the slightest ripple in his heart.
Daniel’s strike was incomparably domineering, like the descent of a main god.
Low-grade and mid-grade sages died on the spot.
Only a few high-grade sages luckily escaped through the gaps between the fingers of the palm, drenched in blood and in an extremely wretched state.
"Vice Speaker... run!"
"That man... that man is a monster!"
The voice of one surviving high-grade sage was shrill.
Cracks continued spreading across his sacred body, and blood gushed out like spring water.
"I have never seen such a terrifying quasi-sage before.
He is simply horrifying beyond belief!"
"If I take another strike from him, I will definitely die too!
Run!"
Another powerhouse screamed at the top of his lungs, his eyes filled with fear.
Sean had been commanding from afar all along and had not personally entered the battlefield.
At this moment, the sudden change before his eyes left him completely frozen in place.
Several hundred Divine-grade powerhouses.
Several hundred!
Yet they could not even withstand a single palm strike from one quasi-sage?
A name suddenly flashed through his mind like a bolt of icy lightning splitting open the chaos.
Faustus!
The strongest quasi-sage in the current Myriad-Star Cosmos!

chapters.title: Chapter 322 -322-No Manners at All
paragraphs: "Could that person... be Faustus?"
Sean murmured to himself, his lips turning pale.
At this moment, Faustus was already the most sensational figure in the Myriad-Star Cosmos.
His portrait and name had spread like wildfire, sweeping across every corner of the universe.
Sean had actually seen his portrait before. He simply had not dared to confirm it earlier.
But now, he could say it with absolute certainty—
He had tried to rob Faustus!
That, in itself, was not the biggest problem.
The real problem was... he had offended him to death!
"Faustus... he really is a legendary monster!"
Sean’s heart pounded wildly in his chest, and his mind went completely blank.
This was absurd beyond belief. A mere quasi-sage was able to instantly kill Divine-grade powerhouses and even severely injure high-grade sages!
You call this a quasi-sage?
Are you sure this isn’t death itself wearing human skin?
"Go! Run!"
Sean instantly lost all will to fight. Only one thought remained in his mind—
Escape!
He turned and fled, not daring to look back.
"What a pity about those sages of my Council of the Gods..."
Sean gritted his teeth, secretly hating Faustus for his ruthlessness. With one palm strike, he had crushed so many Divine-grade powerhouses to death.
That was the foundation the Council of the Gods had accumulated over millions of years!
"When I return, the Speaker will never let me off easily..."
His figure transformed into a stream of light and vanished into the vast star sea.
Behind him, the Imperial Bow Ark still hovered silently in the void. The starlight on its hull flickered coldly, as if mocking every enemy who had overestimated themselves.
Daniel watched as those high-grade sages scattered in all directions like a school of frightened fish. The corners of his lips slowly curled into a cold arc.
"Now you know fear?"
He murmured softly, his voice carrying unquestionable killing intent.
He slowly extended his right hand. In his palm, a Holy Grail appeared out of thin air—
The Voidbound Grail!
The body of the Holy Grail was engraved with countless flowing star tracks and patterns of spatial cracks, as if it had once held an entire frozen galaxy.
"You want to run? I haven’t even given you permission yet. No manners at all!"
If a sage was determined to flee, it was extremely difficult for a quasi-sage to catch up.
Daniel had been helpless against this in the past. He could only watch his prey slip away before his eyes.
But now, things were different.
He held the Voidbound Grail in his palm, sensing the dormant power of space-time within it.
This Holy Grail was one of the championship rewards from the Starlight Rankings Tournament. It was a top-grade Divine-grade space-time secret treasure.
Not only could it break through no-flight formations, it could also reverse-seal space, turning an entire region of void into an invisible and intangible cage.
And the key to that cage was held by Daniel alone.
"Go!"
Daniel released his hand, and the Holy Grail spun into the air under the control of his mind power.
Its mouth faced downward, pouring out a mist of blue light.
Buzz, buzz, buzz—

Waves of invisible space-time ripples spread from the rim of the Holy Grail. Like a drop of ink falling into a calm lake, the ripples expanded layer after layer, covering a million miles of void in the blink of an eye.
Every place touched by the ripples instantly froze in space.
Within the invisible starry sky, an unseen gigantic wall appeared out of nowhere, so solid that not even molecules could pass through it.
The fleeing high-grade sages were like trains rushing at full speed through a tunnel, only to crash violently into an invisible wall.
Amid thunderous explosions, they were shaken until their heads spun. Some even spat blood on the spot.
"Oh no! Space has been sealed!"
Sean’s expression changed drastically. His heart nearly exploded out of his chest.
"We... we’ve become insects trapped in a cage..."
The other powerhouses’ faces were filled with deep despair, as if they could already see the scythe of death pressed against their necks.
"We can’t leave!"
"He’s not demi-sage rank at all! He’s an ancient magical beast wearing human skin!"
The Voidbound Grail hung high above the sky, emitting a cold, glow.
Even if a peak Divine-grade powerhouse descended, they would not be able to easily break through the spatial seal of this secret treasure.
The Holy Grail suddenly trembled, and another, denser ring of space-time ripples spread outward.
The moment those powerhouses were touched by the ripples, they felt their Strength rapidly draining away, as if a greedy mouth was madly sucking the divine energy from their bodies.
"Sage rank!"
Sean was horrified. He hurriedly unleashed his own sage-rank domain, trying to resist that invisible devouring force.

However, his sage-rank domain, which had once been fairly decent, could now barely expand to a range of one hundred miles under the suppression of the Holy Grail. It had been weakened by an unknown number of times!
At this moment, it was only barely comparable to the sage-rank domain of a low-grade sage. It was pitifully weak.
The Voidbound Grail was terrifying indeed!
Sean felt despair seep deep into his bones. It was a kind of powerlessness that could not be broken free from no matter how hard he struggled.
He raised his head and looked at the Holy Grail hanging above him.
"Celestial Grasp!"
Daniel did not give them even the slightest chance to catch their breath.
He raised his right arm. His palm rapidly expanded in the void, transforming in an instant into a gigantic hand that blotted out the sky and covered all the battered high-grade sages beneath it.
Within the palm, layers upon layers of world projections revolved, while galaxies spun and coiled.
Rumble—!
Inside the palm, surging Strength boiled and churned like a volcano, carrying the weight of countless worlds as it crushed downward.
Those high-grade sages were already heavily injured. On top of that, they had been weakened by the Holy Grail. How could they possibly withstand such a world-destroying palm strike?
With one palm, all the enemies were slain, turning into silent dust within the star sea.
[Ding! You have killed a Divine-grade powerhouse: Council of the Gods high-grade sage. You have obtained Origin Crystal ×200 cubic units!]
[Ding! You have sold Origin Crystal ×200 cubic units to the Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost! Please choose quality boost or quantity boost!]
"Quantity boost!"
[Congratulations! You have obtained 1 gold coin! You have obtained Origin Crystal ×200,000,000 cubic units!]
[Ding! You have killed a Divine-grade powerhouse: Council of the Gods high-grade sage. You have obtained Origin Crystal ×230 cubic units!]
[...You have obtained Origin Crystal ×230,000,000 cubic units!]
[Ding! You have killed the Divine-grade powerhouse Sean, Deputy Speaker of the Council of the Gods. You have obtained Origin Crystal ×1,150 cubic units!]
[...You have obtained Origin Crystal ×1,150,000,000 cubic units!]
Daniel listened to the system notifications exploding repeatedly in his ears, yet he did not even lift his eyelids.
Although this wave of gains had cost him absolutely nothing, he had experienced far greater harvests countless times before.
This bit of Origin Crystal was no longer enough to stir even the slightest ripple in his heart. It was like pouring another bucket of water into a vast ocean. Not even a splash would appear.
After Daniel completely suppressed and killed the many powerhouses of the Council of the Gods, he casually recalled the Voidbound Grail.
The Holy Grail slowly spun in the air, then transformed into a blue stream of light and sank into his palm, as quiet as a sleeping little beast.
"This Holy Grail will become stronger and stronger as my own strength increases."
Daniel thought to himself.
The reason he had not exchanged for other offensive Divine-grade secret treasures was because, with the Voidbound Grail in hand, his offensive weapon was already more than sufficient.
Especially because of this Holy Grail’s unique trait—

It could grow stronger as its user’s strength increased. Like a loyal comrade-in-arms, the stronger Daniel became, the stronger it would become as well, and the denser the space-time power it contained would be.
If Daniel achieved peak Divine-grade in the future, suppressing powerhouses of the same rank with this treasure would be as easy as crushing a group of ants.
Even if he encountered existences above sage rank but below Oracle-grade, he would still not fall into a disadvantage!

chapters.title: Chapter 323 -323-Chaos Star Sea, the Fallen Land
paragraphs: Aside from that, the great Sacred Art, Celestial Grasp, was also extremely compatible with Daniel, as if it had been tailor-made for him.
This Sacred Art allowed him to bring his endless Strength to its fullest potential, like carving out a channel through which an entire ocean could finally pour.
Without Celestial Grasp, Daniel could still instantly kill a low-grade sage. However, when facing a mid-grade sage, it would have been slightly less clean and satisfying.
It would be like cutting flesh with a blunt blade—messy, slow, and lacking decisiveness. It would have been even more impossible for him to easily severely injure a high-grade sage.
But with this great Sacred Art, he could slap a mid-grade sage to death with a single palm and effortlessly beat a high-grade sage half to death without the slightest delay.
Daniel withdrew his gaze and turned around, flying back to the Imperial Bow Ark.

Behind him, the void was deathly silent. Only the shattered remnants of sage ranks and the wreckage of Starships floating in the star sea remained, silently recounting the one-sided massacre that had just taken place.
Daniel flew toward the nearby trade Starship that belonged to Windrest World.
The powerhouses aboard had already been completely wiped out during the previous battle. At this moment, the entire ship was empty, leaving only a cargo hold packed full of goods.
The trade Starship had become ownerless property.
Without expending the slightest effort, Daniel had obtained a merchant ship for free.
The Council of the Gods had busied themselves for so long, but in the end, everything they had done had merely served to make wedding clothes for Daniel. All of it had benefited him instead.
Daniel opened the Starship’s cargo hold and pocketed all the goods inside.
[Ding! You have obtained Origin Crystal ×300,000 cubic units!]
[Ding! You have sold Origin Crystal ×300,000 cubic units to the Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
"Quantity boost!"
[Congratulations! You have obtained 1 gold coin! You have obtained Origin Crystal ×30,000,000,000 cubic units!]
"Not bad."
Listening to the system notification ringing in his ears, Daniel’s lips curved slightly upward.
The top-tier currency of the Endless Starsea was Origin Crystal.
Back then, his entire net worth combined had only been worth 1 cubic unit of Origin Crystal.
And the wealthiest high-grade sage he had killed just now had only possessed a total fortune of 1,150 cubic units.
Yet this one Starship alone was worth 300,000 cubic units. It was clear that this harvest was indeed substantial.
"This Starship can’t be wasted either."
As Daniel spoke, he took away the Starship as well.
In the treasury of Gold Holy Mountain, exchanging for a Starship of this level would cost several thousand points.
And if he exchanged it back to Gold Holy Mountain, he could at least earn more than one thousand points!
Daniel returned to the Imperial Bow Ark.
"Break the boundary!"

He immediately activated the Imperial Bow Ark’s boundary-breaking trait, easily tearing apart the low-grade no-flight formation set up by the Council of the Gods. Then, he continued traveling through the starry sky.
Aside from the Voidbound Grail possessing the ability to break boundaries, the Imperial Bow Ark also possessed boundary-breaking power.
Daniel did not take a no-flight formation of this level seriously at all.
Unless he encountered some truly top-tier no-flight method, it would not cause him any real trouble.
"Divine-grade secret treasures related to space-time laws are all extremely precious in the Endless Starsea."
Daniel thought to himself.
"It is only because I possess the Millionfold Boost system and have an almost limitless foundation that I can own such a treasure!"
"Even among peak Divine-grade powerhouses, not everyone can take out something like this."
The Imperial Bow Ark continued its voyage.
After some time, it finally arrived at the Budelica starfield.
Along the way, he did not encounter any more kind-hearted people like the Council of the Gods.
The journey was smooth and peaceful, and he arrived safely.
Daniel canceled the Imperial Bow Ark’s spatial leap function and slowly sailed through the starry sky of the Budelica starfield.
"Dustin, James, Mosi—long time no see!"
Sacred Guard World.
The Imperial Bow Ark hovered above the plane of Sacred Guard World.
At this moment, countless Starships had already gathered here like stars surrounding the moon, densely suspended in the void.
Within the plane, countless powerhouses were also flying out one after another.
Whoosh—!
The Imperial Bow Ark transformed into a streak of light and dissipated.
At the same time, Daniel and Camille appeared out of thin air in the void.
"Sacred Guard World..."
Daniel sized up the grand and magnificent plane before him.
Sacred Guard World was an open great world. It was also the most prosperous great world for trade in this galaxy.
Calling it a super trade hub would not be an exaggeration.
This was the meeting place Daniel had agreed upon with Dustin, James, and Mosi.
"Let’s go in."
Daniel said to Camille.
Camille’s eyes were filled with anticipation.
Inside a luxurious hall somewhere in Sacred Guard World.
Daniel, Camille, Dustin, James, and Mosi—
Five quasi-sages had gathered together.
Half a year had passed, but everyone’s appearance and aura had not changed much at all, as if those six months had been nothing more than the blink of an eye.
At this moment, they were discussing how to head to the Chaosverse.
That was because the Astral Realm was located precisely within the Chaosverse!
Dustin slowly looked around at everyone. Starlight reflected in his eyes, which were deep as the night sky.
He leaned forward slightly.
"Between universe and universe, there is still a vast and boundless ’star sea’!"
James leaned against his stone chair, the corners of his mouth lifting into a knowing smile.
"I know that too."
He said softly, his tone carrying a trace of leisure.

"The ’star sea’ is merely another name for the Chaos Sea. The major universes are separated by the Chaos Sea. Universes are like islands scattered across a vast ocean, gazing at one another from afar, yet divided by an abyss that cannot be easily crossed."
Dustin nodded approvingly.
"That’s right."
He stood up and paced with his hands behind his back.
"No one knows exactly how vast the Endless Starsea truly is, because the Chaos Sea is almost boundless. Its end is hidden in a corner forgotten even by time itself."
"The major universes known today are nothing more than an insignificant corner of this endless ocean, like a few unremarkable grains of sand on a beach."
He paused for a moment. His gaze turned toward the deep night sky outside the hall, and his tone became solemn.
"There were even great Oracle-grade beings who once attempted to explore the boundaries of the Endless Starfield!"

"Across countless eras, countless great Oracle-grade beings advanced one after another like moths flying into a flame. But they still failed to uncover the answer. Instead, they were buried in the depths of the star sea, in that deathly region known as the ’Fallen Sea.’"
"That place is piled with the bones of countless pioneers. Every skeleton silently tells of the cruelty of the star sea."
Dustin turned around. A bitter smile hung on his lips as he continued.
"The star sea is not only boundless, but also filled with danger. It shows no mercy to any intruder."
"Only powerhouses above peak Divine-grade can physically cross that Chaos Sea!"
"Ordinary sages simply cannot withstand the ’Chaotic Essence’ within the star sea, which is powerful enough to corrode the soul and tear apart consciousness."
Hearing this, Daniel felt stormy waves surge through his heart.
Unimaginable!
Even supreme beings like great Oracle-grade powerhouses could not finish exploring the star sea?
Instead, they could even fall within it?
This was simply too inconceivable!
However, Daniel was not completely ignorant.
He knew that the difficulty of physically crossing the star sea was no different from a mortal climbing a tower that pierced the heavens with bare hands.
Only powerhouses above peak Divine-grade possessed such strength and qualifications.
Otherwise, it was no different from courting death.
In lighter cases, they would fall into a dazed and muddled state, becoming lost forever in the endless Chaos Sea, unable to find their way back.
In more serious cases...
The Fallen Sea, piled high with the corpses of countless Oracle-grade beings, was a living example!
It was like a silent tombstone, warning every latecomer.
The deeper one ventured into the star sea, the more dangerous it became.
Even powerhouses above peak Divine-grade only dared to linger around its outer region.
They were like travelers testing the edge of an abyss, never daring to take even half a step deeper!

And the wealthiest high-grade sage he had killed just now had only possessed a total fortune of 1,150 cubic units.
Yet this one Starship alone was worth 300,000 cubic units.
It was clear that this harvest was indeed substantial.
"This Starship can’t be wasted either."
As Daniel spoke, he took away the Starship as well.
In the treasury of Gold Holy Mountain, exchanging for a Starship of this level would cost several thousand points.
And if he exchanged it back to Gold Holy Mountain, he could at least earn more than one thousand points!
Daniel returned to the Imperial Bow Ark.
"Break the boundary!"
He immediately activated the Imperial Bow Ark’s boundary-breaking trait, easily tearing apart the low-grade no-flight formation set up by the Council of the Gods.
Then, he continued traveling through the starry sky.
Aside from the Voidbound Grail possessing the ability to break boundaries, the Imperial Bow Ark also possessed boundary-breaking power.
Daniel did not take a no-flight formation of this level seriously at all.
Unless he encountered some truly top-tier no-flight method, it would not cause him any real trouble.
"Divine-grade secret treasures related to space-time laws are all extremely precious in the Endless Starsea."
Daniel thought to himself.
"It is only because I possess the Millionfold Boost system and have an almost limitless foundation that I can own such a treasure!"
"Even among peak Divine-grade powerhouses, not everyone can take out something like this."
The Imperial Bow Ark continued its voyage.
After some time, it finally arrived at the Budelica starfield.
Along the way, he did not encounter any more kind-hearted people like the Council of the Gods.
The journey was smooth and peaceful, and he arrived safely.
Daniel canceled the Imperial Bow Ark’s spatial leap function and slowly sailed through the starry sky of the Budelica starfield.
"Dustin, James, Mosi—long time no see!"
Sacred Guard World.
The Imperial Bow Ark hovered above the plane of Sacred Guard World.
At this moment, countless Starships had already gathered here like stars surrounding the moon, densely suspended in the void.
Within the plane, countless powerhouses were also flying out one after another.
Whoosh—!
The Imperial Bow Ark transformed into a streak of light and dissipated.
At the same time, Daniel and Camille appeared out of thin air in the void.
"Sacred Guard World..."
Daniel sized up the grand and magnificent plane before him.
Sacred Guard World was an open great world.
It was also the most prosperous great world for trade in this galaxy.
Calling it a super trade hub would not be an exaggeration.
This was the meeting place Daniel had agreed upon with Dustin, James, and Mosi.
"Let’s go in."
Daniel said to Camille.
Camille’s eyes were filled with anticipation.
Inside a luxurious hall somewhere in Sacred Guard World.
Daniel, Camille, Dustin, James, and Mosi—
Five quasi-sages had gathered together.
Half a year had passed, but everyone’s appearance and aura had not changed much at all, as if those six months had been nothing more than the blink of an eye.
At this moment, they were discussing how to head to the Chaosverse.
That was because the Astral Realm was located precisely within the Chaosverse!
Dustin slowly looked around at everyone.
Starlight reflected in his eyes, which were deep as the night sky.
He leaned forward slightly.
"Between universe and universe, there is still a vast and boundless ’star sea’!"
James leaned against his stone chair, the corners of his mouth lifting into a knowing smile.
"I know that too."
He said softly, his tone carrying a trace of leisure.
"The ’star sea’ is merely another name for the Chaos Sea.
The major universes are separated by the Chaos Sea.
Universes are like islands scattered across a vast ocean, gazing at one another from afar, yet divided by an abyss that cannot be easily crossed."
Dustin nodded approvingly.
"That’s right."
He stood up and paced with his hands behind his back.
"No one knows exactly how vast the Endless Starsea truly is, because the Chaos Sea is almost boundless.
Its end is hidden in a corner forgotten even by time itself."
"The major universes known today are nothing more than an insignificant corner of this endless ocean, like a few unremarkable grains of sand on a beach."
He paused for a moment.
His gaze turned toward the deep night sky outside the hall, and his tone became solemn.
"There were even great Oracle-grade beings who once attempted to explore the boundaries of the Endless Starfield!"
"Across countless eras, countless great Oracle-grade beings advanced one after another like moths flying into a flame.
But they still failed to uncover the answer.
Instead, they were buried in the depths of the star sea, in that deathly region known as the ’Fallen Sea.’"
"That place is piled with the bones of countless pioneers.
Every skeleton silently tells of the cruelty of the star sea."
Dustin turned around.
A bitter smile hung on his lips as he continued.
"The star sea is not only boundless, but also filled with danger.
It shows no mercy to any intruder."
"Only powerhouses above peak Divine-grade can physically cross that Chaos Sea!"
"Ordinary sages simply cannot withstand the ’Chaotic Essence’ within the star sea, which is powerful enough to corrode the soul and tear apart consciousness."
Hearing this, Daniel felt stormy waves surge through his heart.
Unimaginable!
Even supreme beings like great Oracle-grade powerhouses could not finish exploring the star sea?
Instead, they could even fall within it?
This was simply too inconceivable!
However, Daniel was not completely ignorant.
He knew that the difficulty of physically crossing the star sea was no different from a mortal climbing a tower that pierced the heavens with bare hands.
Only powerhouses above peak Divine-grade possessed such strength and qualifications.
Otherwise, it was no different from courting death.
In lighter cases, they would fall into a dazed and muddled state, becoming lost forever in the endless Chaos Sea, unable to find their way back.
In more serious cases...
The Fallen Sea, piled high with the corpses of countless Oracle-grade beings, was a living example!
It was like a silent tombstone, warning every latecomer.
The deeper one ventured into the star sea, the more dangerous it became.
Even powerhouses above peak Divine-grade only dared to linger around its outer region.
They were like travelers testing the edge of an abyss, never daring to take even half a step deeper!

chapters.title: Chapter 324 -324-Millionfold Boost Cap Unlocked
paragraphs: "So, Dustin, what you mean is... we need to cross the Chaos star sea in order to reach the Chaosverse?"
Daniel frowned, a trace of surprise in his voice.
"Hiss..."
Camille listened from the side, utterly dumbfounded.
Mosi also looked at Dustin in confusion. Although he did not speak, his cold, stern face was filled with incomprehension.
Clearly, the shock in his heart was no less than anyone else’s.
"That’s right."
Dustin’s tone remained calm and unhurried.
"When I came here, I relied on a cosmic spatial passage opened for me by a great Oracle-grade being. I won’t have that kind of top-tier treatment on the way back."
"So, I can only cross the star sea and return to the Chaosverse myself."
His tone suddenly changed. He raised one hand, signaling everyone to stay calm.
"But you don’t need to worry too much."
The heavy pressure in the air seemed to be gently brushed away.
A trace of pride flashed through Dustin’s eyes. He slowly took out an object from his robes, one that emitted an ancient and simple radiance.
The light was warm and smooth like jade, yet it faintly carried a terrifying pressure that made one’s heart tremble.
"I have a top-grade Divine-grade secret treasure that an elder of my clan specially lent to me."
Dustin’s fingertips gently brushed over the outline of the treasure.
"This treasure is a Primordial Law Grade supreme treasure—rare in the world. Even Oracle-grade beings would look at it with interest."

"Controlling it to cross the star sea is like strolling through one’s own garden, as easy as walking on flat ground. In terms of defense, it can calmly withstand a full-force strike from an Oracle-grade being. Our safety is absolutely guaranteed."

"Even those chaotic star beasts in the star sea, famous for their ferocity, can only return defeated before this treasure. It is said that its creator once used a drop of great Oracle-grade blood as the catalyst and fused it with the essence of an entire galaxy before finally forging it."
"This is a true top-grade treasure!"
When James heard this, burning light burst from his eyes.
He could not help but lean forward.
"Sir Dustin, could you let us take a look at this treasure? Even if it is only from afar!"
Dustin gave a light cough and calmly put the treasure back into his robes without making a sound.
"My apologies. This treasure is of great importance."
His tone was courteous and polite, but it left no room for discussion.
In the star sea, showing off often attracted disaster faster than silence.
This was a lesson countless sages had paid for with blood.
"Hahaha..."
James raised his head and laughed, his laughter bright and carefree.
He leaned back against his chair again, crossing his hands behind his head.

"Sir Dustin, please don’t mind me. I was the one being a little offensive. In any case, it won’t be long before we use this treasure to cross that Chaos Sea. When the time comes, we’ll naturally have the chance to personally experience its wonders."
Only now did he react.
No matter what, Dustin was currently staying alone in this universe.
Keeping a low profile was undoubtedly his wisest choice.
At the edge of the Myriad-Star Cosmos.
Within the dim void, Dustin took out a Divine-grade secret treasure shaped like a round shield—
The Shield of Aegis!

The entire shield was dark gold in color. Its surface was carved with a terrifying relief of a snake-haired demoness. The snake hair twisted like living things, writhing slightly in the void, as if they could break free from the shield’s surface at any moment.

A circle of dense runes was embedded along the shield’s edge. Faint lightning and starlight flowed across them, releasing a pressure that made the soul tremble, like a relic of a God King passed down from a legendary age.
"This is the Shield of Aegis. It is a Primordial Law Grade Sacred Artifact."
Dustin explained with a smile, his palm gently brushing over the snake-haired relief on the surface of the shield.
The shield immediately let out a deep hum, like a colossal beast sleeping in the abyss being awakened.
"With this treasure here, no matter how violent the Chaotic Essence in the star sea becomes, it won’t be able to harm us in the slightest."
"What a good treasure!"
James sized up the treasure, his eyes full of amazement.

"With a Divine-grade secret treasure of this level, there’s no need to fear cosmic storms. The edge of this shield is incredibly sharp. If it charged forward at full force, I’m afraid even stars would be sliced apart by it!"
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Daniel, Camille, James, and Mosi transformed into streams of light one after another and entered the internal space of the Shield of Aegis.

The world inside the shield suddenly opened up before them. Warm, thick golden light filled the surroundings, making them feel as though they were inside a moving divine temple. It gave them an incomparable sense of security.
"Awaken, sacred shield!"
Dustin clenched both hands in the air. Divine energy surged wildly around him and poured into the Shield of Aegis.

The lightning runes along the edge of the shield suddenly lit up. Like an ancient divine beast breaking free from its shackles, it easily tore open a deep rift in the barrier of the Myriad-Star Cosmos and plunged headfirst into the vast, boundless star sea.
Ripples appeared around the edge of the tear in the cosmic barrier.
In the blink of an eye, it healed on its own.
The power of the universe’s Origin was endless and vast. A tear of this level was insignificant to it.
Buzz—!
The Shield of Aegis appeared within the star sea.
The star sea was hazy and chaotic. Boundless chaos flowed there for all eternity.
At that moment, a grand and icy voice suddenly exploded deep within Daniel’s mind!
[Ding! You have stepped into the Chaos star sea and completed the unique hidden achievement: "First Person Beneath the Boundless Starry Sky"!]
Daniel felt his entire body tremble.
[Notice: You have completed the achievement "First Person Beneath the Boundless Starry Sky." Special effect activated—the cap of Millionfold Boost has been fully unlocked!]
[From this moment onward, all equipment, resources, secret treasures, Holy Relics, and other items you obtain can undergo higher-level boosts. There will no longer be any shackles!]
Daniel froze.
He stood there in a daze, the cold and sacred notification echoing beside his ears.
In his pupils, the hazy and chaotic star sea outside the shield was reflected.
The cap of Millionfold Boost... had been fully unlocked?
He could hardly believe his ears.
Before this, although his boost ability was heaven-defying, there had always been some invisible ceiling.
Certain treasures that were too high-level could not be boosted. Certain quality boundaries could not be crossed.
But now, the moment he stepped into this Chaos star sea, that invisible shackle had shattered with a thunderous crash!
A surge of wild joy rose from the bottom of his heart.
"Excellent!"
He clenched his fists, his eyes flashing with a light he could not suppress.

From now on, no matter what level of equipment, resources, or Divine-grade secret treasures he obtained, they could all transform into even higher-grade existences under the mighty power of Millionfold Boost.
This meant that a Primordial Grade Star Relic could become a Primordial Law Grade supreme treasure in his hands.
An ordinary Sacred Material could surge and transform into a rare treasure that even Oracle-grade beings would covet.
He took a deep breath and forced that excitement back into his chest, but the corners of his mouth still rose uncontrollably.
The Chaos star sea truly was the most mysterious place in the Endless Starfield!
Ahead of him, countless opportunities were still waiting.
And once those opportunities were baptized by Millionfold Boost, what kind of dazzling brilliance would they bloom with?
The light in Daniel’s eyes burned even brighter than the stars.

chapters.title: Chapter 325 -325-The Eruption of the Universe’s Treasury
paragraphs: Inside the Shield of Aegis.
At this moment, all four powerhouses were immersed in shock. Through the transparent barrier along the edge of the shield, they sensed the vastness of the star sea.
"By the way, what exactly does Chaotic Essence look like?"
James wondered inwardly.
"Look over there!"
Just then, Daniel suddenly pointed into the distance.
The others followed the direction of his finger and looked over.
They saw a four-armed giant who stood a full hundred thousand meters tall, sleeping within the Chaos star sea.
When he inhaled, the gray mist swirling around him seemed to be devoured by an invisible gigantic mouth. It churned and poured into his nostrils and enormous mouth.
And when he exhaled, that gray mist surged out from within his body, like the breath of an ancient colossal beast, stirring up a violent storm in the void.
That gray mist was Chaotic Essence!
It contained a violent Strength powerful enough to tear apart souls and devour reason.
"That is Chaotic Essence."
Dustin’s gaze was as calm as still water.
"This super powerhouse is using Chaotic Essence to temper his body."
A sharp gleam flashed in Daniel’s eyes.
"If he can use Chaotic Essence to temper himself, he is definitely an existence above sage rank."
"That’s right. Perhaps he is a Divine Radiant, or perhaps a Divine Sovereign."
James agreed, his tone carrying a hint of respect.
"Strong."
Mosi uttered a single word. Yet within his usually cold eyes, a rare trace of solemnity flashed past.
"This powerhouse’s attainments in the path of the battle body have probably already reached the pinnacle."
Camille sighed softly, her eyes filled with awe.
The Shield of Aegis silently cut through the chaos, leaving the towering figure of the one-eyed giant far behind.
Daniel had originally been filled with curiosity toward the Chaos star sea, but after looking at it for too long, he also began to find it dull.
Although the scenery of the star sea was magnificent, it was ultimately too monotonous. The same endless gray mist flowed past his eyes, like old pages that could never be fully turned.
Just then—
A dazzling light suddenly lit up ahead!
Hm?
What was going on?
"A treasure has appeared!"
Dustin looked at the light before them, his voice carrying a trace of excitement.
"Our luck is quite good. We happened to pass by during an eruption of Star Relics. Treasures born in the star sea are extremely rare, and every eruption is accompanied by countless opportunities."
"What a pity that we’re only passing through and can’t personally take part."
Camille felt regretful inside and sighed.
"That’s right. We are only quasi-sages, so we’re still not qualified to enter the field."
Dustin agreed.
"Even peak Divine-grade powerhouses would find it difficult. The weakest among those existences fighting over the treasures could casually crush us to death."
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
Although he could not personally participate in the fight, it was still not bad to broaden his horizons.

According to Dustin, the treasures produced within the Chaos star sea were all extremely powerful. Every single one of them could potentially be a Holy Relic that some great Oracle-grade being had pursued for their entire life!
Ahead, the star sea shone with boundless radiance. Countless figures crisscrossed through it, flying back and forth like participants in a grand star sea hunt.
The Shield of Aegis moved a little closer, and only then did Daniel and the others finally see clearly.
So the dazzling light was actually being emitted by the treasures themselves!

Countless Star Relics were surrounded by brilliant radiance. They surged out from all directions like fountains erupting from the depths of the earth, illuminating this dim star sea until it was bright as day.

They flew wildly in every direction, scattering streams of light everywhere. It was as though the treasury of some ancient god had shattered in the void, and countless treasures were scrambling to escape their cage, fleeing toward the end of the star sea.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Countless powerhouses had already been lying in wait throughout the star sea.
When they saw the Star Relics erupting like a torrential rain, greed and fanaticism ignited in their eyes.
Secret arts were unleashed one after another. Secret treasures were activated one after another. The powerhouses chased after and subdued those agile treasures like fishermen casting nets.

However, those Star Relics seemed to possess wills of their own. Although they were not as strong as the powerhouses, they relied on their unique abilities to frantically dodge, like frightened schools of fish weaving and struggling through the gaps of a fishing net.
Daniel looked at this noisy, bustling scene, and a faint smile unconsciously appeared at the corner of his mouth.
How lively!
The Endless Starfield truly contained opportunities everywhere.
This star sea never showed mercy to anyone, yet it was never stingy with its gifts either.
Daniel was not the only one feeling emotional. The other powerhouses were also moved in their own ways.
To some people, the Chaos star sea was a legend they could never touch in their lifetime, an ethereal ballad sung by wandering bards.
And yet at this moment, they were standing within that very legend.

The treasure land of the star sea was like a boiling furnace. Star Relics gushed out like fountains, and like schools of fish leaping from the ocean surface, they drew countless brilliant streaks of light through the void.
The powerhouses were like experienced fishermen, casting down invisible nets one after another as they competed to harvest this gift from the star sea.
At this moment, the entire star sea seemed to be burning.
Meanwhile, the Shield of Aegis had already quietly entered the range of the treasure land.
Through the semi-transparent barrier of the shield, Daniel and the others could see the distant scene even more clearly.
"Look! They’re fighting over there!"
James suddenly pointed into the distance, his voice carrying a trace of suppressed excitement.
"They probably set their eyes on the same Star Relic at the same time and drew their blades against each other."
Dustin chuckled, calmly watching the slaughter as if he were enjoying a play that had nothing to do with him.
Rumble—rumble—!
The two powerhouses fought until heaven and earth seemed to collapse. Every collision shook the surrounding space, sending ripples scattering in all directions.

One of them emitted a hazy radiance from his entire body. Six arms grew from his back, and each hand held a Divine-grade secret treasure, making him look like a war god who had walked out of an ancient legendary age.

The other had only one arm. His remaining right arm tightly gripped a pitch-black lance. Terrifying black lightning coiled around the spearhead, and every thrust carried a shriek that seemed capable of tearing the void apart.
And at this moment, the one with the upper hand was actually the one-armed powerhouse!
The lance in his hand was terrifying beyond compare. The spearhead condensed pure power of the law of destruction, and every strike was like the whisper of death.

The six-armed powerhouse did not dare to block it head-on at all. Earlier, when he had clashed with it directly several times, not only had two of his secret treasures been destroyed, but two of his arms had also been severed, leaving him in an utterly miserable state.
"That six-armed powerhouse is at the Divine Radiant level."
A layer of golden light covered Dustin’s eyes. Some kind of detection secret art was clearly operating as he slowly spoke.
"The one-armed powerhouse is a Divine Sovereign. He controls the law of destruction. He is certain to win!"
"The gap between Divine Sovereign and Divine Radiant is even greater than the gap between Divine Radiant and peak Divine-grade."
Before his words had even finished, the one-armed powerhouse thrust his lance forward.
Puchi—!
The black lightning on the spearhead slipped into his opponent’s shoulder like a serpent’s tongue, then exploded with a roar.
One of the six-armed powerhouse’s arms once again turned into blood mist and shattered bone, splattering wildly through the void.
His broken body panicked. He did not even dare to turn his head as he fled.
However, the one-armed powerhouse did not give chase. He merely turned around and continued pursuing the Star Relic that had caused the conflict.
That was the only thing he cared about.

Dustin looked at the light before them, his voice carrying a trace of excitement.
"Our luck is quite good.
We happened to pass by during an eruption of Star Relics.
Treasures born in the star sea are extremely rare, and every eruption is accompanied by countless opportunities."
"What a pity that we’re only passing through and can’t personally take part."
Camille felt regretful inside and sighed.
"That’s right.
We are only quasi-sages, so we’re still not qualified to enter the field."
Dustin agreed.
"Even peak Divine-grade powerhouses would find it difficult.
The weakest among those existences fighting over the treasures could casually crush us to death."
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
Although he could not personally participate in the fight, it was still not bad to broaden his horizons.
According to Dustin, the treasures produced within the Chaos star sea were all extremely powerful.
Every single one of them could potentially be a Holy Relic that some great Oracle-grade being had pursued for their entire life!
Ahead, the star sea shone with boundless radiance.
Countless figures crisscrossed through it, flying back and forth like participants in a grand star sea hunt.
The Shield of Aegis moved a little closer, and only then did Daniel and the others finally see clearly.
So the dazzling light was actually being emitted by the treasures themselves!
Countless Star Relics were surrounded by brilliant radiance.
They surged out from all directions like fountains erupting from the depths of the earth, illuminating this dim star sea until it was bright as day.
They flew wildly in every direction, scattering streams of light everywhere.
It was as though the treasury of some ancient god had shattered in the void, and countless treasures were scrambling to escape their cage, fleeing toward the end of the star sea.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Countless powerhouses had already been lying in wait throughout the star sea.
When they saw the Star Relics erupting like a torrential rain, greed and fanaticism ignited in their eyes.
Secret arts were unleashed one after another.
Secret treasures were activated one after another.
The powerhouses chased after and subdued those agile treasures like fishermen casting nets.
However, those Star Relics seemed to possess wills of their own.

Although they were not as strong as the powerhouses, they relied on their unique abilities to frantically dodge, like frightened schools of fish weaving and struggling through the gaps of a fishing net.
Daniel looked at this noisy, bustling scene, and a faint smile unconsciously appeared at the corner of his mouth.
How lively!
The Endless Starfield truly contained opportunities everywhere.
This star sea never showed mercy to anyone, yet it was never stingy with its gifts either.
Daniel was not the only one feeling emotional.
The other powerhouses were also moved in their own ways.
To some people, the Chaos star sea was a legend they could never touch in their lifetime, an ethereal ballad sung by wandering bards.
And yet at this moment, they were standing within that very legend.
The treasure land of the star sea was like a boiling furnace.
Star Relics gushed out like fountains, and like schools of fish leaping from the ocean surface, they drew countless brilliant streaks of light through the void.
The powerhouses were like experienced fishermen, casting down invisible nets one after another as they competed to harvest this gift from the star sea.
At this moment, the entire star sea seemed to be burning.
Meanwhile, the Shield of Aegis had already quietly entered the range of the treasure land.
Through the semi-transparent barrier of the shield, Daniel and the others could see the distant scene even more clearly.
"Look!
They’re fighting over there!"
James suddenly pointed into the distance, his voice carrying a trace of suppressed excitement.
"They probably set their eyes on the same Star Relic at the same time and drew their blades against each other."
Dustin chuckled, calmly watching the slaughter as if he were enjoying a play that had nothing to do with him.
Rumble—rumble—!
The two powerhouses fought until heaven and earth seemed to collapse.
Every collision shook the surrounding space, sending ripples scattering in all directions.
One of them emitted a hazy radiance from his entire body.
Six arms grew from his back, and each hand held a Divine-grade secret treasure, making him look like a war god who had walked out of an ancient legendary age.
The other had only one arm.
His remaining right arm tightly gripped a pitch-black lance.
Terrifying black lightning coiled around the spearhead, and every thrust carried a shriek that seemed capable of tearing the void apart.
And at this moment, the one with the upper hand was actually the one-armed powerhouse!
The lance in his hand was terrifying beyond compare.
The spearhead condensed pure power of the law of destruction, and every strike was like the whisper of death.
The six-armed powerhouse did not dare to block it head-on at all.

Earlier, when he had clashed with it directly several times, not only had two of his secret treasures been destroyed, but two of his arms had also been severed, leaving him in an utterly miserable state.
"That six-armed powerhouse is at the Divine Radiant level."
A layer of golden light covered Dustin’s eyes.
Some kind of detection secret art was clearly operating as he slowly spoke.
"The one-armed powerhouse is a Divine Sovereign.
He controls the law of destruction.
He is certain to win!"
"The gap between Divine Sovereign and Divine Radiant is even greater than the gap between Divine Radiant and peak Divine-grade."
Before his words had even finished, the one-armed powerhouse thrust his lance forward.
Puchi—!
The black lightning on the spearhead slipped into his opponent’s shoulder like a serpent’s tongue, then exploded with a roar.
One of the six-armed powerhouse’s arms once again turned into blood mist and shattered bone, splattering wildly through the void.
His broken body panicked.
He did not even dare to turn his head as he fled.
However, the one-armed powerhouse did not give chase.
He merely turned around and continued pursuing the Star Relic that had caused the conflict.
That was the only thing he cared about.

chapters.title: Chapter 326 -326-This Star Relic Is Fated with Me
paragraphs: "Treasures within the star sea are what we call ’Star Relics.’"
Dustin withdrew his gaze and explained to everyone, "Most Star Relics are natural Holy Relic embryos. They are born with spirits already nurtured within them!"

"Oracle-grade beings love using Star Relics the most when forging Divine-grade secret treasures. A top-grade Star Relic can often be forged into a supreme treasure that will be passed down through the ages. They are the most perfect gifts of this star sea."
Daniel and the others listened quietly, their hearts surging with waves.
The Shield of Aegis continued onward.
Just as they were about to leave the range of the treasure land, a dazzling light suddenly chased up from behind them, like a meteor streaking across the night sky.
Behind the light, a powerhouse followed closely.
The exposed skin of that powerhouse was covered in mysterious totem patterns. Every line glowed faintly, as if they were living things.
Daniel and the others instantly noticed this unusual movement.
"Something’s not right. This Star Relic... why does it seem like it’s coming straight toward us?"
Daniel frowned, his gaze locking tightly onto that incoming light.
Dustin’s expression became solemn, and his voice turned low.
"That powerhouse... is a Divine Sovereign!"
"That is an existence second only to Oracle-grade. He could crush quasi-sages like us to death with a single finger."
"Divine Sovereign..."
James and the others involuntarily swallowed, their throats rolling.

The Divine-grade rank was divided by strict hierarchy. Aside from low, mid, high, and peak stages, there were also Divine Radiant, Divine Sovereign, Divine Lord, Divine Descendant, and Divine Oracle-grade!
The gap between each rank was like a heavenly chasm, while Oracle-grade beings had already touched the source of laws, surpassing the realm of imagination.
"Something’s wrong. That Star Relic is about to crash into us."
James spoke hesitantly, cold sweat already seeping from his palms.
Based on the flying speed of the Star Relic and the pursuit speed of the Divine Sovereign behind it, that Divine Sovereign would soon collide with them directly.
"This Star Relic has quite the personality."
Daniel had just withdrawn the threads of karma. The corners of his mouth rose slightly, revealing a meaningful smile.
"I want this Star Relic."
The others were instantly shocked.
That was a treasure a Divine Sovereign powerhouse had been chasing so desperately all this way!
Big brother, are you joking?
That was a Divine Sovereign!
An existence that could kill a quasi-sage with a single glance!
Boom—!
Celestial Grasp!

Daniel’s arm pierced through the Shield of Aegis. His palm suddenly expanded in the void, transforming into a gigantic hand that blotted out the sky, as if even stars could be crushed within its grasp.

Within the palm, layers upon layers of world projections revolved like the rotation of countless realms, surging with world-destroying might. It was as though the weight of an entire galaxy had been condensed into that small space.
Whoosh—!
The Star Relic moved extremely fast, like an arrow fired from an ancient divine bow, dragging a long trail of light as it tore through the void.
However, Daniel’s giant palm appeared at exactly the right moment.
The Star Relic plunged straight into his palm.
[Ding! You have obtained Star Relic (Primordial Grade).]
Daniel immediately sold the Star Relic through the system with a backhand motion. The selling price was still the symbolic 1 copper coin.
[Ding! You have sold Star Relic (Primordial Grade) ×1 to the Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The item sold is a Divine-grade secret treasure category item. Please choose quality boost or quantity boost!]
"Quality boost!"
Daniel did not hesitate at all.
[Congratulations! You have obtained 1 gold coin! You have obtained Star Relic (Primordial Law Grade) ×1!]
Whoosh—!
The light receded, and a perfectly round object the size of a football landed in Daniel’s hand.
Its entire body emitted a soft glow. Inside it, countless tiny stars seemed to be constantly born and extinguished.
[Primordial Law Star Relic: Divine-grade secret treasure embryo]
Restriction: Divine-grade
Effect: Top-grade Divine-grade secret treasure embryo. Can be used to forge a top-grade Divine-grade secret treasure.
Law Trait: Infinite Projection
Description: A Star Relic produced from a chaotic treasure land. Extremely rare. Contains complete law power.
Daniel lowered his head and glanced at it. The corners of his mouth rose slightly.
Originally, it had only been Primordial Grade. After undergoing Millionfold Boost, it had actually leapt straight to Primordial Law Grade!
Although it seemed to be only one rank higher, at the level of Divine-grade secret treasures, the gap between every rank was like a heavenly chasm!
Daniel looked at the trait "Infinite Projection," and his eyes immediately lit up.

If this Star Relic was refined into a Divine-grade secret treasure, then that secret treasure would be able to infinitely replicate itself—one becoming a hundred, a hundred becoming ten thousand, like a tide of Sacred Artifacts from the legendary age!
Satisfied, he stored the Star Relic into his personal space.
Once he broke through to Divine-grade in the future, he could personally refine it. Or he could directly use Gold Holy Mountain points to ask a great Oracle-grade being to handle the forging for him.
In Gold Holy Mountain, as long as one had enough points, even a great Oracle-grade being would be willing to serve.
There was nothing in this world that points could not buy.
And if there was, it only meant that the points were not enough!
However, Daniel’s move had snatched away the Star Relic that the Divine Sovereign had painstakingly chased for so long.
"This isn’t looking too good. That Divine Sovereign is coming after us too."
James’s voice carried obvious tension.
"Hm?"
Dustin frowned and looked toward the rear of the Shield of Aegis.
Daniel’s expression was calm as still water, as if only a light breeze had blown past.
At this moment, the Divine Sovereign powerhouse’s face was filled with rage. The totem patterns on his face were violently pulsing because of his fury, like struggling venomous snakes.
"In the name of the Star Abyss! I chased it so hard for so long, and it was actually picked up by you ants!"
His roar exploded through the star sea, shaking the surrounding space until it trembled.
"Even if there’s an Oracle-grade being on your ship today, I don’t care! Hand over the Star Relic!"
A Divine Sovereign was already infinitely close to Oracle-grade. If one was at peak Divine Sovereign, the gap between them and Oracle-grade was only a thin line.
Since this Divine Sovereign powerhouse dared to shout so arrogantly, he naturally had his own confidence.
Moreover, he had long since sensed that the aura emitted by that giant hand that had stretched out was only at quasi-Divine-grade level.
A quasi-sage?
In his eyes, that was no different from an ant!
With one finger, he could crush an entire swarm of them to death.
"No need to pay attention to him."
Dustin sneered, his tone full of disdain.
"How could a Primordial Law Grade supreme treasure possibly be shaken by a mere Divine Sovereign?"
"The defensive power of the Shield of Aegis is something even an Oracle-grade being would have to spend some effort against. Let him roar. We’ll just sit here and watch the show."
When Daniel and the others heard this, they immediately relaxed.
They leisurely continued admiring the scenery of the star sea through the shield’s semi-transparent barrier, as if that roaring powerhouse outside was nothing more than a noisy fly.
However, the Divine Sovereign powerhouse refused to let the matter rest.
Gritting his teeth, he summoned a spider-shaped Divine-grade secret treasure.

The gigantic spider was ten thousand meters tall and ten thousand meters long. Its eight sharp segmented limbs drew streaks of cold light through the void, like a moving steel fortress, emitting a terrifying pressure that made one’s heart chill.
Boom—!
That steel giant spider fiercely slammed into the Shield of Aegis with the momentum of two stars colliding head-on.
Boom, boom, boom...
Visible shockwaves instantly exploded through the void!

chapters.title: Chapter 327 -327-A Battle Between Great Oracle-grade Beings
paragraphs: Buzz—!
The instant the two made contact, the relief of the snake-haired demoness on the shield’s surface suddenly opened its eyes.
Those were hollow, abyssal eyes, like a gaze from the very end of the abyss. They carried no emotion at all—only pure destruction.
A gray light almost impossible to catch with the naked eye quietly shot out from the snake hair and silently sank into the body of the steel giant spider.
Pop—!
A crisp sound rang out, like a bubble bursting on the surface of water.

That enormous steel giant spider disintegrated inch by inch from the inside out, turning into countless tiny fragments that scattered through the star sea. In the blink of an eye, it was swallowed by the surging Chaotic Essence, leaving not even a trace behind.
The Divine Sovereign powerhouse froze on the spot.
He stared blankly at the empty void, his mouth wide enough to fit a fist inside. Even the totem patterns on his face stiffened.
"No... my Sacred Artisan Law Grade secret treasure..."
He muttered to himself, his voice filled with heartache. That bleeding pain felt worse than having his flesh carved out by a blade.
That was a fortune he had accumulated over countless years. It was one of the treasures he cherished most.
However, what chilled his spine even more was this—
If what had crashed into the shield just now had not been that secret treasure, but himself...
He would probably have ended up like that spider, unable to even leave ashes behind!
"That was close... thank goodness..."
He touched his forehead, and his fingertips brushed against a layer of cold sweat.
He took a deep look at the departing Shield of Aegis, his eyes filled with fear and unwillingness. Then he spat fiercely.
"It was actually a Primordial Law Grade supreme treasure... Fuck, this time I suffered a huge loss."
He had originally wanted to seize a Primordial Star Relic, but not only had he failed, he had lost a Sacred Artisan Law Grade secret treasure instead.
This deal had cost him everything!
Daniel and the others were not particularly surprised when they saw that the Divine Sovereign did not chase after them.
A Primordial Law Grade supreme treasure was itself no weaker than an Oracle-grade being. As long as that Divine Sovereign was not insane, he would know when to retreat.
In the star sea, the existences who lived the longest were often not the ones who fought the best, but the ones who best understood how to judge the situation.
"Congratulations, Boss Faustus."
"Excellent methods, Sir Faustus!"
James, Dustin, and the others all congratulated him one after another, their eyes filled with envy.
"Why didn’t a second Star Relic fly over too?"
Dustin pretended to sigh and shook his head.
"Sir Faustus, that Star Relic was truly fated with you!"
Daniel blinked. A playful smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
"I think so too!"
The other powerhouses were stunned and looked at one another.
Daniel smiled.
Now that the Star Relic had already fallen into his hands, it was his.

A star sea treasure land had erupted, and of all things, a Star Relic had just so happened to rush toward him. This luck was no different from picking up a legendary divine artifact in the wilderness.
Who could truly explain something like fate?
The Shield of Aegis continued traveling through the chaos.

It passed through one dangerous region after another. In those places, the Chaotic Essence was so dense that it seemed almost tangible. Within the gray mist, enormous figures could be vaguely seen writhing.

Those chaotic creatures were said to have been born from Chaotic Essence, or perhaps they were the corpses of dead Oracle-grade beings that had developed intelligence again over countless years. Every single one of them was unimaginably powerful, capable of tearing apart stars with a casual strike!
Fortunately, the Shield of Aegis was a Primordial Law Grade supreme treasure, allowing them to pass safely through that land of death.
After sensing the aura emitted by the shield, those chaotic creatures all retreated like the tide, as if wild beasts had encountered an even more ferocious member of their own kind.
"If we didn’t have this Shield of Aegis, even a Divine Sovereign would probably suffer here."
James looked at the blurry colossal shadows outside, still feeling lingering fear.
"Any one of those chaotic creatures is no weaker than Oracle-grade. Tearing us apart would be as easy as tearing a sheet of paper."
"The Chaos star sea... is truly incomparably miraculous."
Camille sighed softly. Her gaze contained both reverence and longing.
The Chaos star sea not only contained secret realms and treasure lands, but also forbidden zones that even Oracle-grade beings did not dare enter lightly.
At this moment, the Shield of Aegis was passing through a special terrain formed by Chaotic Essence.
Countless enormous vortexes slowly rotated in the void, like eyes opening in the depths of the star sea. They were deep and unfathomable, as if leading to some unknown abyss.
Even a top-tier Divine-grade secret treasure like the Shield of Aegis was affected by the gravity of those vortexes, its speed slowed as it endured an invisible pulling force.
At this moment, it was as though an invisible giant hand was trying to drag it into endless darkness!
Boom—rumble—!
A muffled thunderous sound came from ahead, like the firmament roaring in anger.
Invisible Strength surged over from the distance. The Shield of Aegis swayed under the tremendous force, like a tiny boat tossed about by raging waves.
The light on the shield’s surface remained as steady as a boulder.
However, Daniel and the others wore solemn expressions, their hearts pounding like war drums.
"Just the chaos of their auras is enough to affect the stability of a Primordial Law Grade supreme treasure..."
James’s voice trembled slightly.
"I’m afraid there are super powerhouses fighting ahead!"
Camille asked curiously, her eyes filled with both fear and excitement.
The answer was soon revealed.
As the Shield of Aegis continued forward while shaking, everyone saw intense fluctuations in the distance. Space itself looked like torn cloth, revealing pitch-black nothingness behind it.
Daniel extended his mind power like an invisible thread into the depths of that chaos.
Soon, his mind power touched two figures.
They were two existences without the slightest aura leaking outward. They floated silently in the void, like two divine statues forgotten at the end of time.
There was no light flowing across their skin. Not even the slightest trace of life fluctuation could be sensed from them. Even their breathing seemed to have stopped entirely.
If he had not seen them with his own eyes, he would never have believed they were living beings!
"Their divine energy is completely restrained..."
Daniel murmured in a low voice, his tone filled with shock.

"If hiding one’s aura and disguising oneself as a mortal is already the limit, then to restrain all of one’s divine energy and all law fluctuations until one seems like a dead object... just what kind of Rank is this?"
Even if they were standing right in front of him, without special methods, he probably would not be able to detect that they were still alive at all!
"Oracle-grade."
Dustin’s expression changed slightly, and his voice subconsciously lowered.
"And... they are great Oracle-grade beings!"
"Only supreme powerhouses who have stepped into that domain can restrain their auras to such a degree—as if they were death itself, silent, cold, and impossible to peer into."
"Great Oracle-grade beings... are fighting!"
James trembled all over, yet his eyes were fixed firmly in that direction. The two confronting figures were reflected in his pupils.

"By the Creator God, I’m actually seeing two great Oracle-grade beings fighting to the death with my own eyes! A scene like this might not be encountered even after drifting through the Endless Starsea for an entire lifetime!"
"In a battle between great Oracle-grade beings, even the aftershocks alone are enough to kill Divine-grade powerhouses."
Daniel sucked in a breath of cold air. His throat felt dry, as if an invisible hand had clenched around his neck.

Every time those two figures attacked, the fluctuations spread outward from them for millions of miles. Wherever they passed, stars shattered, the void collapsed, and even Chaotic Essence was torn to pieces.
How terrifying!
The Shield of Aegis struggled through the gaps between the fluctuations, like a lone boat fighting to survive in a storm.
The snake-haired demoness relief on the shield’s surface flickered between bright and dim, as if it too was enduring tremendous pressure.
Only after an unknown amount of time did that forbidden region finally fall far behind them.
Only then did everyone inside the shield slowly let out a breath of relief.
