"Congratulations, Daniel."
Daniel asked blankly,
"Congratulations for what? I don’t remember buying a lottery ticket."
"Hahaha... The boss’s daughter has taken a liking to you."
There was a hint of ambiguity and amusement in his superior’s eyes.

"You’re a lucky boy. As long as you agree to divorce your wife and marry Miss Yvette, your position will rise several levels in a row. You’ll directly sit in the department manager’s chair, and you’ll even step across the threshold of the board of directors."
"A single step to the heavens is right before your eyes!"
His superior paused, his gaze sharpening.
"However... if you refuse..."
"Good day, miss. This is the meal you ordered."
Kelly handed the meal box in her hand to the elegant, noble-looking woman before her.
Yvette did not reach out to take it. She merely glanced at it indifferently, a faint smile rising at the corner of her lips.
"This meal was ordered for you."
"What?"
Kelly froze.
"I’m Daniel’s colleague, and also the daughter of the owner of the company he works for."
Yvette’s lips curved upward.
"Tell me, do you think Daniel would be happier spending his life with someone like you, or with me?"
"If you are a smart person, then let him go. That would also be letting yourself go."
Kelly was speechless for a moment.
Her gaze fell on the oil-stained work uniform she was wearing.
She looked at the woman before her—young, noble, born into a prestigious family.
And herself?
She was wearing coarse work clothes, and in a little while, she still had to rush to the tavern to carry plates.
Her grandmother had long since passed away as well...
Indeed, she did not have any impressive cards to put on the table.
"Why aren’t you saying anything?"
Yvette’s laughter was crisp yet cold.
"You only need to agree to dissolve your marriage with Daniel, and I will give you thirty million!"
"That is thirty million. You would never need to run around for a living again!"
"I believe you are a smart person. Smart people know what they should do."
The city apartment.
"Kelly, I’m back."
Daniel pushed open the door and walked into the familiar room.
"Go wash your hands first. Dinner is ready."
Kelly answered with a smile, her voice as gentle as ever.
After dinner,
"Kelly, I resigned from that job."
Daniel suddenly spoke, his tone calm.
Kelly’s eyes instantly grew wet, tears circling in them.
"It’s okay. I believe in you. I have believed in you from beginning to end."
"You are the best person in this world. You always have been."
Daniel gently wiped away the tears sliding down her cheeks and sighed softly.
"Stop crying. I’ll take you to see fireworks."
"It’s not a festival. Where would there be fireworks?"
"Beautiful things never need to wait, just as stars will shine when it is time for them to shine!"
Daniel found another job.
Five years later, he became an executive of a chamber of commerce and bought a spacious manor.
Kelly gave birth to a pair of twins for him, and the children were already several years old.
They walked hand in hand through decades of life, until both of them eventually lived in the same clinic.
"By the way... did Yvette ever say something to you?"
Daniel asked casually.
"That’s right!"
Kelly smiled, her wrinkled eyes filled with tenderness.
"She even said she would give me thirty million if I divorced you."
"Then why didn’t you agree? Back then, you were working yourself half to death, and your monthly salary was still less than ten thousand, wasn’t it?"
"Then why did you resign from that job?"
Kelly rolled her eyes and asked him back.
The two looked at each other, then suddenly burst into laughter.
"Idiot."
Daniel scolded her with a smile, though his voice was full of affection.
"You’re not much better."
Kelly smiled too, smiling just like the girl who had handed over a few copper coins at the carriage station all those years ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 344 -344-Kelly’s True Identity
paragraphs: Whoosh—!
The scene before Kelly’s eyes suddenly changed, as though an invisible hand had lifted a curtain.
Her eyes were filled with astonishment.
She had clearly reached the end of her life, lying on a sickbed, surrounded by the low hum of medical instruments and the suppressed sobs of her loved ones.
Yet at this moment, another Door of Truth had appeared before her!

It was exactly the same as the one she had pushed open all those years ago. Even the patterns of star trajectories and spacetime rifts engraved upon the door were identical, without the slightest difference.
But this time, she did not want to push it open.
She lowered her head and looked at her own body in shock.
It had actually returned to the appearance of her youth, with smooth skin and an upright posture.
"What kind of place is this now?"
She looked around, but all she could see was chaos.
A gray, hazy void.
There was no sky, no earth, no stars, and no wind.
The only light came from a river not far away, flowing quietly.
That river was incomparably vast, as though all the secrets of the universe were hidden beneath its surface.
Beside the river, a figure holding a fishing rod sat above the water, completely motionless.
Kelly gathered her courage and slowly walked over.
"Your Excellency, may I ask... what is this place?"
As she drew closer, she finally saw what was inside the river.
It was not water!
Within it, endless living beings were born, grew, withered, and perished...
Countless stars and universes were extinguished within it, then reborn from the ashes.
It was a long river woven from space and time.
Every wave was an era.
Every ripple was a stretch of fate.
This was the Time River!
The figure slowly turned around.
"The Door of Truth is right before you. Why will you not push it open again?"
"Kelly."
Kelly froze.
Before her was a face exactly identical to her own.
It was like a mirror reflecting another version of herself!
"You are..."
Kelly was stunned, as though something had blocked her throat.
"I... am you!"
The angler raised the fishing rod in her hand. There was only a thin line hanging from it into the Time River, and no one knew what she was fishing for.
"You are a strand of my true self."
Boom—!
Kelly was completely stunned, as though the entire world had collapsed beneath her feet.
Daniel put away that Law Essence.
The essence contained the Law of Fated Reincarnation, and its Law level had reached high-grade!
This was a full level higher than the Law of Causality he currently mastered.
Of course, he could choose to use this essence directly and thereby master both reincarnation and causality at the same time, becoming a controller of two Laws in one stroke.
However, the detailed description of the Law Essence had already stated it clearly.
It was more suitable for constructing a sage rank, just like a cornerstone to a palace.
Thinking of this, he decided to keep the essence for constructing his sage rank later.
As for raising the grade of his Laws themselves, that could be done through deduction.
Daniel had not actually done much killing, so his collection progress for Primal Spirit had not been particularly fast.

After all, the powerhouses he encountered in the starsea were not necessarily of primordial race bloodlines. It was far less efficient and convenient than when he had slaughtered his way through the God Realm.
This time, after killing a group of peak demi-sages and adding his previous accumulation, he had barely managed to gather ten billion Primal Spirit.
It just happened to reach the threshold for deducing a Law.
[Ding! You have consumed 10 billion Primal Spirit. Forbidden Law deduction in progress...]
[Ding! You have obtained Law of Causality. Detected that you have already mastered this Law. Would you like to fuse it? After fusion, this Law will advance to a higher level.]
Daniel did not hesitate.
"Fuse!"
[Ding! Fusion successful! You have obtained high-grade Law of Causality!]
[High-grade Law of Causality]
Grade: High-grade rare Law
Effect: Obtain the power of high-grade Law of Causality, greatly increasing the defensive and offensive capabilities of the Law of Causality, as though forging a wooden sword into a blade of stars.
Traits:
[Cause Begets Effect]: The power of low-grade Law of Causality. Trace the cause and alter the effect.
[Effect Becomes Cause]: The power of mid-grade Law of Causality. Place the effect before the cause and reverse fate.

[Effect, Cause, Effect]: The power of high-grade Law of Causality. Causes the target to bear the karma carried by beings connected to oneself through causal lines. This karma can be transformed into [Evil Consequences]—and [Evil Consequences] can stack!
Special Note: Those who manipulate fate and causality will also be trapped by them!
The higher the grade of the Fated Law of Causality used, the greater the price that must be paid. It is like two edges of the same blade, cutting the enemy while also cutting oneself.
Introduction: High-grade Law of Causality, an advanced Law power mastered by powerhouses above the peak of Divine-grade. It is like a key leading to the hall of supreme-grade.
Mastering Laws is an unavoidable threshold on the path of the strong. No one is exempt!
After Daniel finished reading the traits of the advanced Law of Causality, his eyes flickered slightly.
The abilities after the Law of Causality’s advancement were simply heaven-defying to an extreme.
As for negative effects like backlash and consumption, he was not afraid of them at all.
After all, no matter how severe the backlash was, could it be worse than blowing himself into powder?
As for the punishment involving Fortune Points, he felt that his Fortune Points were inexhaustible. Being able to reasonably use his Fortune Points to offset the cost of Law usage was acceptable.
Compared to the positive abilities of the Law, that little bit of backlash could be ignored.
Especially the third trait—
"Effect, Cause, Effect."
It was absurdly powerful.
To put it plainly, when he encountered a troublesome enemy, he only needed to drag a group of Oracle-grade beings on his own causal lines into the matter!
Who could withstand a blow of that level?
Daniel felt as though his entire body was filled with energy, as though he could shatter a galaxy with one punch.
In an excellent mood, he continued searching through this plane.

Before long, he had nearly swept clean all the good things in the violet plane. His divine energy broke through to three trillion points, bringing him another large step closer to his small goal of ten trillion.
At that moment—
Boom!
The entire plane suddenly shook violently, as though an invisible giant hand had grabbed this stretch of heaven and earth and was shaking it madly.
Daniel’s expression changed drastically.
"What’s going on?"
"Could something have happened to the Astral Realm?"
His brows furrowed tightly.
Seeing that this place had already fallen into complete chaos, he decisively flew out of the plane.
Whoosh—!
Daniel hovered in the void outside the Astral Realm.
Only then did he discover that all seven great planes were trembling, like seven petals being torn apart by a violent wind.
Countless demi-sages flew out from their respective planes one after another, scattering like startled birds.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh...!
"What’s happening? Are the planes about to collapse?"
"I don’t know either! I was still digging out a divine mine and almost got buried inside!"
"Look—deep inside the Astral Realm! The disturbance is coming from there!"
The Astral Realm itself was shaped like a flower, with the seven great planes surrounding it like blooming petals.
At the center was an independent plane, covered layer upon layer by dense seven-colored radiance, like a veiled young woman attracting the gazes of countless powerhouses.
Unfortunately, without a Scroll of Astral Prosperity, no one could even think of stepping inside.

At this moment, the central plane of the Astral Realm was shaking violently. Seven-colored radiance flickered unsteadily, like a sleeping beast turning over in its dreams, triggering a powerful resonance across all seven great planes!

chapters.title: Chapter 345 -345-The Two Powerhouses Who Shifted the Disaster Elsewhere
paragraphs: "There’s been a change in the depths of the Astral Realm."
Daniel raised his brow, his gaze locking tightly onto that surging radiance.
"Who triggered this disturbance?"
Although he held a Scroll of Astral Prosperity and could have entered the depths, he had planned to first sweep clean the opportunities in the outer region, leaving the depths for last.
However, there was one thing to note.
There were seven Scrolls of Astral Prosperity in total!
Aside from his own, six others were still out there.
He had a feeling that it was most likely another demi-sage who had already entered the depths of the Astral Realm with a scroll.
And by some coincidence, they had triggered this turmoil!
Suddenly—
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Two figures appeared from the depths of the Astral Realm, moving at incredible speed like two arrows loosed from their strings.
Daniel quickly recognized the two powerhouses.
"Vincent of the Varasen Universe, and Vera of the Lunaris Universe!"
They also had Scrolls of Astral Prosperity.
Daniel immediately understood.
At this moment, Vincent and Vera were flying at extreme speed, as though something terrifying was chasing them from behind.
Boom—!
A figure flew out from the depths of the Astral Realm.
That figure was a million meters tall, like a moving mountain. Compared to it, the demi-sages were like ants before a giant dragon.
The creature moved, and in an instant, it caught up to Vera and Vincent’s speed.
The demi-sages looked upon this scene like mortals gazing up at a falling god.
Suddenly, one powerhouse snapped out of his shock, his face turning deathly pale.
"In the name of the gods—you two lunatics! Don’t lead it over here!"
Vera and Vincent had clearly planned this from the start, and there was not the slightest shame in their eyes.
"No need to panic. It’s only at the peak of Divine-grade! If we all attack together, we can drown it with sheer numbers!"
Vincent maintained his distance with ease, never allowing the giant creature to catch up.
At the same time, he looked around and loudly incited the surrounding demi-sages.
"I didn’t want to bring it here either, but I can’t beat it! If one person can’t beat it, then everyone can fight it together! We’ll definitely win!"
Vera’s face was full of excitement.
"A peak Divine-grade is such a fat, delicious prey. Come join the hunt!"
Hearing the two of them speak like this, the surrounding demi-sages were instantly furious.
"Vera is a lunatic! Damn it!"
The demi-sages of the Lunaris Universe wished they could get as far away from her as possible.
"A peak Divine-grade? Who dares provoke something like that?!"
The demi-sage rank beings from the other universes were also helpless, retreating one after another.
"These two madmen went off and provoked a peak Divine-grade by themselves, and now they actually want to drag us into the water—how did they even come up with that?!"
Daniel listened to the surrounding demi-sages’ discussions, but his gaze never left that creature.
"Peak Divine-grade..."
He muttered softly.
"It should be one of the native beings from the depths of the Astral Realm."

In his understanding, the Astral Realm was like a world at the beginning of the starsea’s creation—filled with treasures everywhere, packed with opportunities, and a treasure vault waiting to be developed.

At the same time, it was also filled with powerful creatures. Those primordial beings were born with top-tier Holy Relics accompanying them, naturally mastered Sacred Arts, and grew in strength at astonishing speed, like children of the Creator.
Now, Vera and Vincent had provoked one such primordial being and could only flee in a sorry state.
"Still, this kind of primordial being is full of good things."
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
Whoosh—!
The gigantic creature had already chased them over, its million-meter body blotting out the sky.
Some timid demi-sage rank beings knew they could not win and fled far away without looking back.
But more demi-sage rank beings saw the opportunity within, and flames of greed ignited in their eyes.
The path of advancement was itself an act of defying the heavens. Powerhouses with little courage and little ambition were ultimately in the minority.
Most powerhouses even dared defy the will of the world. What else would they not dare do?
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
Secret arts blasted toward the enormous creature one after another.
"What’s going on? Are they... fighting?"
"A peak Divine-grade being? That’s outrageous!"
James, Mosi, Dustin, and Camille rushed out from their respective planes one after another and landed beside Daniel.
They watched the scene in astonishment. Hundreds of demi-sage rank beings were joining forces to besiege the native creature of the Astral Realm.
Vera and Vincent had also stopped fleeing and begun to counterattack, blades and sword lights flashing as skills flew everywhere.
Daniel explained the sequence of events in just a few words.
"What do we do?"
Dustin and the others looked toward Daniel, their gazes filled with battle intent.
"We fight!"
The corner of Daniel’s mouth rose slightly.
The several demi-sages also joined the attack.
Daniel did not hurry to make a move. Instead, he watched the prey’s every action from the side like a hunter.
The moment the demi-sages unfolded their Divine Domains, they were ruthlessly crushed by that creature’s sage rank.
And the demi-sages’ Sacred Artifacts had no effect at all against that gigantic creature.
The creature took out a treasure shaped like a giant basin.
Whenever the demi-sages’ Sacred Artifacts came into contact with the seven-colored radiance, they were all sucked inside and vanished like stones sinking into the sea.
The demi-sages were shocked and furious, unleashing their Sacred Arts to attack fiercely.
But the creature’s Sacred Arts were also terrifying.
With every raise of its hand and every movement of its foot, all kinds of phantoms appeared behind it.
Rotating galaxies and flowing star rivers shifted unpredictably, as though it carried an entire universe on its back.
The demi-sages’ Sacred Arts were completely suppressed by the enormous creature. Skills that fell into those phantom galaxies and star rivers could not even stir a ripple.
And under the attacks of that gigantic creature, any demi-sage who failed to dodge in time would end up with flesh and blood flying everywhere.
"A peak Divine-grade native being is indeed terrifying."
A trace of solemnity appeared in Daniel’s gaze.
There were so many top-tier demi-sage rank beings here. It was no exaggeration to say that any one of them could instantly kill a low-grade sage and suppress a mid-grade sage.
But before a peak Divine-grade powerhouse, they were like children waving wooden swords against an armored knight.
"Only the Sacred Arts of those few top demi-sages are barely worth looking at."
Daniel saw it clearly.
The Sacred Art attacks from James, Mosi, Camille, and the others landed on the gigantic creature like raindrops striking a stone wall, only causing faint ripples.
Only Dustin, Vera, and Vincent could inflict substantial injuries on that colossal being. Every strike left deep cracks across its towering body, and its blood flowed like lava.
What Dustin displayed was his self-created Divine-grade secret art—
A fusion of the Laws of the Sanctum Sigil Universe and the Laws of the Chaos Humans.
He summoned two ancient Holy Relics.
One was a sacred stele.
The other was a totem pillar.
The sacred stele stood majestic as a mountain, its surface engraved with endless star rivers and time scales.
The totem pillar pierced heaven and earth, its surface carved with ancient beasts and star totems.
The two Holy Relics hovered in the void, one on the left and one on the right, guarding Dustin like divine protectors.
The sacred stele released waves of invisible ripples, shattering the seven-colored radiance spewed out by the gigantic creature’s treasure basin.
The totem pillar lowered strands of Chaotic Essence, protecting Dustin’s entire body. No matter how violent the gigantic creature’s attacks were, they found it difficult to get close to him!

chapters.title: Chapter 346 -346-The Strength of Two Top-Tier Prodigies
paragraphs: "Roar—!"
Vera suddenly opened her mouth and let out a beast-like roar at the gigantic creature.
The sound was rough and wild, like a war song rising from the deepest layer of the abyss.
Her eyes instantly turned blood-red, and the giant blade in her hand—larger than her own body—was also dyed with a crimson sheen. Blood-like radiance flowed along its edge.
The might of that blood-colored giant blade was no weaker than any inherited Sacred Artifact.
Every slash carried a shriek that seemed to tear the void apart, as though even stars would be split open beneath it.
The gigantic creature’s treasure came suppressing toward her, and Vera swung her blade with one hand.
A thunderous boom rang out!
She forcibly cleaved that treasure away. The treasure basin tumbled through the air, letting out a piercing wail.
"Kill—!"
Vincent’s figure was the most dazzling.
His speed suddenly rose to the extreme. His body transformed into afterimages, weaving endlessly around the gigantic creature like a shuttle moving through cloth.
The half-meter-long feather pen in his hand turned into a sharp blade. Its tip was like a knife’s edge, continuously leaving fine wounds across the gigantic creature’s body.
Every stroke was like the brushwork of a painter—precise and deadly. It was as though he was not fighting, but completing a shocking masterpiece.
At the same time, because his speed was too fast, he left countless afterimages around the gigantic creature.

Those afterimages actually swung their pens as well, continuing to inflict damage upon the gigantic creature. It was as if hundreds upon thousands of Vincents were attacking at the same time, or as if hundreds upon thousands of pens were falling upon a single canvas.
"Vera and Vincent are indeed not simple."
Daniel frowned slightly.
Vera’s close-combat ability could only be described as terrifying. Every strike had reached the limit of a Divine-grade high-grade powerhouse. Her entire body was like a moving war fortress.
Vincent, on the other hand, used his heaven-defying speed to make up for his lack of single-strike attack power, like lightning that could not be captured.
This was the first time Daniel had seen a powerhouse who had reached such a Rank in terms of speed. His movement technique was as elusive as a ghost.
By comparison, although Dustin was not weak either, he was still slightly inferior to those two.

As for the other demi-sage rank beings, they felt as though they were merely there to make up the numbers, like extras on a stage, fleeing in panic between the flashes of the main characters’ blades and swords.
Suddenly—
The gigantic creature seemed to be completely enraged!
Its entire body trembled, and the phantom behind it suddenly became clear.

It was a complete and almost lifelike Star Chart. Countless stars flowed within it, star rivers spiraled, and starfields overlapped, as though the miniature of an entire universe had been branded into that stretch of void.
"Roar, roar, roar—!"
The gigantic creature let out a great shout, its voice like thunder, shaking the surrounding void.
That phantom Star Chart pressed down like the collapse of the heavens, covering the many demi-sage rank beings before it.
The demi-sages sensed the monstrous force coming from the Star Chart, and their expressions changed one after another.
Pfft!
Pfft, pfft!
The Star Chart had not even touched their bodies, yet under that invisible pressure, the demi-sages were already spitting blood, their internal organs violently trembling.
"Immortal Vajra Idol!"

Dustin gritted his teeth and activated his strongest defensive secret art. Golden light erupted from his entire body, making him seem like a golden-armored war god who had stepped out of legendary-grade myth.
At the same time, the sacred stele and totem pillar shone brilliantly, blocking the pressure of the Star Chart outside.
"Roar—!"
Vera roared toward the sky, revealing the fangs in her mouth. Under the blood-colored radiance, she looked especially ferocious.
She showed no fear at all. Instead, she swung her blade toward that Star Chart. The blade light rose like a blood moon, carrying a resolute determination to press forward no matter what.
"Starflower!"
Vincent’s brows tightened. The paintbrush in his hand swept rapidly through the void, its tip releasing dazzling light.
He outlined the shape of a starlight flower in the void. That flower instantly stretched and expanded, covering a radius of a million miles.
At the same time, it covered the other demi-sages below, holding up a protective sky for them.
Rumble—!
The gigantic creature’s phantom Star Chart carried world-destroying might as it forcefully suppressed everything below.

Dustin’s Immortal Vajra Idol forcibly endured this wave of impact, but his golden, radiant body was also covered in spiderweb-like cracks, like a porcelain doll that had been struck by a heavy hammer and could shatter at any moment.
"Pfft—!"
Vera clashed head-on with the gigantic creature’s Star Chart and was shaken until she spat blood. Her blood-red eyes instantly dimmed slightly.
Vincent’s Starflower was crushed into pieces by the Star Chart in an instant, like a paper lantern encountering a violent storm.
However, his strike had not been in vain. The power of the gigantic creature’s Star Chart was abruptly consumed by seventy percent, leaving only thirty percent of its remaining might.
A small number of demi-sage rank beings could not withstand the residual impact. They were heavily injured and collapsed to the ground, unable to rise.
The demi-sages had suddenly suffered a setback, and for a moment, they actually hesitated, unsure whether they should continue fighting.
"If another attack like that comes, I’ll be going to meet my ancestors."
One demi-sage rank being’s face was deathly pale.
"Let’s run while there’s still time."
Another powerhouse turned around, wanting to leave.
"That’s a peak Divine-grade being. With our little bit of strength, we aren’t even enough to get stuck between its teeth."
"This... gods above, I really can’t hold on anymore!"
"It’s time—!"
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
He had never fought against a peak Divine-grade powerhouse before, so he had first played things cautiously. Before making a move, he wanted to carefully observe every habit of the prey.
On one hand, he was observing the methods and strength of a peak Divine-grade powerhouse.
On the other hand, he was calculating how to kill such an existence.
After all, he was only at the peak of demi-sage rank, while that gigantic creature was at the peak of Divine-grade.
Either he did not attack at all, or once he attacked, it had to be fatal!
"Come."
A sharp light flashed in Daniel’s eyes.
"Voidbound Grail—!"
"Supreme Divine Domain, Chaotic Reincarnation—!"
"Titan Body, Immortal Icon—!"
The moment the Voidbound Grail appeared, ripples of spacetime Law instantly spread outward like waves across the surface of a lake, weakening the gigantic creature’s sage rank by several degrees.
The demi-sages immediately felt an obvious change.
Their Divine Domains were finally no longer being crushed by the gigantic creature.
"Huh—this treasure is really nice!"
Vera’s weakened spirit immediately revived. She stared blankly at the Holy Grail floating in midair, a strange red light shining in her blood-red eyes.
"My Divine Domain can finally be used."
Vincent glanced at Daniel.
"Faustus... As expected, you still couldn’t resist making a move."
"Good. Let us see just how much substance this legendary invincible demi-sage truly has."
Whoosh—!
The gigantic creature’s gaze became solemn. It sensed the threat of the Voidbound Grail and immediately drove its treasure to slam toward the Holy Grail.
"You’re not allowed to damage that cup!"
Whoosh!
Boom—
Vera’s petite body blocked the front of the Holy Grail. With one slash, she sent the treasure basin flying. The treasure spun through the air and was knocked far away.
"Again—!"
Vincent once again unleashed his heaven-defying speed. His figure transformed into countless afterimages as he attacked the gigantic creature.
"Attack—!"
Daniel’s move caused the many demi-sages to regain their spirits one after another, and they displayed their abilities to attack the gigantic creature.
Daniel coldly watched the gigantic creature, the corner of his mouth curving into an icy arc.
"Have a taste of my newest Law power."
"Fated Causality—!"
Whoosh!
Dense threads appeared before him, like countless invisible strands weaving together into a massive net.

chapters.title: Chapter 347 -347-Bestowing Evil Consequences, Time to Clear the Field
paragraphs: "Found you!"
Daniel’s hands moved swiftly, and he soon located the causal line belonging to the gigantic creature.
Then, he connected that line to the Oracle-grade beings who shared causal ties with him, while transforming the causal state into—
Evil Consequences!
At the same time,
Thud—!
One of Daniel’s clones suddenly lost all vitality and collapsed heavily to the ground.
"Pfft—!"
The gigantic creature suddenly felt an unimaginable Strength strike it without warning, like the hammer of fate smashing into its chest.
As a peak Divine-grade being, it naturally also mastered Law power, but only at mid-grade.
Its Law power merely resisted that Strength for a brief instant before it was swiftly pierced through.
The gigantic creature spat out a mouthful of blood.
This damage had come without the slightest warning!
"High-grade Law—!"
Terror appeared on the gigantic creature’s face.
The only thing capable of piercing through its mid-grade Law power was high-grade Law!
That was a forbidden power qualified to contend for the domain of Oracle-grade.
"Who is it?!"
The gigantic creature’s eyes swept around wildly, its turbid gaze filled with fear as it tried to find the enemy who had posed such a huge threat to it.
Daniel, however, was secretly astonished.
A peak Divine-grade powerhouse was indeed terrifying!
It had fully endured that attack, yet it had only suffered light injuries, far from damage to its foundation.
A smile rose at the corner of his mouth.
"The main course is ready to be served!"

Daniel activated the Fated Law of Causality, injuring the peak Divine-grade gigantic creature in one stroke. At the same time, he also suffered backlash from the Law, his whole body feeling as though it were being torn apart.
But he had prepared in advance and sacrificed a clone without hesitation to offset the backlash.
As for the loss of Fortune Points, it was almost negligible.

After all, his Fortune Points were simply too enormous. Back then, even third-tier Oracle-grade Justin had suffered backlash from his Fortune Points. This tiny bit of consumption now was nothing more than drizzle.
Seeing that the Law attack was effective, Daniel repeated the same trick.
He skillfully entangled the gigantic creature’s causal line with those Oracle-grade beings, transformed it into Evil Consequences, and once again sacrificed a clone.
Thud—!
Another clone collapsed and turned into nothingness.
Under the support of "Effect Becomes Cause," the death of Daniel’s clone was exchanged for irresistible damage, something even a peak Divine-grade powerhouse could not resist.

Wave after wave of Law attacks surged like tides. The gigantic creature’s strength rapidly declined, and at the same time, it suffered heavy injuries. More and more wounds appeared across its body, blood flowing like streams.

Coupled with the continuous weakening from the Voidbound Grail, the gigantic creature was forcibly dragged from an advantageous position into a disadvantageous one, changing from the suppressor into the suppressed.
"Attack together! Kill—!"
The attacks of James and the others could finally inflict substantial damage on the gigantic creature.
Every strike drew blood, and large numbers of Sacred Arts exploded across its body, blooming into flowers of blood.
Vera, meanwhile, was chasing after that treasure basin and hacking at it wildly. Her small, doll-like face forced out a fierce expression as she muttered,
"Let’s see you act so mighty now! Go on, try being arrogant again—!"
Dustin and Vincent’s attacks could also cause more effective damage to the gigantic creature.
The radiance of the sacred stele and totem pillar continuously bombarded the gigantic creature’s body.
Vincent’s feather pen left wound after wound on the gigantic creature, each deep enough to reveal bone.
As one clone after another died, Daniel quickly summoned new clones to fill their place, densely covering the void.
"This gigantic creature is a native being of the Astral Realm. If I don’t kill it, I won’t be able to obtain the Astral Realm’s opportunities."
Daniel’s eyes flickered, his killing intent already decided.
"But before killing it, there are still some things to do!"
These obstructive fellows would only cause trouble if they stayed here!
"Voidbound Grail!"
Buzz, buzz, buzz—!

The body of the Holy Grail trembled slightly. Rings of Law ripples spread outward like waves across a lake, rapidly expanding in all directions and enveloping the void within a hundred thousand miles.
Previously, the Holy Grail had only targeted the gigantic creature.
Now, however, it enveloped all the demi-sages within its range.
James and the others had already received Daniel’s mind power transmission and moved far away from this area, retreating to a safe distance.
The remaining demi-sage rank beings watched as their own strength began plummeting wildly, frightening them into complete panic.
"In the name of the gods! What does Faustus mean by this?!"
"Holy shit, he’s a lunatic too! He even schemes against his own side!"
"Run! Our strength is less than one-tenth of what it was. That gigantic creature can crush us into powder with a casual strike!"
The demi-sages fled in all directions, cursing bitterly in their hearts.
Faustus was also an utterly unreasonable madman!
Vera’s Divine Domain was extremely mysterious.
It was a surging sea of blood.
That blood sea actually completely resisted the Law erosion of the Holy Grail, and her strength was not weakened at all, as though she were wearing an invisible suit of armor.
Vincent did not possess such a trait. His strength was continuously declining, and at this moment, his brows were tightly furrowed.
Vera looked at Daniel in dissatisfaction.
"Huh—this guy actually wants to eat alone. Hmph!"
Although she was unhappy, she still carried her giant blade and flashed aside.
Vincent looked at Daniel helplessly and also retreated.
During that short exchange just now, both of them had already seen that their strength was inferior to Daniel’s.
Even if they were unwilling, they could only accept it for now.
"Celestial Grasp—!"
"Effect, Cause, Effect—!"
"Effect Becomes Cause—!"
The giant palm Daniel swung out covered the sky and sun, crashing toward the gigantic creature like the collapse of the heavens.
The gigantic creature roared angrily and also unleashed a Sacred Art to resist.
Behind it, layer upon layer of galaxy phantoms manifested, actually managing to forcefully suppress Daniel’s Sacred Art by a degree and make that heaven-covering giant palm tremble slightly.
Boom!
Rumble! Rumble!
Daniel did not care at all, a cold smile still hanging on his lips.
At the same time, he continuously consumed his clones. The attacks of the Law of Causality were irresistible, and their destructive power was extremely strong!
These attacks were like invisible blades. The gigantic creature endured wave after wave of damage, as though it were being executed by countless unseen knives.
Once Daniel exhausted one batch of clones, he immediately summoned another, as though they could never be killed off.
"My clones are practically infinite—!"
A sinister smile rose at the corner of his mouth, his eyes filled with confidence.
Boom, boom, boom—!
After several rounds of consumption, the gigantic creature suffered unimaginable heavy injuries.
Its sage rank shattered, and its sacred body was covered in cracks. Blood flowed like waterfalls, and its aura was on the verge of collapse.
"Die—!"
Daniel’s heaven-covering giant palm descended once more.
This time, the gigantic creature was already powerless. It could only watch helplessly as that giant palm crushed down upon it.
Boom-crack—!
The gigantic creature’s head was smashed apart by Daniel’s palm!
Flesh and shattered bones splattered through the void, and that ten-thousand-meter body collapsed heavily to the ground, shaking the entire void as it fell!

chapters.title: Chapter 348 -348-Divine State, Basin of Greed
paragraphs: [Ding! You have killed a peak Divine-grade being!]
[Ding! You have obtained Origin Crystal ×5,000 cubic units... Detected that you have already sold this item. Millionfold Boost triggered! You have obtained Origin Crystal ×5 billion cubic units!]

[Ding! You have obtained the Divine-grade treasure Basin of Greed (Primordial Grade)... Detected that you have already sold this item. Millionfold Boost triggered! You have obtained Basin of Greed (Primordial Law Grade)!]
[Ding! You have obtained Fortune Points +1 billion!]
[Ding! You have obtained divine energy +2 trillion!]
[Ding! You have killed a peak Divine-grade powerhouse, triggering the Divine State!]
[Prompt: The Divine State will last for 5 minutes. During this period, massive amounts of Primal Spirit and divine energy will emerge. Please pay attention to collecting and absorbing them!]
Dense system prompts rang beside Daniel’s ears. Almost every single prompt represented a tremendous gain.
Five billion cubic units of Origin Crystal.
This wealth could be exchanged for a massive number of points at the gold-grade Sacred Mountain.

Although the points of the gold-grade Sacred Mountain could not be affected by Millionfold Boost, as long as the assets he obtained could be enhanced by Millionfold Boost, it was equivalent to his points being enhanced as well.
There was also the one billion Fortune Points, which completely replenished the consumption from using the Law of Causality.
As for divine energy, a full two trillion!
Perfect!
And the greatest gain was undoubtedly the Basin of Greed.
Before enhancement, its grade was equivalent to the Voidbound Grail.
After enhancement, it had already surpassed the Voidbound Grail by an entire level.

More importantly, the Basin of Greed still contained the many treasures of the demi-sages that the creature had collected, as well as a large number of top-tier Holy Relics and secret treasures it had gathered from the central plane of the Astral Realm.
That was practically a gigantic treasury!
By obtaining the Basin of Greed, Daniel had essentially obtained an entire treasury for free!
As for the effect of Divine State, that was completely unexpected wealth.
Daniel could not help but sigh inwardly at fate’s favor.
If he had relied on his strength alone, even while holding the high-grade Law of Causality, killing a peak Divine-grade powerhouse would definitely not have been easy.
It would have been a prolonged war of attrition.

However, Vera, Vincent, Dustin, and the others had taken action first, holding the gigantic creature down from the front and consuming its Strength and energy. Only then had Daniel obtained the perfect opportunity to calmly unleash his damage.
If it had been a different unfamiliar peak Divine-grade powerhouse, and if he had been alone, he would definitely not have chosen to clash head-on.
That would have been far too troublesome, far too dangerous, and simply not worth it.
"The Astral Realm really does have opportunities buried everywhere."
Light flickered in Daniel’s eyes.
The demi-sage rank beings competing on the same stage as him were opportunities. Killing them meant seizing their treasures.
Those ownerless heavenly materials and earthly treasures born naturally were also opportunities. No one could fight him for them.
Even this newly born peak Divine-grade native being had brought him such unimaginably generous rewards after being killed.
He understood clearly that only native beings nurtured by the Astral Realm could drop such astonishing spoils.
If it were an ordinary peak Divine-grade powerhouse from another universe, this would be absolutely impossible.
In short, everywhere he looked, there were opportunities.
Daniel was filled with anticipation toward this newly born world.
The head of the peak Divine-grade gigantic creature had been smashed apart by a single palm strike.
However, its corpse still remained in the starry sky, radiating dazzling seven-colored light.
The light grew brighter and brighter, while the gigantic creature’s body slowly shrank.
Those seven-colored lights continuously peeled away from the gigantic creature’s body like fragments of stars, scattering throughout the void.
"Divine energy—!"
Daniel’s clones were like hungry wolves pouncing on food, frantically collecting the seven-colored light dancing across the sky.
The fall of a peak Divine-grade powerhouse was actually such a heaven-shaking gift!
The seven-colored light fluttered through the void like hundreds of millions of fireflies.
The demi-sages’ eyes also turned red, and they each used their own methods to fight over it.
"Mine! All of it is mine!"
Vera’s eyes were scarlet. She threw herself onto the gigantic creature’s body and crazily gnawed at the flesh and blood flowing with sacred light.
What she cared about most was the Origin essence contained within that flesh and blood.
[Ding! You have obtained divine energy +100 million!]
[Ding! You have obtained divine energy +100 million!]
Every time Daniel gathered a stream of seven-colored light, a system prompt exploded beside his ears.
The Divine State lasted for a full five minutes.
Of all the seven-colored light flying through the sky, Daniel alone seized eighty percent. The remaining twenty percent was divided among the other demi-sages.
He did not care.
The range covered by Divine State was so vast that it was impossible for him to monopolize everything.
Eighty percent was already satisfying enough.
This wave brought him another steady one trillion divine energy.
"This secret treasure seems to have some connection to the legendary Gold Coin of Greed."
Daniel took the Basin of Greed out from his inventory and held it in his palm, examining it carefully.
"I wonder how much stronger it has become after advancing to Primordial Law Grade."
He looked curiously at the secret treasure in his hand, his eyes filled with anticipation.
Ancient and complex runes were engraved across the Basin of Greed, and faint golden light flowed within them.
It exuded an indescribable aura.
As though it had been born for the sole purpose of "seizing."
[Basin of Greed (Primordial Law Grade)]
Type: Auxiliary Divine-grade treasure
Grade: Primordial Law Grade
Effects:

[Forced Storage]: Can forcibly store all Divine-grade treasures below its own grade, automatically erase the old marks on seized treasures, and generate new marks. There is no limit to the number. All are accepted.

[Fortune Advancement]: This basin contains high-grade Fortune Law and has a certain chance of raising a treasure by one grade, provided it does not exceed the treasure’s own grade limit. Cooldown: 10,000 years.
[Resistance Defense]: Against Divine-grade treasures one grade higher than itself, namely Sacred Artisan treasures and above, it possesses a certain ability to resist or weaken them.
After Daniel finished reading the details of the Basin of Greed, he could not help but draw in a cold breath.
"As expected of a Primordial Law Grade treasure!"
He sincerely marveled at how heaven-defying this treasure was.
After Millionfold Boost, the Basin of Greed had risen by an entire major grade, reaching Primordial Law Grade.
Now, it could seize treasures below the Primordial Grade, and could even forcibly take Primordial Law Grade treasures into itself!
Imagine two sides clashing with their treasures, their energies colliding head-on.
At that moment, it could forcibly seize another powerhouse’s treasure for itself.
As long as the treasure was below Primordial Law Grade, it would find it hard to escape the greedy mouth of the Basin.
Forced devouring.
Completely unreasonable!
Not only that, it also contained high-grade Fortune Law and had a chance of raising a treasure by one grade out of thin air.
As for the third trait, it could even resist and weaken treasures one grade higher than itself, namely Sacred Artisan treasure grade.
That was far too heaven-defying!
The Shield of Aegis was a primordial treasure, yet the Basin of Greed could also contend with it to some extent.
It was worth mentioning that the Basin of Greed also contained a large number of top-tier Holy Relics.
The corner of Daniel’s mouth slowly rose.
He placed the Basin of Greed into his inventory, then turned his gaze toward the still-trembling depths of the Astral Realm ahead.
"What exactly lies inside..."
New anticipation burned in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 349 -349-Daniel’s Certain-Death Future
paragraphs: "This really is picking up a treasure."
Daniel sighed at the sheer abundance of his gains. The Basin of Greed alone was enough to compare with all the spoils he had gathered from the outer region of the Astral Realm.
"Although I’ve obtained massive amounts of Holy Relics and divine energy, this current accumulation is still far from enough to construct a supreme sage rank."
His gaze flickered as he looked toward the core plane.
"There are even greater Holy Relics and opportunities hidden there. If I want to forge a supreme sage rank and step into Divine-grade, I must go to the depths of the Astral Realm."
The higher the quality of the sage rank template, the greater its demand for Holy Relics and divine energy.
What Daniel wanted to forge was a supreme sage rank, one that could support him in overlooking all living beings of the same Rank!
Not some mediocre foundation pursued by ordinary sages.

Those ordinary sage ranks were naturally easy to construct. Even a few scraps slipping through his fingers would be enough for ordinary demi-sage rank beings to forge thousands upon thousands of them.
But his pursuit was the strongest!
The Holy Relics and divine energy he required were many times greater than those of ordinary sage rank powerhouses.
Looking around, only the depths of the Astral Realm possessed enough resources to support his grand ambition.
Moreover, once he broke through to Divine-grade, he would immediately obtain the final two elemental cores, unseal the Chronoverse Prologue Codex, and grasp the Laws of spacetime.
At that time, he would truly soar!
"However... I need to fully master the Basin of Greed first."
He liked this treasure very much and could not wait to make it his own.
[Ding! You are absorbing the Primordial Law Grade treasure Basin of Greed...]
About half an hour later,
[Ding! You have successfully mastered the Primordial Law Grade treasure Basin of Greed!]
Daniel placed all the Divine-grade treasures under his name into the Basin of Greed, secretly hoping that one of them would be lucky enough to advance.
As long as even one treasure advanced, it would be a guaranteed profit.
From now on, if anyone dared to provoke him, he only needed to summon the Basin of Greed to plunder every treasure on the enemy’s body.
What did it mean to be "unreasonable"?
This was it.
After finishing all this, he finally turned his gaze toward the core plane before him.

During the time he spent mastering the Basin of Greed, James and the others had continued searching for opportunities in the outer planes, while Vera and Vincent had already taken the first step and entered the core plane.
"It’s time."
Daniel no longer delayed and flew straight toward the core plane.
Some unknown place, beside the Time River.
"I am supreme-grade sage Kelly."
The angler’s face was expressionless, her voice like frozen ice.

Although she possessed the same appearance as Kelly, her temperament was frosty, and there was no fluctuation of emotion in her eyes. She was like a stone statue that had existed since the beginning of eternity.
"Because of you, I cannot advance."
Supreme-grade sage Kelly spoke calmly, her tone revealing neither joy nor anger.

"I have remained stagnant at my current Rank for countless eras. If I do not advance soon, the Eternal Sacred Tribulation will inevitably descend. If I fail, my soul will scatter, and you will also vanish into nothingness with me."
Kelly seemed to understand, yet also not understand. She hesitated before asking,
"What... should I do?"
"Return to me and complete what is missing."
Supreme-grade sage Kelly said softly.
Kelly suddenly fell silent.
After returning to the main body, would she still exist?
But if she did not return, and supreme-grade sage Kelly failed to advance, she would likewise be reduced to ashes.
In other words, whether she returned or not, she seemed unable to escape the fate of disappearance.
She sank into silence.
"However... your Mental State has yet to harmonize with my spirit. If you return now, you will only drag me down."
Supreme-grade sage Kelly stared at her.
"You still need to continue tempering yourself, washing away your obsessions and impurities of the heart until you are completely compatible with me."
Kelly frowned.
She had not expected that even returning to the main body would have so many harsh conditions.
"Faustus is Daniel. Both you and he are being manipulated by the threads of fate."
Supreme-grade sage Kelly said coldly,

"I hoped that in reincarnation, you would break free from your obsessions and see through everything in the world. Yet you have always been toyed with by fate, sinking into love and unable to free yourself..."
"If this continues, even endless reincarnations will not allow you to comprehend the truth that the universe is heartless! At this rate, when will you ever be able to become one with me?"
Although supreme-grade sage Kelly possessed heaven-reaching and earth-shaking might, she was helpless against her own avatar.
She did not dare forcefully fuse with her either. If she did, her own strength would instead regress.
She could only wait until Kelly was willing of her own accord, until she understood that on the scale of the universe, emotion was nothing more than a meaningless wisp of cooking smoke.
But deep in Kelly’s heart, there seemed to be a voice whispering.
Do not listen to her. If you listen to her, you will become a person without feelings or emotions.
Would that still be you?
At that time, would Kelly still be Kelly?
Supreme-grade sage Kelly sensed the hesitation and struggle within her heart.
"Choose for yourself."
She gently waved her hand, and an image appeared before Kelly.
It was a projection of time taken from the Time River.
In the scene, Daniel had transformed into a streak of light and was flying toward the core plane of the Astral Realm.
"This is a fragment I extracted from a certain period of the future."
Supreme-grade sage Kelly said indifferently,
"He is about to encounter a tremendous crisis. The only one who can save him is me. After watching it, make your choice."
"Daniel..."
The moment Kelly saw that figure, her gaze became incomparably complicated.
As expected, Brother Faustus was Daniel!
Although she had spent very little time with Faustus, everything about him had already been carved deep into her heart.
The moment she saw Daniel, she was certain that Daniel was Faustus!
She simply did not know what kind of connection existed between Daniel and Faustus...
The image of time continued moving forward.
Following Daniel’s perspective, Kelly experienced everything he experienced.
Those battles, those struggles, those moments on the edge between life and death.
Very soon, the image came to an abrupt stop.
The final frame froze on the instant Daniel was mercilessly erased from the Time River by a great Oracle-grade being.
"Kelly."
Supreme-grade sage Kelly said calmly,
"If you want me to save him, you should know what to do."
"I understand."
Kelly said softly.
There was no hesitation in her voice, only a tragic resolve that bordered on absolute determination.
Whoosh—!
Daniel transformed into a streak of light and plunged directly into the core plane.
The Scroll of Astral Prosperity in his arms suddenly trembled violently, as though responding to the summons of this heaven and earth.
Whoosh—!
Without encountering any obstruction, he passed through layer upon layer of spatial barriers, pierced through the seven-colored radiance, and finally stepped into the core plane.
This was a plane even vaster than an ordinary large-scale life world.

Unlike the seven outer planes of the Astral Realm, which were formed from scattered fragments of broken continents, the earth of the core plane was a single complete whole, like a canvas personally laid down by the Creator.
The Laws of this world were slowly moving toward maturity.
Once they matured to a certain stage, the Astral Realm would also open its access permissions to sages!

chapters.title: Chapter 350 -350-Spare Me a Way Out?
paragraphs: "This is the depths of the Astral Realm."
Daniel hovered in midair, observing his surroundings.
Before him was indeed the appearance of a newborn world, everything still in the most primordial state generated by heaven and earth.
The concentration of energy here was extremely high. Even with every breath, he could feel surging Strength rolling around him.

He tried to spread out his mind power to investigate, but just like in the outer region, it was heavily suppressed. The moment his mind power left his body, it was stirred into chaos and scattered apart.
He then tried to use the Law of Causality, only to discover that all causal lines appeared gray and chaotic. He could not discern anything at all.
As expected of the core of the Astral Realm. Every corner was filled with mystery and danger.
"It can even interfere with Law power."
Daniel could not help but sigh.
The world had only just opened, and the Laws of the Astral Realm were already chaotic to begin with. Now, even his Law of Causality was being severely suppressed.
"Looks like I can only search slowly on foot."
Just as he was about to move elsewhere, he suddenly sensed that space had been firmly locked down by an invisible force!
"Imprisonment!"
Daniel frowned.
It seemed he had unknowingly attracted the attention of the native powerhouses here. They had already laid down an airspace-sealing formation, waiting for him to walk right into the trap.
"However, the strongest native beings in the Astral Realm should only be at the peak of Divine-grade."
"For this newborn world to have one peak Divine-grade being is already the limit. Surely I can’t be so unlucky as to run into a second one, right?"
His expression remained calm.
Even if it really was another peak Divine-grade, so what?
If he could not beat it, could he not outrun it?
Besides, it was not necessarily true that he could not win.
At that moment—
Whoosh, whoosh!
A humanoid creature with goat horns suddenly stepped out from the void, its build as burly as a mountain.
The horned man glanced coldly at Daniel, his voice deep as muffled thunder.
"Otherworldly being, we will spare you a way out. But you must swear that from now on, you will never step into this place again!"
"Spare me a way out?"
Daniel laughed.
A mere airspace-sealing formation, and they thought he would obediently retreat?
"What if I say no?"
A pitch-black giant hammer appeared out of thin air in the horned man’s right hand. Dark red lava-like patterns flowed across the hammer’s surface.
"Then you will sleep here forever."
"Oh?"
Daniel’s tone was casual.
"I don’t feel like sleeping here."
"Voidbound Grail—break the boundary!"
With a wave of his hand, he took out the Holy Grail.
The deep-blue body of the Holy Grail trembled lightly, and the invisible spatial shackles shattered and dispersed in an instant like cracked ice.
"A Primordial Law Grade treasure!"
The moment the horned powerhouse saw the Holy Grail, his eyes filled with greed, like a starving wolf seeing fresh meat.
But immediately afterward, his expression turned extremely vigilant, and the muscles throughout his body tightened.
He suddenly shook his body.
"Sage rank—!"
Boom—!
His sage rank unfolded with a crash, covering the sky and earth as it enveloped the entire void.
"A Divine-grade high-grade powerhouse!"
Daniel sensed the opponent’s strength.
"Chaotic Reincarnation!"
Whoosh—!
Daniel likewise unfolded his Divine Domain without hesitation.

Under the continuous weakening of the Voidbound Grail, the might of his Divine Domain was currently not inferior to the horned powerhouse’s sage rank at all. It even showed signs of suppressing it in return.
This was the terrifying aspect of a supreme Divine Domain!
This was also why Daniel was willing to pay an enormous price to construct a supreme sage rank—
Because this was the foundation that allowed one to cross Ranks and challenge those above oneself!
When the horned powerhouse saw that Daniel’s Divine Domain was actually this powerful, his pupils suddenly contracted.

He hurriedly took out a blood-colored piece of sailcloth from his chest. The sailcloth emitted a filthy aura, as though it had been fished out of a rotten blood pool, making one feel nauseated just from smelling it.
"Die!"
The horned powerhouse charged toward Daniel with his giant hammer in hand, while also taking out that blood-colored sailcloth.
"Although this treasure of mine is only Sacred Artisan Law Grade, it can contaminate Primordial Grade treasures!"
The sailcloth expanded violently in the wind, transforming into a blood-colored curtain that blotted out the sky, like a congealed sea of blood sweeping toward the Voidbound Grail.
"Once that treasure is contaminated by my blood cloth, its power will be greatly reduced. At that point, how could this mere demi-sage before me possibly be my opponent?"
The horned powerhouse was secretly pleased, a sinister smile rising at the corner of his mouth.
This treasure was something he had obtained only after paying an enormous price. When facing treasures of the same grade, it could prevent the other side from unleashing even a trace of power.
Even against treasures one grade higher, it could weaken seventy to eighty percent of their might.
"Contaminate?"
Daniel glanced at the blood-colored sailcloth covering the sky and sneered.
"Basin of Greed—!"
Boom—!
The Basin of Greed appeared out of thin air, and its opening sprayed out brilliant seven-colored light.

The blood-colored sailcloth was swept by the light and rapidly shrank as though its bones and tendons had been pulled out. It struggled and let out unwilling squeaking cries before falling into the basin.
"You don’t know your own limits."
The corner of Daniel’s mouth rose.
"Celestial Grasp—!"
His giant palm was like the collapse of the heavens, carrying overwhelming force as it slapped the horned powerhouse away.
"Pfft—!"
The horned powerhouse tumbled dozens of times through the air and instantly suffered heavy injuries.
At the same time, he sensed that his connection to the blood-colored sailcloth had been completely severed.
"You... where did you take my secret treasure?!"
He roared at Daniel, then turned his head and shouted,
"How long are you all planning to keep watching?!"
The moment his voice fell—
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
Another seven or eight powerhouses appeared from the void.

Those powerhouses had different appearances. Some had three eyes, while others were covered in scales. However, every single one of them was a high-grade sage, and each held a secret treasure of a different form.
They had first allowed the horned powerhouse to test Daniel’s true strength.
Now that they saw his power was astonishing, and that even the horned man’s treasure had been taken away, they finally all appeared together.
The seven or eight powerhouses quickly exchanged a few glances.
"This otherworldly being is not simple. Attack together."
"All otherworldly beings deserve death!"
"Enough nonsense. Kill—!"
They simultaneously took out their secret treasures—
A longsword, a dagger, a warhammer, a treasure box, an ancient lamp...
Seven or eight treasures of different forms carried surging divine energy as they charged fiercely toward Daniel.
"They’re all good things!"
A bright light flashed in Daniel’s eyes.
"Basin of Greed—!"
The Basin of Greed nimbly turned its opening, and a large wave of seven-colored light surged out to meet those treasures.
The treasures came quickly.
But the light of the Basin of Greed was even faster!
Whoosh—!
The treasure box was swept down by the light, tumbling into the basin.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—!
The remaining treasures also could not escape the massive mouth of the Basin of Greed. One after another, they fell inside, not a single one spared.
In the blink of an eye, the powerful treasures that these native powerhouses of the Astral Realm relied upon for their fame had all fallen into Daniel’s Basin of Greed.
The scene made it seem as though these natives were lining up to hand over their treasures willingly.
It was simply unbelievable!
The group of powerhouses stared blankly at the scene, as though they had been struck by lightning.
"I... I can’t sense my treasure anymore!"
"The mark I left on my treasure has been erased!"
"No! My sacred sword! That was my companion born alongside me!"
As though some switch had been flipped, the eyes of the powerhouses turned blood-red.
It was anger and madness erupting from unbearable pain.
"Damned otherworldly being, return my secret treasure—!"
"How shameless! I’ll fight you to the death!"
"Hurry up and give me back my treasure box!"
The powerhouses whose treasures had been forcibly taken by Daniel rushed toward him like frenzied beasts, each scrambling to be the first to kill him!
